14.desc: Aftershocks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

15.name: Tremors
15.desc: Earthquake can cast more minimum possible Aftershocks. Each enemy can only be targeted by one Aftershock.

16.name: Amplitude
16.desc: Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.

17.name: Rupture
17.desc: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Potency
18.desc: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

19.name: Ground Slam
19.desc: Using Earthquake directly it now deals damage in a cone which has increased range. Aftershocks also favour targets in the direction Earthquake is cast.

20.name: Seismic Smash
20.desc: Modifiers to Aftershock damage on this tree apply to the initial slam, but Earthquake can no longer create Aftershocks.

21.name: Seismic Tide
21.desc:
Earthquake's initial slam occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Earthquake now has a cooldown, and each initial hit consumes mana.

22.name: Sunder
22.desc: Earthquake's initial slam reduces enemy armor.

23.name: The Harder They Fall
23.desc: Earthquake's initial slam deals more hit damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +15% Initial Slam Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

24.name: Cataclysm
24.desc:
Earthquake's base damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

25.name: Concussion
25.desc: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

26.name: Storm Rift
26.desc:
Earthquake is converted into a spell, and no longer scales with melee damage. Earthquake now deals substantial additional base damage on the initial slam and its base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increased lightning damage, but not with increased physical damage.

Aftershocks also deal substantial additional spell damage.

27.name: Thunderblight
27.desc: Earthquake's initial slam deals additional lightning damage, and Earthquake deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.name: Fury Of The Elements
28.desc:
Casting Earthquake expends Storm Stacks over 0.5 seconds.

{Storm Bolts} triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.name: Staggering Force
30.desc: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage and has increased stun chance and stun duration, but Earthquake has a 6 second cooldown.

31.name: Shattered Resolve
31.desc: Stuns caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer, but Earthquake has a longer cooldown.

32.name: Deep Impact
32.desc: Earthquake's initial slam can't be dodged.

2.name: Toxic Envelopment
2.desc: Root Wave hits have a chance to poison enemies.

3.name: Venomous Briar
3.desc: Entangling Roots' base physical damage over time is converted to poison and it now has the poison tag. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

4.name: Kobra Vines
4.desc: Rooted enemies are also blinded.

5.name: Poisonous Seeds
5.desc:
Entangling Roots now creates seeds in the area. When an enemy draws too close to a seed it bursts, releasing a burst of spores that slow and poison enemies.

If you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node, the seed bursts inflict {Frostbite} and {Chill} instead of slow and poison.

6.name: Renewing Pollen
6.desc:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.

7.name: Nectar of Rejuvenation
7.desc: Seeds now burst when an ally draws close to them which grants you and your allies the {Haste} buff, granting you 30% increased movement speed.

8.name: Earthy Puffball
8.desc: Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.

9.name: Rampant Growth
9.desc: Seeds will now grow {Vines} when they burst.

10.name: Entrapped
10.desc: Root Wave immobilizes enemies for a longer duration.

11.name: Inescapable Thicket
11.desc: Root Wave cannot be dodged.

12.name: Frenzying Thorns
12.desc: Entanging Roots now wraps around your totems and vines for twice the duration as enemies, granting them additional armor and increased attack and cast speed.
stats: +10% Attack Speed To Totems And Vines
+10% Cast Speed To Totems And Vines

13.name: Bramblewood Wardens
13.desc: Entangling Roots now also wraps around your Spriggans for twice the duration as enemies, granting them all buffs from {Frenzying Thorns} as well as additional projectiles with their {Thorn Volley}.

14.name: Reclamation
14.desc: Entangling Roots leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

15.name: Noxious Grasp
15.desc: Entangling Roots deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Lethal Spines
16.desc: Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Overgrown Garden
17.desc: You now cause Entangling Roots to expand in a circle around you rather than a cone in front, but it now has a cooldown.

18.name: Rooted System
18.desc: Entangling Roots is now cast from the nearest totem to your cursor.

19.name: Briarthorn's Wrath
19.desc:
When you are stunned, you now cast Entangling Roots. 

This effect has a 20 seconds cooldown, which doesn't affect Entangling Root's cooldown.

20.name: Shredding Vines
20.desc: Root Wave hits shred enemy physical resistance.

21.name: Thick Growth
21.desc: Root Wave's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have a higher chance to stun enemiess.

22.name: Winternid Thorns
22.desc:
Entangling Roots' base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Physical Resistance Shred from all sources is converted to Cold Resistance Shred chance and effects related to Physical Resistance Shred now depend on Cold Resistance Shred instead.

23.name: Iceshard Roots
23.desc:
Root Wave has a chance to inflict {Frostbite}. 

Poison chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite for Root Wave and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

24.name: Thicket of Frost
24.desc: Root Wave gains additional freeze rate per character level.

25.name: Nourishment Surge
25.desc:
Root Wave now heals other allies it hits. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

This effect is tripled for minions.

26.name: Wild Weapons
26.desc: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional physical damage with spells and attacks for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

27.name: Blooming Magic
27.desc: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional damage with spells for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

28.name: Bush Stalkers
28.desc: Root Wave causes your Wolves and Bear it hits to have improved base critical strile chance and deal more damage with critical strikes for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.
stats: +4% Wolves And Bear Base Crit Chance

29.name: Venomsting
29.desc:
Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to have additional chance to poison on hit. This buff lasts 8 seconds and does not stack.

The effect is tripled for Scorpions and Serpents.

2.name: Brutal Impact
2.desc: Fury Leap's critical strikes deal more damage.

3.name: Regain Stamina
3.desc:
You have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown whenever you kill an enemy with any other skill.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.
stats: 5% Chance To Reset Fury Leap Cooldown On Kill

4.name: Lagon's Wrath
4.desc: Fury Leap creates {Storm Bolts} while you are leaping.

5.name: Storm Bringer
5.desc: {Storm Bolts} occur with increased frequency.

6.name: Rejuvenating Storms
6.desc:
You have additional spell damage per 2 Attunement while leaping, and kills with {Storm Bolt} have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.
stats: +1 Spell Damage Per 2 Attunement While Leaping
30% Chance For Storm Bolt To Reset Fury Leap's Cooldown

7.name: Warrior's Entrance
7.desc: When you land, you and your minions gain additional melee damage and spell damage for 3 seconds. This buff can stack.

8.name: Frenzied Onslaught
8.desc: When you land, you and your minions gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds, which increases attack and cast speed. Frenzy cannot stack.

9.name: Pack Leader
9.desc: Your Wolf, Sabertooth, and Raptor companions leap with you.

10.name: Crushing Impact
10.desc: Fury Leap has an increased chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflicts last longer.

11.name: Gravity
11.desc: Fury Leap pulls enemies when you land.

12.name: Rise
12.desc: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you leap from.
stats: 25% Chance To Cast Summon Vines At Departure

13.name: Poisonous Thicket
13.desc: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you land.
stats: 25% Chance To Cast Summon Vines At Arrival

14.name: Crater
14.desc: Fury Leap's deals damage in a larger area and costs less mana.

15.name: Ambush Predator
15.desc: Fury Leap hits deal more damage against enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +30% Hit Damage Against Enemies At Full Health

16.name: Savage Impact
16.desc: Fury Leap deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it deals as health.

17.name: Aspect of the Mantis
17.desc:
Fury Leap's cooldown is reset when you kill an enemy with a short leap.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.
stats: Reset Fury Leap Cooldown On Short Leap Kill

18.name: Unshackled
18.desc: While you are below half health, Fury Leap always critically strikes.

20.name: Panther Strike
20.desc: Fury Leap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

22.name: Violent Upheaval
22.desc: When you land with Fury Leap you cast Upheaval. This consumes Upheaval's mana cost and requires positive mana.

24.name: Heorot's Protection
24.desc: You are immune to damage while leaping.

25.name: Wind Hammer
25.desc: Fury Leap deals more damage based on how far you leap.

26.name: Wings of Endurance
26.desc: When you land, you and your minions are healed.

27.name: Battle Bloom
27.desc: When you land you cleanse all ailments on you and your minions.

2.name: Looming Clouds
2.desc: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} at an additional enemy.

3.name: Concentrated Storm
3.desc: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend {Storm Stacks} more frequently, but {Storm Bolts} target enemies within a smaller area.

4.name: In the Eye of the Storm
4.desc: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.

6.name: A Storm Gathers
6.desc: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.

7.name: Lightning Gale
7.desc: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain {Haste}.

8.name: Whirlwind Tactics
8.desc:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend {Storm Stacks} over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 1 Expends Storm Stacks On Companion Use

9.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
9.desc: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a {Storm Bolt} you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.

10.name: Lagonian Diplomacy
10.desc: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of {Storm Bolt}, but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.

11.name: Clouds on the Horizon
11.desc: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from farther away.

12.name: Friends of the Tempest
12.desc: If you have from 1 to 15 {Storm Stacks}, your minions' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

13.name: Thunderous Strikes
13.desc: Gathering Storm penetrates enemy lightning resistance.

14.name: Excited Bolts
14.desc: {Storm Bolts} now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana, up to a maximum.

15.name: Two Eyed Storm
15.desc: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} while dual wielding you now cast {Storm Bolts} at two enemies instead of one.
stats: Additional Storm Bolt While Dual Wielding

16.name: Windfury Blows
16.desc: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.

17.name: Manafused Storm
17.desc: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.
stats: 1 Mana Gain Per Storm Stack On Use

18.name: The Typhoon
18.desc: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.
stats: 15% Increased Stun Chance Per Storm Stack
+15% Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Storm Stack

19.name: Energized by the Skies
19.desc: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional {Storm Stacks}.

20.name: Island Cleaver
20.desc: Gathering Storm's melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional {Storm Stack} if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.

21.name: Wings of Lightning
21.desc:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm's and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Wings of Lightning}.

Each time one of your {Storm Crows} attack they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.

22.name: Jolting Strikes
22.desc:
{Storm Bolts'} hits have chance to shock enemies.

Gathering Storm deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

23.name: Tempest Weapon
23.desc:
Gathering Storm deals additional spell damage per 3 melee damage on your equipped axe or mace.

The added spell damage granted by this effect is significantly reduced when applied to a Storm Totem through its {Unmatched Storms}.

24.name: Earth Smasher
24.desc:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to armor shred chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Physical} tag.

25.name: Seismic Crash
25.desc: Gathering Storm deals additional melee damage per Strength while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

26.name: Frostbringer
26.desc:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

27.name: Of Ice and Snow
27.desc: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to chill enemies and a higher chance to freeze enemies.

28.name: Winter Comes
28.desc: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.

30.name: Rending Vortex
30.desc: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of {Maelstrom} on you from any source.

2.name: Turmoil
2.desc: Maelstrom deals damage in a larger area.

3.name: Storm's Aid
3.desc: You can choose to cast Maelstrom on your minions instead of yourself.

4.name: Vortex
4.desc: Maelstrom deals more damage when cast on a totem (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.name: Grip of Chaos
5.desc: When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.
stats: 10% Chance for Tornado on Direct Cast

6.name: Arctic Chill
6.desc: Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.

7.name: Tsunami
7.desc: After every fifth Maelstrom stack gained, you release a {Tsunami}, a cold spell that deals damage in an area around you.

8.name: Typhoon
8.desc: {Tsunami} deals more damage and has increased area for each stack of Maelstrom on you.

9.name: Healing Winds
9.desc: Maelstrom also heals allies in its area of effect each second.

10.name: Violent Squall
10.desc: Maelstrom deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), has significantly increased healing effectiveness and lasts significantly longer, but you can have only one maximum stack of Maelstrom.

11.name: Eye of the Storm
11.desc: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

12.name: Arctic Blast
12.desc: Maelstrom has an increased chance to freeze enemies each second.

13.name: Beneath The Waves
13.desc: If you go one second without directly casting Maelstrom you gain a stack of {Lagon's Slumber}. When you next cast Maelstrom directly, all stacks of {Lagon's Slumber} are consumed to cast Maelstrom an additional time per stack.

14.name: Calm
14.desc: Maelstrom costs less mana.

15.name: Sleet-Footed
15.desc: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you increased dodge chance.
stats: 3% Increased Dodge Rating Per Maelstrom Stack

16.name: Cyclone
16.desc:
Maelstrom's base cold damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze, but each stack of Maelstrom grants global more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +1% Global More Physical Damage Per Maelstrom Stack

17.name: Whirlpool
17.desc: Maelstrom stacks have a longer duration.

18.name: Power of the Storm
18.desc: While you have 6 or more stacks, you cast {Storm Bolt} at a nearby enemy each second.
stats: Storm Bolt Cast Each Second At 6 Or More Stacks

19.name: Strong Tides
19.desc: {Power of The Storm's} stack requirement is reduced.

20.name: Energized
20.desc: {Storm Bolt} from the {Power of the Storm} node is cast at additional targets.

21.name: Turbulence
21.desc: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is doubled if you have at least 60 Attunement.

22.name: Growing Storm
22.desc:
You have a chance on killing an enemy or hitting a boss or rare enemy to cast Maelstrom. 

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.
stats: +5% Chance On Kill To Cast Maelstrom
+2% Chance On Hitting Boss Or Rare

23.name: Windswept
23.desc: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Haste.}

24.name: Windfury
24.desc: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Frenzy.}

26.name: Essence of Debris
26.desc: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.
stats: +8% Global Increased Stun Chance Per Stack

28.name: Frozen Abyss
28.desc: Maelstrom deals more damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Prowling Juggernaut
2.desc: Your sabertooth has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and recovers a percentage of its maximum health when it leaps.

3.name: Frozen Fur
3.desc: Your sabertooth has additional cold resistance and it has a chance to chill attackers that hit it. It also has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Shatterhide
4.desc: All physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.

5.name: Ferocity
5.desc: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with {Flurry Swipes}.

6.name: Camouflage
6.desc: Your sabertooth has more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it gains additional dodge rating for each point of Dexterity you have.

7.name: Savage Catalyst
7.desc: When your sabertooth directly uses a melee attack and hits at least one target it has a chance to use {Flurry Swipes}.

8.name: Sabermaw
8.desc: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its melee attacks have increased area.

9.name: Keen Senses
9.desc: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike chance.

10.name: Opportunistic Hunter
10.desc: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike multiplier.

12.name: Agile and Deadly
12.desc: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed.

13.name: Frenzy
13.desc: Your sabertooth gains Frenzy for 2 seconds after using {Flurry Swipes}.

14.name: From the Brink
14.desc: While your sabertooth is on low health it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage it deals as health.

15.name: Patient Predator
15.desc: Your sabertooth deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Frost Fang
16.desc: Your sabertooth deals additional cold damage with spells and melee attacks.

17.name: Ice Tiger
17.desc:
Your sabertooth becomes an {Ice Tiger}, converting 100% of its base melee physical damage to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to physical damage. The ice tiger's melee attacks have a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

All bleed chance is converted to frostbite chance for your ice tiger.

The ice tiger's melee attacks' {Physical

18.name: Rhyme Heart
18.desc: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of chill on the target.

19.name: Ice Bringer
19.desc: Your sabertooth has a a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

20.name: King of the Tundra
20.desc: Your sabertooth has additional Freeze Rate Multiplier and it has more Freeze Rate per stack of Chill on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers)

21.name: Northwind
21.desc: Your sabertooth deals additional cold melee damage based on your dexterity.

22.name: Heavy Paws
22.desc: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.

23.name: Destructive Power
23.desc:
Your sabertooth's attacks which hit at least one enemy have a chance to trigger {Upheaval}. Upheaval cast in this way uses your sabertooth's stats, but your Upheaval tree.

This chance is halved if Upheaval creates multiple fault lines.

24.name: Earthshaking Entrance
24.desc: When your sabertooth leaps, it uses {Upheaval} when it lands

25.name: Hunter's Trail
25.desc: When your sabertooth leaps you gain {Haste} for a duration.
stats: You gain Haste when your Sabertooth Leaps

26.name: Cornered Beast
26.desc: Your sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} inflict Bleed on hit and if you or your Sabertoth are below half health it always crits.
stats: +100% Flurry Swipes Crit Chance if You or Sabertooth are below 50% Health

27.name: Ancestral Favor
27.desc: Your ancestral sabertooths have increased duration per point of your attunement. Additionally, your sabertooth gains attunement scaling equivalent to its strength scaling.
stats: Attunement Scaling Equivalent to Strength Scaling

28.name: Ancestral Hunter
28.desc: Your sabertooth's hits now have a chance to summon an {Ancestral Sabertooth} that attacks nearby enemies for a short duration. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

29.name: Ancient Bond
29.desc: Your sabertooth's hits have a higher chance to summon {Ancestral Sabertooths} and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.name: Gouging Claws
30.desc: Your sabertooth's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred armor.

2.name: Death by a Thousand Wings
2.desc: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and {Locust} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.name: Bloodlust Swarm
3.desc:
When you create a {Locust Swarm} with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the {Swarm} to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.
stats: 5% Locust Swarm Increased Damage Per Bleed

4.name: Feverous Stings
4.desc: Yours and your {Locusts'} hits have a chance to poison enemies.

5.name: Grand Colony
5.desc: You can control additional {Locusts} and your Hives contain additional {Locusts}.

6.name: Hive Mind
6.desc: Hives release {Locusts} more frequently and if you have an active {Locust Swarm} it also releases Locusts every second.
stats: 1 Locusts per 3 seconds from Locust Swarm

7.name: Swarmkeeper's Call
7.desc:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with {Cleanse Hives}, which releases all {Locusts} from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with {Healing Totems} and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

8.name: Bountiful Hibernacula
8.desc: When a {Hive} releases a {Locust} you regain health and {Rage}.

9.name: Release the Horde
9.desc: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release {Locusts}.

10.name: Frost Bites

11.name: Chitin Sleet Storm
11.desc: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.

12.name: Spiked Vespiary
12.desc: Your Hives now cast {Thorns} as if they were {Thorn Totems}, rather than releasing {Locusts}. They can cast thorns a limited number of times equal to the number of Locusts they would have released.

13.name: Locust Agility
13.desc: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.

14.name: Water Strider
14.desc:
You cast {Maelstrom} a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom's mana cost as {Rage}.

15.name: Springer's Fury
15.desc: You gain {Rage} when you dodge.

16.name: Ironclad Beetle
16.desc: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.

17.name: Slashing Spiral
17.desc: Your Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm} and your {Locusts'} melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.

18.name: Vampiric Mandibles
18.desc: Your {Locust Swarm} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

20.name: Neverending Drove
20.desc: {Locust Swarm} has more duration and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Swarm's Fury
21.desc:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with {Angered Swarm}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your {Locust Swarm} and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

22.name: Inspiring Swarm
22.desc: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.
stats: Random Companion Ability After Swarm Strike

23.name: Plague of Locusts
23.desc: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage per {Locust} consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per {Locust} consumed.
stats: +4% Poison Chance Per Locust While Swarm Active

24.name: Earth Stinger
24.desc: You and your {Locusts} deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your {Locust Swarm} deals additional melee physical damage per active {Locust} consumed when you use Swarm Strike.
stats: +3 Swarm Melee Physical Damage Per Locust

25.name: Needle-Like Sting
25.desc: You and your {Locusts} have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.

26.name: Hornet Nest
26.desc: You can only control half as many {Locusts}, but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.

20.desc: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now consumes your mana.

21.desc: Storm Crow hits have a chance to grant you a stack of {Aspect of the Crow} for 8 seconds, granting you additional melee and spell lightning damage per stack.

22.name: Navigator
22.desc: Your non-crow companions gain {Aspect of the Crow} when you do, but it has 50% reduced duration on them.
stats: Aspect of the Crow On Other Companions

23.name: Goodberries
23.desc:
Storm Crows fly to your companions below half health to heal them. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness.

24.name: Silverberries
24.desc:
{Goodberries} now also grants the companion ward. 

The amount of ward gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

25.name: Forager
25.desc: Storm Crows are able to use {Goodberries} more frequently.

26.name: Winds of Restoration
26.desc: Storm Crows can now also fly to and heal you with {Goodberries}.

27.name: Wisdom of the Storm
27.desc:
Every 10 seconds Storm Crows cast {Wisdom of the Storm} on its nearest ally, granting it {Aspect of the Crow}. 

This effect has 50% reduced duration on minions.
stats: Wisdom of the Storm On Allies

28.name: Ornithology
28.desc: You are granted additional Intelligence per active Storm Crow.

29.name: Arborist
29.desc: {Wisdom of the Storm} no longer has a cooldown, but can now only target totems.
stats: Wisdom of the Storm On Totems

30.name: Sky Passage
30.desc:
When you directly cast {Crowstorm} you and your crows are teleported to the target location if it is accessible.

Crowstorm now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

31.name: Thunderous Blast
31.desc: {Crowstorm} deals more damage per contributing Crow (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

2.name: Primal Serpent
2.desc: When Serpent Strike kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Primal Serpent}.
stats: 2% Summon Chance on Rare or Boss Hit

3.name: Culling Point
3.desc: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to instantly kill enemies that are below a threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

4.name: Coldfang
4.desc: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

5.name: Serpent Venom
5.desc: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to inflict {Serpent Venom}, an ailment that deals poison damage over time and prevents enemies from landing critical strikes. It lasts 3 seconds and cannot stack.

6.name: Spirit Viper
6.desc: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Vitality, and if you have 50 Vitality you regain mana when you inflict an enemy with Serpent Venom or refresh its duration.
stats: 1 Mana Gain with at least 50 Vitality

7.name: Poison Tipped
7.desc: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to poison on hit and they deal more melee damage per stack of poison on the target, up to a limit.

8.name: Venomous Union
8.desc:
When you lunge forwards with Serpent Strike, if you have a {Scorpion} it casts its companion ability, {Venom Nova}, twice, once centred on itself, and once centred on you.

This effect has a 12 second cooldown, but ignores Venom Nova's regular cooldown and does not put it on cooldown.
stats: 2 Venom Novas on Lunge (12 Second Cooldown)

9.name: Cobra Lunge
9.desc: When you attempt to use Serpent Strike against a target that is slightly out of range you will lunge forwards before attacking.
stats: Lunge if Slightly Out of Range

10.name: Constrictor
10.desc: You gain a stack of {Constrictor} every 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 4. When you use Serpent Strike all stacks are consumed causing the attack to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Mussurana
11.desc: Each stack of {Constrictor} also grants Serpent Strike additional poison chance and increased poison duration when consumed

12.name: Sapping Coils
12.desc: You regain mana when you consume a stack of {Constrictor}.

13.name: Slither
13.desc:
You gain {Slither} for 4 seconds when you use Serpent Strike and hit at least one enemy.

Each stack grants you more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Gouging Spear
14.desc: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

15.name: Hydra Strikes
15.desc: Serpent Strike has increased attack speed.

16.name: Corrosive Venom
16.desc: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and posion resistance.

17.name: Devour Prey
17.desc: You regain health when Serpent Strikes kills or critically strikes an enemy.

18.name: Eye of the Viper
18.desc: Serpent Strike's critical strikes deal more damage.

20.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
20.desc:
Serpent Strike now has a chance to freeze and its base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

21.name: Vicious Strikes
21.desc: {Primal Serpents} have increased melee attack speed and are granted health when they hit enemies with a melee attack.
stats: 10 Primal Serpent Health Granted On Melee Hit

22.name: Iron Scales
22.desc: {Primal Serpents} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional armour

23.name: Emerald Fangs
23.desc: {Primal Serpents}'s hits have an additional chance to poison enemies and inflict {frailty}.

24.name: Guardian Spear
24.desc: Instead of summoning a new serpent when the {Primal Serpent} node's effect triggers, you heal your current serpent to full health and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This damage buff can stack.

26.name: Biting Winds
26.desc: Frosbite inflicted by Serpent Strike lasts longer and has additional cold penetration

27.name: Shroud of Winter
27.desc: You have additional dodge rating per cold resistance, for each stack of the {Slither} buff.

28.name: Swirling Carnage
28.desc: Each active stack of {Maelstrom} grants Serpent Strike additional chance to inflict bleed on hit and more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Steel Eater
29.desc: Armour Shred inflicted by Serpent Strike has an increased effect based on your Dexterity.

30.name: Shattered Immunity
30.desc: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the number of poison and frostbite stacks on them, up to a maximum benefit from each ailment.
stats: +1% Serpent Venom Damage Per Frostbite Stack

31.name: Fast Acting Toxins
31.desc:
Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your melee critical strike chance.

If your melee crit chance is above 50% then Serpent Venom deals its damage twice as quickly. This does not increase the total damage it deals over its full duration, but rather halves its duration and doubles its damage per second.
stats: +2% Serpent Venom Damage per Melee Crit Chance
+100% Serpent Venom Speed with >50% Melee Crit Chance

32.name: Dread Fang
32.desc: Ailments applied by Serpent Strike and {Primal Serpents} have additional poison penetration.

2.name: Static Field
2.desc: Storm Totem attacks have a chance to shock enemies.

3.name: Exploit Weaknesses
3.desc: Storm Totem hits deal more damage to shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Press Your Advantage
4.desc: Storm Totem has more critical strike chance against shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 10% More Crit Chance Against Shocked Enemies

5.name: Fulgurite Core
5.desc: Storm Totem has additional Spell Lightning Damage based on your Shock Chance and your Chance to Shock Attackers.
stats: +1 Spell Lightning Damage per 10% Shock Chance
+1 Spell Lightning Damage per 10% Chance to Shock Attackers

6.name: Overstimulation
6.desc: Enemies hit by Storm Totem recently have reduced movement speed.

7.name: Stormrider
7.desc: You have increased movement speed if Storm Totem has hit a shocked an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

8.name: Grounding Conduit
8.desc: You deal increased lightning damage if a Storm Totem has hit a shocked an enemy recently.

9.name: Shielding Totem
9.desc: Allies near your Storm Totem have additional lightning resistance.

10.name: Steel Plating
10.desc: Storm Totem has increased health.

11.name: Heavy Impact
11.desc: Storm Totem hits have an increased chance to stun enemies and the stuns they inflict last longer.

12.name: Limited Resistance
12.desc: Storm Totem costs less mana to summon.

13.name: Lightning Raider
13.desc: Storm Totem has more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Direct Current
14.desc: Improves Storm Totem's base critical strike chance.

15.name: Power Shunt
15.desc: Storm Totem critical strikes deal more damage.

16.name: Blizzard
16.desc:
Storm Totem now creates a {Blizzard} around itself; enemies caught in the blizzard take cold damage over time and have a 25% chance to be chilled each second.

All shock chance is converted to chill chance. All effects which are conditional on shock are conditional on chill instead.

17.name: Icicles
17.desc: Storm Totem deals additional cold spell damage.

18.name: Chill to the Bone
18.desc: Storm Totem hits have a chance to chill enemies.

19.name: Frostbite
19.desc: {Blizzard} has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite} each second.

20.name: Piercing Winds
20.desc: {Frostbite} inflicted by {Blizzard} has additional Cold Penetration.

21.name: Storm's Reach
21.desc: Storm Totem's individual lightning strikes damage enemies in a larger area

22.name: Shockfury
22.desc: Allies near your Storm Totem are granted additional melee lightning damage.

23.name: Discharge
23.desc: Storm Totem casts {Lightning Nova} when it dies.

24.name: Intensity
24.desc: Storm Totem deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but cost more mana.

25.name: Thunder Totem
25.desc:
If you have at least 3 other totems when you summon Storm Totem, up to 5 are consumed to instead summon a {Thunder Totem} which has more damage, duration, health and size per totem consumed this way (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect does not consume other Storm Totems or Thunder Totems.
stats: +20% Thunder Totem Damage, Health, Duration And Size Per Totem

26.name: Unmatched Storms
26.desc: Your Storm Totem now casts {Storm Bolts} from your {Gathering Storm} instead of its own lightning strikes, but Storm Totem has significantly less cast speed and deals less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: Storm Bolts Instead Of Lightning Strikes

2.name: Claws of the Bear
2.desc: Swipe deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and slows enemies, but has a cooldown.

3.name: Twin Fangs
3.desc: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have additional critical strike multiplier per Stack. This bonus is doubled if you are dual wielding.

4.name: Blood Beast
4.desc: Swipe hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

5.name: Rending
5.desc: Swipe has a chance to shred physical resistance on hit.

6.name: Duality of Nature
6.desc: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain health if you are transformed, or mana if you are not transformed.

7.name: Culling
7.desc:
Swipe hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

8.name: Sabertooth's Endurance
8.desc:
Each stack of {Aspect of the Panther} lasts longer and grants increased health regen.

Aspect of the Panther also applies to your {Sabertooth} if you have one.
stats: Aspect of the Panther affects Sabertooth

9.name: Storm Claw
9.desc:
Swipe deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Every 3 seconds, your next Swipe deals damage in a larger area and has its base damage converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Swipe gains a {Lightning} tag.

10.name: Lagon's Fury
10.desc: The cooldown for the effect of the {Storm Claw} node is reset if you summon a Totem.
stats: Storm Claw Cooldown Reset on Totem Summon

11.name: Umjol's Guidance
11.desc:
Swipe has a chance to shock on hit and a portion of Swipe's base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

If you have 5 points in this node, Swipe loses its {Physical} tag.

12.name: Storm Scour
12.desc: Swipe has additional lightning penetration based on your Attunement

13.name: Way of the Hunt
13.desc: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of damage dealt as health.

14.name: Claws of Stone
14.desc: You have a chance to summon a {Claw Totem} when Swipe kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy.
stats: 10% Chance To Summon Claw Totem On Kill
10% Chance to Summon Claw Totem On Rare or Boss hit

15.name: Aspect of the Panther
15.desc: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Aspect of the Panther. Each stack lasts 4 seconds and grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Lion's Strength
16.desc: Aspect of the Panther can have more stacks and each stack grants you additional melee damage.
stats: +1 Maximum Aspect of the Panther Stacks

17.name: Wild Calling
17.desc: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.

18.name: Lupine Attunement
18.desc: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.

19.name: Feline Hunter
19.desc: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have increased attack and cast speed. This does not scale with the number of stacks.

20.name: Wrath of the Wild
20.desc: Swipe deals more Lightning Damage per stack of Shock on the target and more Cold Damage per stack of Chill on the target.

21.name: Wengarian Reach
21.desc: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

22.name: Primal Resonance
22.desc: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy your nearest companion uses its companion ability and is restored to full health.
stats: 100% Nearest Companion Health Restored on Hit

23.name: Avatar of Stone
23.desc: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy, all your totems gain +1 Melee Damage and +1 Spell Damage. This buff stacks and lasts until the totems expire.

24.name: Trapper
24.desc: Swipe hits deal more damage against slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

2.name: Forested Expanse
2.desc: You can have additional Thorn Totems active, but Summon Thorn Totem costs more mana.

3.name: Grove Mind
3.desc: You summon your maximum number of Thorn Totems at once in a ring around the target location, but your maximum number of Thorn Totems is reduced and Summon Thorn Totem costs additional mana per additional totem summoned.
stats: Totems Summoned In Ring At Location
+15 Mana Cost Per Additional Totem Summoned

4.name: Memories of Eterra
4.desc: You regain mana when a Thorn Totem dies or is unsummoned.

5.name: Totemic Wisdom
5.desc: Summon Thorn Totem costs less mana.

6.name: Venom Tipped Thorns
6.desc: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to poison enemies.

7.name: Rotten Core
7.desc:
When Thorn Totems die or are unsummoned they release a {Poison Burst}, which deals a small amount of physical spell damage on hit and inflicts poison.

Thorn Totem gains a {Poison} tag, but this does not affect the damage type of Thorn Totems' other abilities.

8.name: Lasting Affliction
8.desc: Poison and Frostbite inflicted by Thorn Totem last longer.

9.name: Pillars of Heorot
9.desc:
Thorn Totem's thorns gain a chance to freeze and 100% of their base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently its damage now scales with your totems' increases to cold damage instead of physical damage.

All poison chance is converted to frostbite chance for Thorn Totems.

Thorn Totems have additional cold resistance.

10.name: Frost Attunement
10.desc: Thorn Totem has a higher chance to freeze enemies, and a greater chance to freeze enemies for each point of Attunement you have.
stats: +5% Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Point Of Attunement

11.name: Winterwood
11.desc: Thorn Totem deals additional spell cold damage, including its own thorns.

12.name: On Astral Winds
12.desc: Thorn Totems deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but their projectiles travel more slowly.

13.name: Torrent of Thorns
13.desc: Thorn Totems have a chance to release twice as many thorns with each burst.

14.name: Titan's Bane
14.desc: Thorn Totems fire only one thorn with each burst, but they have massively increased cast speed, are more accurate with their thorns, and their thorns' hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +10% Thorn Hit Damage vs Rares and Bosses

15.name: Spriggans' Wrath
15.desc: Thorn Totem's thorns can pierce enemies up to a maximum

16.name: Ancient Power
16.desc: Thorn Totem deals more damage, but has less cast speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Impale
17.desc: Thorn Totem's thorns have a chance to deal double damage on hit.

18.name: Shred Armor
18.desc: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

19.name: Winged Thorns
19.desc: Thorn Totem's thorns travel faster and farther.

20.name: Frenetic Attunement
20.desc: You summon Thorn Totem faster and all Thorn Totems have increased cast speed.

21.name: Oaken Protection
21.desc: Thorn Totems have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional physical resistance.

22.name: Guided Thorns
22.desc: Thorn Totem's thorns now seek nearby targets, but Thorn Totem has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Eternal Forest
23.desc: Thorn Totems last longer and have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers)

24.name: Lethal Thicket
24.desc: Thorn Totems have an increased critical strike chance and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Nightshade Briar
25.desc: Thorn Totem's thorn hits deal more damage per stack of poison on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum.

2.name: Lasting Storm
2.desc: Tornado lasts longer.

3.name: Strength of Air
3.desc: Tornado has increased pull strength.

4.name: Hurricane
4.desc: When you use Tornado, you have a chance to create an additional Tornado, but Tornadoes have reduced pull strength.

5.name: Charged Storm
5.desc: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} at an enemy within 8 meters every 2 seconds.

6.name: Frequent Lightning
6.desc: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} more frequently.

7.name: Debris
7.desc: Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

8.name: Fire Tornado
8.desc:
Tornados' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Druidic Control
9.desc: Tornado is now stationary, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Eye of the Storm
10.desc: Tornado deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and attach to you wherever you move, but you can no longer cast additional Tornadoes at once.
stats: Can No Longer Cast Additional Tornadoes

11.name: Overcast Skies
11.desc: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from further away.

12.name: Churning Orbs
12.desc: Tornado now create a {Storm Orb} every second, but Tornado has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Trail of Storms
13.desc: Tornadoes cast {Storm Orbs} more frequently.

14.name: Igniting Swirl
14.desc: Tornado ignites nearby enemies every second.

15.name: Inferno
15.desc: Tornado gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells as ignite chance per second.
stats: 50% Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second

16.name: Stormbringer
16.desc: Tornado has increased cast speed and area of effect.

17.name: Aspect of the Storm
17.desc: Casting Tornado grants {Aspect of the Storm} for 2 seconds, which grants 10% increased movespeed.

18.name: Storm Dervish
18.desc: {Aspect of the Storm} now also grants increased attack and cast speed.
stats: +7% Aspect of the Storm Attack Speed
+7% Aspect of the Storm Cast Speed

19.name: Gust of Renewal
19.desc: Tornado costs less mana, and {Aspect of the Storm} grants increased mana regeneration.
stats: +3% Aspect of the Storm Mana Regen

20.name: Swift Wings
20.desc: {Aspect of the Storm} lasts longer.

21.name: Snap Gale
21.desc: Tornado is now instant cast and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now has a 4 second cooldown.

22.name: Storm Soul
22.desc: Tornado has a shorter cooldown and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Voices of the Wind
23.desc: Tornado is now a channelled skill, sustaining a single tornado that follows your cursor. This tornado deals much more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased area of effect. Modifiers to duration affect its damage instead.

24.name: Shelter of the Storm
24.desc: While channelling Tornado you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have increased dodge rating.

2.name: Lagonian Shamanism
2.desc: You now have a chance to gain a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} when you cast a {Tempest}.

3.name: Tempestuous Legend
3.desc:
{Frigid Tempest} has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
{Thunder Tempest} has a chance to shock enemies.
{Wind Tempest} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Thunderous Storm
4.desc: You have a chance to also cast {Thunder Tempest} when you attack with cold or physical Tempest Strike.

5.name: Grand Cyclone
5.desc: You have a chance to also cast {Wind Tempest} when you attack with lightning or cold Tempest Strike.

6.name: Nature's Storm
6.desc: If Tempest Strike's melee attack does not hit an enemy you consume a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} to cast a {Tempest} of the respective type.

7.name: Scheme of the Architect
7.desc: {Gladiator of Lagon} has double the effect on your totems and {Storm Crows} if you have at least 50 Intelligence.

8.name: Stormriding Companions
8.desc: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy physical resistance per active physical minion, penetrates cold resistance per cold minion and penetrates lightning resistance per lightning minion.

9.name: Bulwark of Nature
9.desc: Whenever you cast a {Tempest} you also regain a portion of your Endurance Threshold as health.

10.name: Druid's Call
10.desc:
While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.

11.name: Attuned Slam
11.desc: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost, but it also costs additional mana.

12.name: Looming Gale
12.desc: You now create a {Tempest Totem} that casts a {Tempest} of the corresponding strike that created the totem. You are limited to 1 of each type of totem.

13.name: Rousing Symbols
13.desc: Your {Tempest Totems} gain a random amount of more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) when summoned.

14.name: Sky Opener
14.desc:
You now expend {Storm Stacks} when you use Tempest Strike and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack.

{Storm Bolts} cast this way deal more damage.

15.name: Windfury Force
15.desc: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

16.name: Heorot's Arsenal
16.desc: Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per equipped axe or mace and additional spell damage while wielding a 2 handed weapon.
stats: +5 Melee Damage With Axe Or Mace

17.name: Firm Grip
17.desc:
Tempest Strike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

These effects are doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

18.name: Calm Seas
18.desc:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

19.name: Crashing Waves
19.desc:
Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

20.name: Grounded Refuge
20.desc:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Thunder Tempest}, but it does not remove the lightning strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

21.name: Gladiator of Lagon
21.desc:
The melee hits grant you a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} for 8 seconds which grants you and your minions additional spell damage.

This effect can trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

23.name: Resurgence of the Land
23.desc: You recover mana if whenever you use Tempest Strike and it hits an enemy and it doesn't cast a {Tempest}.
stats: 5 Mana Gain On Hit With No Tempest

24.name: Warm Shelter
24.desc:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Frigid Tempest}, but it does not remove the cold strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

25.name: Ancestral Swiftness
25.desc: Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

26.name: Soaring Blows
26.desc: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.
stats: +1% Physical Pen Per 5% Uncapped Physical Res
+1% Cold Pen Per 5% Uncapped Cold Res
+1% Lighting Pen Per 5% Uncapped Lighting Res

27.name: Wind Booster
27.desc:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you and your other allies it touches gain {Haste} for a short duration.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have Haste.

28.name: Ceaseless Tyhoon
28.desc:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you have a chance to also cast {Tornado}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tornado's mana cost.

29.name: Devastating Whirlwind
29.desc: {Tornados} cast from {Wind Tempest} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

30.name: Blizzard's Wrath
30.desc: You have a chance to also cast {Frigid Tempest} when you attack with lightning or physical Tempest Strike.

32.name: Coldest Night
32.desc:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

33.name: Wrath of the Mountain
33.desc: While channeling {Avalanche} you now also cast {Frigid Tempest} every second.
stats: Frigid Tempest Each Second During Avalanche

34.name: Fulminating Strikes
34.desc:
{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

35.name: Cloudburst Conduit
35.desc: Whenever you cast {Thunder Tempest} you also cast it around your nearest {Storm Totem}.

0.name: Upheaval
0.desc: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.

2.name: Tremblor
2.desc: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.

3.name: Excavating Blow
3.desc:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Erupting Earth
4.desc: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.

5.name: Glacial Cascade
5.desc:
Upheaval's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and slow chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

6.name: Sundering Strike
6.desc: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a {Shockwave}, a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.

7.name: Inexhaustible
7.desc: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.

8.name: Mantle Strike
8.desc: Improves Upheaval's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

9.name: Crust Rupture
9.desc: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.

10.name: Stonethorn Pillars
10.desc: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active {Thorn Totems} to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.
stats: +30% Upheaval Totem Damage Per Totem Consumed

11.name: Mountain Fortress
11.desc: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.

12.name: Frozen Collision
12.desc: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Cold Front
13.desc: Upheaval has additional freeze rate and has additional chance to inflict Frostbite on hit.

14.name: Sublimation
14.desc: You cast {Shatter} on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.

15.name: Quarry Maker
15.desc: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

16.name: Maiming Rubble
16.desc:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

17.name: Terrain Delving
17.desc: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.

18.name: Primal Bulwark
18.desc: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.

19.name: Through Muck and Clay
19.desc: While you have {Earth Armor}, if you fall below 6 stacks of {Maelstrom} you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.
stats: Consume Earth Armor Falling Below 6 Maelstroms

20.name: Terraforming Clash
20.desc: Upheaval travels further.

21.name: Earthbreaker
21.desc:
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but no longer scales with modifiers to attack speed.

These effects are doubled when Upheaval is directly used.

22.name: Glacial Crash
22.desc:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

23.name: Natural Weapons
23.desc: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.

24.name: Unstoppable Strength
24.desc: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

25.name: Brutish Engagement
25.desc: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.

26.name: Hindering Tremors
26.desc: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.

27.name: Rock Upsurge
27.desc: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a {Shockwave} from the totem.

28.name: Master of the Totem
28.desc: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (each stack multiplicative with each other and other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

29.name: Rejuvenating Splinters
29.desc: Upheaval and {Shockwave} hits from the {Sundering Strikes} node now {Shatter} totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.

30.name: Upheaval Totems
30.desc:
You now create an {Upheaval Totem} that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

Upheaval Totems last 8 seconds.

32.name: Strengthened Roots
32.desc: Upheaval Totems last longer, and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Ursine Heart
2.desc: You have additional endurance and endurance threshold while in Werebear Form.

3.name: Frenzied Strikes
3.desc: You regain additional {Rage} if you hit at least one enemy with {Swipe}.

4.name: Relentless Thunder
4.desc: For 6 seconds after you enter Werebear Form, you deal more Lightning Damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 100% of Swipe's Base Damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with lightning damage instead of physical damage.

5.name: Wisened Claws
5.desc: You gain additional spell damage per point of Strength while in Werebear Form.

6.name: Ursine Storm
6.desc:
You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you use Swipe or Maul and hit at least one enemy.

This consumes Maelstrom's mana cost as Rage.
stats: +8% Chance To Cast Maelstrom On Use

7.name: Rip and Tear
7.desc: Maul and Rampage deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Dauntless
8.desc: Rampage has increased movement speed, a higher chance to stun enemies and stuns inflicted by Rampage last longer.

9.name: Apex Predator
9.desc: Rampage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have global increased damage while Rampaging.

10.name: Eterra's Renewal
10.desc: When you leave Werebear Form you cleanse all negative ailments and gain {Haste} for 3 seconds.

11.name: Voice of the Thicket
11.desc:
After using Rampage, Human Form is now replaced with {Arboreal Protection}, which casts {Thorn Shield} on you and up to 5 nearby allies and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

12.name: Intimidating Cry
12.desc:
After using Rampage, you now {Roar}.

This consumes Warcry's mana cost as Rage and puts it on cooldown.

13.name: Army Sunderer
13.desc: Rampage and Maul hits shred enemy armor.

14.name: Unending Storm
14.desc:
Rampage has no cooldown.

While using Rampage you move more slowly, but deal more lightning damage. Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

15.name: Insatiable
15.desc: Maul and Rampage have improve base critical strike chance and you have global increased critical strike chance while in Werebear Form.
stats: +2% Base Crit Chance For Maul And Rampage

17.name: Crackling Assault
17.desc: You cast {Storm Bolts} from the sky a number of times each second while Rampaging.
stats: 1 Lightning Strikes Per Second While Rampaging

18.name: Invigoration
18.desc: You regain health and {Rage} on kill or when you hit a rare or boss enemy.
stats: +3 Health Gained On Kill Or Hit
+3 Rage Gained On Kill Or Hit

19.name: Bloodthirst
19.desc:
Your hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed while in Werebear Form.

This chance is doubled for Maul.

21.name: Territorial
21.desc: Maul and Roar affects a larger area.

22.name: Fury of the Maul
22.desc: Maul has a shorter cooldown.

24.name: Wild Command
24.desc: When you use Maul and hit at least one enemy, your minions deal increased damage for 8 seconds. This effect can stack.

25.name: Enrage
25.desc: You regain {Rage} and health with Roar per enemy hit, up to a maximum number of enemies.
stats: +2 Rage Gain On Roar Per Enemy
+15 Health Gain On Roar Per Enemy

26.name: Bringer of Storms
26.desc:
Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred or bleed now depend on shock instead for Maul and Rampage.
stats: Armor Shred And Bleed -> Shock Chance

27.name: Pummel and Bash
27.desc: Maul deals more melee damage to stunned enemies and you regain {Rage} when you hit a stunned enemy with Maul.
stats: +2 Rage Gained With Maul To Stunned

29.name: Ruthless
29.desc: Your {Rage} decays slower while in Werebear Form.

31.name: Skull Crusher
31.desc:
Your {Fury Leap} tree now applies to Maul. 

This consumes Fury Leap's mana cost as Rage.
stats: Consumes Fury Leap's Mana Cost As Rage

32.name: Tremor Slam
32.desc:
After using Maul, you now use {Upheaval} towards your target.

This consumes Upheaval's mana cost.

33.name: Barrage of the Swarm
33.desc:
After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

34.name: Woodland Bear
34.desc:
After using Maul, you now cast {Entangling Roots}.

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost as Rage.

0.name: Warcry
0.desc: Unleash a mighty roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.

2.name: Deep Roar
2.desc: Warcry affects a larger area.

3.name: Battle Cry
3.desc: You and allies affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance for 4 seconds.

4.name: Ferocity
4.desc:
While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you. 

This effect can only happen once per direct Warcry use, and it will reset the cooldown.

5.name: Jormun's Wrath
5.desc:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.

6.name: Frost Claw
6.desc: You and allies affected by Warcry deal increased cold damage for 4 seconds.

7.name: Bringer of Winter
7.desc: You and your cold minions affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance and additional chill chance for 4 seconds.

8.name: Heart of Rime
8.desc: Warcry inflicts stacks of {Frostbite} to affected enemies.

9.name: Frigid Breath
9.desc: Enemies frozen by Warcry take increased damage from hits.

10.name: Debilitating Shout
10.desc: Warcry applies one stack of {Frailty} to affected enemies for a short duration.

11.name: Toxic Companions
11.desc: For 4 seconds after using Warcry, your {Wolves} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and your {Scorpion} has a chance to poison enemies.

12.name: Juggernaut
12.desc: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.

13.name: Breath of Eterra
13.desc:
Warcry now also restores your health. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

14.name: Whirlpool
14.desc:
You now cast {Maelstrom} when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.

15.name: Purging Shout
15.desc: Warcry now cleanses negative ailments on you.

16.name: Invigorate
16.desc:
Warcry now also restores ally health for the same amount as from {Breath of Eterra}. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

17.name: Hastily Advance
17.desc: If Warcry hits at least one enemy, you gain {Haste} for 1 second.

18.name: Energized Charge
18.desc: Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

19.name: Raging Frenzy
19.desc: You gain {Frenzy} for the same duration as you have Haste from {Hastily Advance}.

20.name: Frightful Presence
20.desc: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.

21.name: Horrifying Cry
21.desc: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the {Berserk} buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +2% Damage to Feared per Berserk Stack

22.name: Berserker
22.desc:
You gain the {Berserk} buff for 1.5 seconds when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.

While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.
stats: +1 Berserk Stacks On Hit While Berserk

24.name: Brutality
24.desc: {Berserk} has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.

25.name: Bloodthirst
25.desc: {Berserk} now also affects your Raptor and Bear.

26.name: Fury Strikes
26.desc: {Berserk} now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.

27.name: Staggering Roar
27.desc: Warcry knocks enemies further back.

28.name: Apprehend
28.desc: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.

29.name: Challenging Might
29.desc: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.

30.name: Kinetic Scream
30.desc: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.

31.name: Eviscerating Howl
31.desc: Warcry causes enemies to bleed.

32.name: Shallow Breath
32.desc: Warcry now has a cooldown of 5 seconds which cannot be reduced by stunning or freezing enemies, but Warcry no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.

33.name: Totemic Heart
33.desc: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.

2.name: Canine Agility
2.desc: Your Wolves have additional dodge chance, and have increased dodge rating for each point of strength you have.

3.name: Leap Attack
3.desc: Your Wolves gain a {Leap Attack} to close the gap on distant enemies. Leap Attack has a 10 second cooldown.

4.name: Victory Howl
4.desc: Wolves have a chance to {Howl} on kill. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

5.name: Serrated Claws
5.desc: Wolves have a chance to cause enemies to bleed with their melee attacks.

6.name: Patient Hunters
6.desc: Wolves deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleed they inflict has additional Physical Penetration.

7.name: Snarl
7.desc:
When you kill an enemy one of your Wolves has a chance to {Howl}. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

Howl also grants more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed to all affected allies.

8.name: On the Hunt
8.desc: Wolves have increased attack and move speed.

9.name: Savage Hunters
9.desc: Wolves deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Legendary Bite
10.desc: Your Wolves' melee hits deal more damage, have a greater chance to stun (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has improved base critical strike enemies, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Permanent Bond
11.desc: You have an additional wolf companion at all times. This wolf does not count towards your companion limit.

12.name: Earthborn
12.desc: Wolves have additional armor, and their attacks leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

13.name: Winterborn
13.desc: Wolves have a chance to chill enemies on hit.

14.name: Tundra Stalkers
14.desc: Wolves deal additional cold damage with attacks, and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

16.name: Wolfen Recovery
16.desc: Wolves have additional base health regeneration and increased health regeneration.

17.name: Safety In Numbers
17.desc: You can summon Wolves up to your maximum number of companions.

18.name: Stormborn
18.desc: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit or when they hit an enemy.

19.name: Lupine Endurance
19.desc: Your Wolves have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Storm Caller's Reprisal
20.desc: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit, and deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Cloud Runners
21.desc: Your Wolves deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.name: Storm Jaws
22.desc: Your Wolves' melee attacks deal additional lightning damage.

23.name: Shaman's Bond
23.desc: Your Wolves now deal increase damage and have increased health for each point of Attunement you have.

24.name: Howl of Might
24.desc: Wolves have more damage and dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is tripled for Wolves that have used {Howl} recently.

25.name: Relentless
25.desc: Your Wolves cannot be stunned.

26.name: Battlecry
26.desc: The buffs granted by {Howl} last longer and wolves have a chance to Howl when they hit a rare or boss enemy. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

27.name: Call of the Wind
27.desc: Your Wolves' {Howl} also grant {Haste} for a short duration.

28.name: Crippling Wounds
28.desc: Bleed inflicted by Wolves lasts longer and wolves have a chance to slow on hit and when hit.

29.name: Frozen Fangs
29.desc:
Your Wolves gain the {Ice Bite} ability, which deals higher damage in a larger area, with a 6 second cooldown. 20% of the remaining cooldown is recovered every time the Wolf hits with an ability other than Ice Bite, including their basic attack.

Ice Bite deals melee cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with your wolves' increases to melee and cold damage, but not increases to their physic

30.name: Lone Wolf
30.desc: While you have the additional wolf from {Permanent Bond} summoned, Summon Wolf is replaced with {Howl}, but you cannot have more than one wolf summoned at a time.

2.name: Elementalist
2.desc: Increases your elemental damage

3.name: Reactive Ward
3.desc: When you drop below 70% health you gain a burst of ward based on your maximum health. This effect has a 12 second cooldown.

4.name: Preparation
4.desc: Every 3 seconds, your next elemental spell deals increased damage and has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

5.name: Mage Flurry
bonus: 9% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Teleport
9% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Snap Freeze

6.name: Arcane Current
6.desc: When you hit an enemy with a lightning skill you cast {Lightning Blast} at other enemies within 6 meters of your target. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

7.name: Arcane Flames
7.desc: When you hit an enemy with a fire skill you {Ignite} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

11.name: Essence of Celerity
11.desc: Each stack of {Arcane Momentum} lasts longer and also increases your spell damage.

12.name: Mana Shell
bonus: +1 Ward Per Second Per 10 Max Mana

13.name: Arcane Momentum
13.desc:
When you cast a spell you gain a stack of {Arcane Momentum} for 2 seconds and refreshing the duration of all existing stacks.

Each stacks of Arcane Momentum increases your cast speed.

14.name: Wisdom
bonus: 5% Increased Mana Regen per 100 Max Mana

15.name: Lost Knowledge
15.desc: You gain ward based on your current mana when you directly use a skill that costs at least 40 mana.

20.name: Calculated Destruction
bonus: 3% Increased Spell Critical Strike Chance per Intelligence

22.name: Crackling Precision
22.desc: You have an increased chance to critically strike with spells. This effect is doubled for lightning skills.

24.name: Rune of Winter
24.desc:
Increases your chance to freeze and converts lightning blast and volcanic orb to cold spells, changing their base damage type to cold and giving them a chance to freeze.

Lightning Blast gains a base freeze rate of 46.

Volcanic Orb's core gains a base freeze rate of 40 and its shrapnel gains a freeze rate of 32.

27.name: Mana Bulwark
27.desc: You have additional mana and a portion of the damage you take is dealt to your mana before health.
stats: 2% Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health

28.name: Warder
28.desc:
You have a chance to be granted ward whenever you hit an enemy with a fire, cold, or lightning skill.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire hit and a lightning hit within the same 10 second duration.

29.name: Arcane Current
29.desc: You deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.
bonus: +100% Spark Charge Chance With Static Orb

30.name: Archmage
30.desc:
You have additional spell damage and you have a chance to refund a portion of the mana cost paid when directly using a skill.

These values are doubled if you have 300 maximum mana and tripled if you have 1000 maximum mana.
stats: 7% Chance To Refund 20% Of Mana Cost

32.name: Arcane Warden
32.desc: You gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.
bonus: +1 Ward Decay Threshold Per 10 Max Health

34.name: Elemental Strikes
34.desc: Your fire melee attacks have a chance to ignite on hit. Your cold melee attacks have a chance to chill on hit. Your lightning melee attacks have a chance to shock on hit.
stats: +10% Ignite Chance For Fire Melee Attacks
+10% Chill Chance For Cold Melee Attacks
+10% Shock Chance For Lightning Melee Attacks

35.name: Infused Weapon
35.desc: You have additional melee damage and spell damage.

36.name: Frozen Steel
36.desc: Your melee attacks deal additional cold damage and you have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

37.name: Arcane Shielding
37.desc: You have increased armor and additional health.

38.name: Flame Walker
38.desc:
While moving or using a melee attack, you have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura}. 

This chance is doubled if you have less than 3 stacks of {Fire Aura}.
bonus: +50% Fire Res Shred Chance Per Second

39.name: Warden's Echo
39.desc:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast {Frost Claw}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Frost Claw's} mana cost.

41.name: Mana Reaver
41.desc: You have additional health and you have a chance to regain mana when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

42.name: Incinerating Aura
42.desc: Your {Fire Auras} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.
bonus: +1% Fire Aura Damage Per 1% Uncapped Fire Resistance

43.name: Resonating Aegis
43.desc: Each stack of {Arcane Shielding} also grants increased armor.
bonus: 4 Arcane Shielding Stacks Gained From Surge or Enchant Weapon

44.name: Crackling Aura
bonus: 5 Static Charges Granted from Gaining Fire Aura

45.name: Sun and Storms
45.desc:
You deal increased fire and lightning damage.

You gain ward when you use a lightning skill or a fire skill. This effect has a 7 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire skill and a lightning skill within the same 7 second duration.

46.name: Conjured Armor
46.desc: You have additional armor and gain ward per second.

47.name: Burning Hands
47.desc: You have additional fire resistance and you have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, up to a limited number of times per second.
bonus: 3 Fire Aura Trigger Limit Per Second

48.name: Volka's Razor
48.desc: You have increased movement speed, attack speed, and dodge rating.

49.name: Mental Fortitude
49.desc: You have additional intelligence and endurance.

50.name: Blade Weaver
50.desc:
When you use a melee attack that costs less than 10 mana you gain a stack of {Blade Weaving}, up to a maximum.

When you use a melee attack that costs 10 or more mana the stacks are consumed and the attack deals 15% more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack consumed.

51.name: Prodigy
51.desc: You gain ward per second scaling with your intelligence.

52.name: Blade Conduit
52.desc:
You have additional mana.

When you indirectly cast a spell you gain a stack of {Blade Conduit} for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Each stack grants increased mana regeneration.
stats: 4% Blade Conduit Mana Regen Per Stack
bonus: 1 No Mana Regen Duration After Direct Cast (seconds)

55.name: Sphere of Protection
