55.desc: You have additional health and you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) from ignited, shocked or chilled enemies.
stats: -1% Less Damage Taken from Ignited Shocked or Chilled Enemies

58.name: Arcane Wind
58.desc: When you hit an enemy with a cold skill you {Chill} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

60.name: Afterglow
60.desc: You deal increased spell damage and have additional ward retention.

64.name: Distant Spark
64.desc: When you critically strike an enemy from at least 4 meters away, you have a chance to cast {Spark Nova,} a spell that deals lightning damage to nearby enemies.

66.name: Whirling Snow
66.desc: You have a chance to chill enemies when you are hit, and your skills have a chance to chill enemies on hit. This effect is doubled for cold skills.
stats: 7% Chance To Chill Attackers When Hit

67.name: Elemental Ascendance
stats: 8% Increased Stun Chance With Elemental Spells

69.name: Arcane Insight
69.desc: You have additional Intelligence and you gain additional ward decay threshold scaling with your Intelligence.

70.name: Freezing Aura
70.desc: You deal increased cold damage and have a higher freeze rate multiplier.
bonus: 48 Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second

72.name: Storm Blade
72.desc: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and your lightning melee attacks have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on hit.
stats: 5% Spark Charge Chance with Lightning Melee Attacks

73.name: Molten Edge
73.desc: Your melee hits have a chance to ignite on hit and the ignites they inflict have increased effect.

74.name: Flame Drinker
74.desc: Your melee attacks deal more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if they cost 10 or more mana.
stats: 3% More Elemental Damage with High Cost Melee Attacks
bonus: 3 Mana Gained Per Fire Aura Consumed

75.name: Illusory Combatant
75.desc: You have additional dexterity and intelligence.
bonus: +2 Dodge Rating per 1 Intelligence, up to +100

76.name: Elixir of Knowledge
76.desc: Whenever you use a potion, you gain ward based on to your intelligence.
stats: 1 Ward on Potion Use per Intelligence

77.name: Essence Duel
77.desc: You have increased melee attack speed, and you gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

78.name: Silver Rune
78.desc: Augments the ward gain effects of the {Reactive Ward} and {Sun and Storms} nodes, causing them to grant more ward and have shorter cooldowns.

80.name: Awe Strike
80.desc: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and you have a chance to parry attacks.

81.name: River Blade
stats: 15% Increased Cast Speed with Snap Freeze

82.name: Outrun and Outlast
82.desc: You have additional health and your ward decays more slowly.
bonus: 30% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Surge

84.name: Gemini
84.desc: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +20% Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

86.name: Arcane Focus
stats: +2 Ward Gain on Direct Spell Cast

87.name: Never Late
87.desc: After using a traversal skill, your next non-channeled spell has additional spell damage and a higher chance to critically strike.
bonus: Crit Chance bonus Doubled for 30+ Mana Cost

89.name: Mental Catalysis
89.desc: While using a Catalyst you have additional Intelligence and take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.
stats: -6% Bonus Damage from Crits with a Catalyst

90.name: Nimbus Walk
90.desc: The spell damage and crit chance from the {Never Late} node now also apply to {Traversal} skills, and you gain ward when you use a {Traversal} skill.
stats: 20 Ward Gained on Traversal Skill Use
bonus: Bonuses from Never Late apply to Traversal Skills

91.name: Transcendence
bonus: +24 Additional Ward per Second with 60 Intelligence

92.name: Inscribed Instruments
92.desc: You have additional critical strike multiplier while using a wand, additional ward retention while using a sceptre, and increased cast speed while using a staff.
stats: +8% Critical Strike Multiplier with a Wand

93.name: Decree of the Burning Wind
93.desc: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to Bosses and Rare enemies.
stats: 1% More Damage to Bosses and Rares
bonus: Doubled effect with Rah Rune or Frost Wall

94.name: Decree of the Eternal Tundra
bonus: Doubled Effect with Heo Rune or Glyph of Dominion

95.name: Brand of Deception
95.desc: Your damage over time has additional elemental penetration
stats: +2% Elemental Penetration with Damage Over Time

96.name: Jagged Veil
96.desc:
You gain ward when you critically strike enemies.

This can trigger a maximum of 5 times per second.
bonus: 1% More Crit Multi per 100 Ward vs Bosses

98.name: Runic Fortress
98.desc: You have additional armor while channeling per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.

99.name: Order's Imposition
99.desc: You deal more damage over time to {Branded} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
bonus: +6% Brand of Deception Damage per 1% Shock Chance

100.name: Runeword: Avalanche
100.desc:
When you directly use a Cold Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Avalanche}, a buff that grants additional Spell Cold Damage and grants additional Endurance Threshold per stack of Ignite on the attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.
stats: 20% Runeword: Avalanche chance on Cold Skill use
bonus: +10 Spell Cold Damage with Runeword: Avalanche
+2 Endurance Threshold per Ignite with Runeword: Avalanche

101.name: Celestial Doom
bonus: 100 Ward Gain vs Branded Bosses (1 second cooldown)

104.name: Runeword: Cataclysm
bonus: +15% Damage vs Low Health with Runeword: Cataclysm

105.name: Rune of Dilation
105.desc: After using a {Traversal} skill you gain increased cast speed and movement speed for a short duration. This buff cannot stack.

106.name: Edict of the Scion
106.desc: Your area skills have increased area, and when you directly use an area skill and hit an enemy you gain ward per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.
stats: 2 Ward Per Rune On Area Skill Use And Hit

108.name: Decree of the Bountiful Ocean
bonus: Doubled effect with Gon Rune or Runebolt

109.name: Cerulean Runestones
109.desc: You have additional endurance and maximum mana.

110.name: Runeword: Inferno
110.desc:
When you directly use a Fire Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Inferno}, a buff that grants additional Spell Fire Damage and grants you more Armor per stack of Shock on the Attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.
stats: 20% Runeword: Inferno chance on Fire Skill use
bonus: +10 Spell Fire Damage with Runeword: Inferno
+3% Armor per Shock with Runeword: Inferno

111.name: Sanguine Runestones
bonus: 15% Health Regen also Applies to Ward

112.name: Runeword: Hurricane
112.desc:
When you directly use a Lightning Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Hurricane}, a buff that grants additional Spell Lightning Damage and Freeze Rate Multiplier.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.
stats: 20% Runeword: Hurricane chance on Lightning Skill use
bonus: +10 Spell Lightning Damage with Runeword: Hurricane
+90% Freeze Rate Multiplier with Runeword: Hurricane

114.name: Burden of Knowledge
114.desc: You have additional spell damage, but your spells take longer to cast.

2.name: Higher Plane
2.desc: Arcane Ascendance grants you increased spell damage while active.

3.name: Arcane Absorption
3.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, each hit you take increases your spell damage and cast speed, but drains your mana.

4.name: Power Overload
4.desc: You are granted increased spell damage each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

5.name: Unstable Energy
5.desc: You are granted increased cast speed each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

6.name: Chronoclasm
6.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to slow enemies over 5 meters away and you deal more damage to enemies per stack of slow on them.

7.name: Mana Surge
7.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you are granted mana whenever you kill an enemy that is over 5 meters away.
stats: 6 Mana Gained On Killing Distant Enemy

8.name: Chains of Ice
8.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, whenever you kill a frozen enemy a nearby enemy is frozen for a duration.

9.name: Power Sprint
9.desc: You are granted {Haste} for a duration after leaving Arcane Ascendance. The duration is capped at 200% of the time you spent in Arcane Ascendance.

10.name: Arcane Rift
10.desc: You regain mana while you enter Arcane Ascendance, but the mana is lost when you exit Arcane Ascendance.

11.name: Cosmic Insight
11.desc: Arcane Ascendance has a shorter cooldown.

12.name: Rebuff
12.desc: You gain ward when you activate Arcane Ascendance.

14.name: Frozen Monolith
14.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, your spells and attacks that can freeze enemies have a higher chance to do so.

15.name: Force Of Mind
15.desc: You knock back all nearby enemies when you enter Arcane Ascendance.

16.name: Superconductor
16.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you automatically cast {Lightning Blast} when you hit an enemy. Lightning Blast uses its skill tree and you lose mana equal to Lightning Blast's cost. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

17.name: Closed Circuit
17.desc: Lightning Blast cast by {Superconductor} triggers more frequently.

18.name: Slow Breathing
18.desc: Arcane Ascendance drains less mana per second.

19.name: Tranquility
19.desc: All of your spells cost less mana while Arcane Ascendance is active, but you cannot regenerate mana while Arcane Ascendance is active.

21.name: Cold Front
21.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to chill enemies over 5 meters away.

22.name: Shocking Expanse
22.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to shock enemies over 5 meters away.

23.name: Mark Of Thunder
23.desc: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you {Mark} enemies you hit that are over 5 meters away. When you exit Arcane Ascendance, you consume all marks, dealing lightning damage to affected enemies.

24.name: Acuity
24.desc: Arcane Ascendance now has a 2 second cooldown and no longer drains your mana. You can cast 4 spells before Arcane Ascendance ends automatically. Lasts 12 seconds.

25.name: Cunning
25.desc: You can cast more spells via {Acuity}, but Arcane Ascendance has a longer cooldown.

26.name: Glyph of Lightning
26.desc: {Mark Of Thunder} deals more damage when it is consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Tidal Force
2.desc: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies towards it slower.

3.name: Absolute Zero
3.desc: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.

4.name: Red Giant
4.desc:
Black Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.

5.name: Scorching
5.desc: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.

6.name: Heat Wave
6.desc: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.
stats: +2% Ignite Chance Per Second Per 1% Uncapped Fire Res

7.name: Flaming
7.desc: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Infusion
8.desc: Black Hole grants you ward each second.

9.name: Binary System
9.desc:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. 

Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Umbral Core
10.desc: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Event Horizon
11.desc: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.

12.name: Collapse
12.desc: Black Hole will {Collapse} at the end of its duration, an explosion which deals cold hit damage and knocks enemies back.

13.name: Pulsar
13.desc: Black Hole will {Collapse} each second while it exists, but it deals less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Deep Space
14.desc: The explosions created by the {Collapse} and {Pulsar} nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

15.name: Time Dilation
15.desc: Black Hole has increased duration and a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.

16.name: Cascade Fracture
16.desc: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.

17.name: Recurrence
17.desc: Black Hole's cooldown is reduced and it costs less mana, but pulls enemies towards it slower and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Intensity
18.desc: Black Hole pulls enemies toward it faster and from within an increased area.

20.name: Drifting Singularity
20.desc: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.

21.name: Spacial Dilation
21.desc: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.

22.name: Gravity's Guile
22.desc: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.

23.name: Supermassive
23.desc: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.

24.name: Density
24.desc: Black Hole lasts longer.

25.name: Endless Maw
25.desc: Black Hole lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.

26.name: Scattered
26.desc: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.

27.name: Weakened Reality
27.desc: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.

28.name: Singularity
28.desc: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.

29.name: Armageddon
29.desc: Black Hole casts {Meteor} every second, but consumes Meteor's mana cost every second.

30.name: Pocket Dimension
30.desc: You can store an additional charge of Black Hole.

2.name: Temporal Entrapment
2.desc: Disintegrate has a chance to slow enemies caught within the beam.

4.name: Catalyst
4.desc: Flame Energy builds up more quickly.

5.name: Searing Plasma
5.desc: Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Praesidium
6.desc: You gain ward each second based on your Intelligence while channeling Disintegrate.
stats: +1 Ward Gained Per 3 Int Per Second

7.name: Cascade
7.desc: Your skills recover their cooldowns faster while you are channeling Disintegrate.

8.name: Twinbeam
8.desc:
Disintegrate now has two beams, and each beam deals damage independently, so enemies caught in both take double damage.

Disintegrate costs more mana per second to channel, and each beam deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Stored Power
10.desc: Disintegrate deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a delay before casting. This delay is reduced by increased cast speed.

11.name: Feedback
11.desc: Disintegrate has a chance to shock enemies caught within the beam.

12.name: Electrify
12.desc:
Disintegrate’s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Disintegrate loses the {fire} tag.

13.name: Laser Focus
13.desc: Disintegrate no longer costs mana while channeling, but it also deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Hyperfocal
14.desc: Disintegrate deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your maximum mana.

15.name: Paralyze
15.desc: Shock inflicted by Disintegrate lasts longer and Disintegrate deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Shock on the target.

16.name: Tendrils
16.desc:
You have a chance each second to cast {Lightning Blast} at a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

17.name: Escalation
17.desc: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 2 after 2 seconds of channeling. Tier 2 Disintegrate deals more damage, but costs more mana to channel.

18.name: Amplification
18.desc: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 3 after 4 seconds of channeling. Tier 3 grants double the bonuses of tier 2.

19.name: Unbridled Power
19.desc:
While your Disintegrate is at tier 3 you have a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} and {Spark Charges} on enemies in the beam each second while channeling.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, the {Spark Charges} are converted to {Spreading Flames}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, the {Spreading Flames} is converted to {Spark Charges}.

20.name: Intensify
20.desc: Disintegrate upgrades to the next Tier faster. This also affects the rate at which you gain stacks of {Lucomancer}.

21.name: Glass Cannon
21.desc: Disintegrate deals more damage while at Tier 2, but also causes you to take more damage while at tier 2 (both multiplicative with other modifiers and each other), and these effects are are doubled at Tier 3.

22.name: Magnify
22.desc: Disintegrate gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells on hit as ignite chance per second.
stats: 60% Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second

23.name: Infernal Ray
23.desc:
Disintegrate’s base lightning damage is converted to fire damage, unless you have the {Electrify} node.

Disintegrate loses the {lightning} tag.

24.name: Inferno
24.desc: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

25.name: Extension
25.desc: Disintegrate has a longer range.

26.name: Lucomancer
26.desc:
For every 2 seconds you spend channeling Disintegrate, you gain a stack of {Lucomancer}, up to 2 stacks and each stack lasts 4 seconds. Stacks are refreshed when you gain a new one.

Lucomancer grants global more damage to ignited or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and global reduced mana cost.
stats: +4% Global Damage to Ignited or Shocked Enemies

28.name: Galvanized Defense
28.desc: You take less damage while channeling Disintegrate (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.name: Dragon Tongue
30.desc: Disintegrate deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Intelligence.

32.name: Backfire
32.desc: Flame energy builds up on enemies within the beam, causing an explosion that deals fire damage around them after 3 seconds of taking damage.

34.name: Unleashed Power
34.desc:
Every 3 seconds of channelling Disintegrate, you cast {Static Orb} or {Volcanic Orb}, chosen randomly.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, you always cast {Volcanic Orb}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, you always cast {Static Orb}.

This consumes mana equal to the mana cost of those respective abilities.

35.name: Charge Conduit
35.desc: You gain {Static Charges} each second while channeling Disintegrate.

36.name: Resurgence
36.desc:
If you start channeling Disintegrate while having at least 1 stack of {Lucomancer} it starts at Tier 2.

If you also have the {Amplification} node and at least 2 stacks of {Lucomancer}, Disintegrate starts at Tier 3 instead.
stats: Starts At Tier 3 With 2 Stacks Of Lucomancer

37.name: Flame Vent
37.desc:
When you stop channeling Disintegrate, you cast {Fireball} at nearby enemies twice per second spent channeling, up to a maximum.

This consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

2.name: Ice Nova
2.desc: Enables {Ice Nova}, which has a freeze rate of 40. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

3.name: Glyphs of Winter
3.desc: Elemental Nova has a chance to chill enemies and an increased chance to freeze enemies.

4.name: Freezing Cascade
4.desc: Elemental Nova casts {Freezing Cascade} on hit, creating a cascade of freezing novas that chain between enemies.

5.name: Glacial Might
5.desc: Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Elemental Nova costs more mana.

6.name: Protective Strikes
6.desc: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to grant ward.

7.name: Magical Barrier
7.desc: The {Protective Strikes} and {Survival of the Victor} nodes on this tree grant more ward.

8.name: Lightning Nova
8.desc: Enables {Lightning Nova}, which has +1% critical strike chance compared to other Elemental Nova types. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

9.name: Charged Destruction
9.desc: Elemental Nova hits have an increased critical strike chance.

10.name: Survival of the Victor
10.desc: Elemental Nova kills have a chance to grant ward.

11.name: Arcane Protection
11.desc: You have more ward retention for 4 seconds after killing an enemy with Elemental Nova. You may have only one instance of this buff at once.

12.name: Fire Nova
12.desc: Enables {Fire Nova}, which deals 8% more hit damage than other Elemental Nova types. All Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

13.name: Infernal Prism
13.desc: Elemental Nova hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

14.name: Ash Frenzy
14.desc: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against enemies that are at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Elemental Nova has increased cast speed.
stats: +5% Hit Damage To High Health Enemies

15.name: Arcane Projection
15.desc: Elemental Nova is now cast at a target location instead of around you.

16.name: Infernal Nova
16.desc: Elemental Nova has a significantly larger area of effect when directly cast, and ignites caused by Elemental Nova have increased duration, but Elemental Nova has a 4 second cooldown. The area of effect increase is smaller if Elemental Nova is channeled.

17.name: Conflagrating Speed
17.desc: Elemental Nova has a shorter cooldown.

18.name: Spark Charges
18.desc:
Elemental Nova hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}, which deals lightning damage to nearby enemies after 1 second or when the enemy dies.

Additionally, Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Immolation
19.desc: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to Ignite enemies.

20.name: Flame Battery
20.desc: You can store an additional charge of Elemental Nova.

21.name: Elemental Expanse
21.desc: Elemental Nova has a larger area of effect.

22.name: Overcharge
22.desc: Elemental Novas have a chance to be {Overcharged}. Overcharged Novas shock enemies and have a larger area of effect.

23.name: Overload
23.desc: {Overcharged} Elemental Novas deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased stun chance.

24.name: Elemental Tranquillity
24.desc:
{Ice Nova} has a higher chance to Freeze enemies.

{Lightning Nova} has a chance to Shock enemies.

{Fire Nova} has a chance to Ignite enemies.

25.name: Cryomantic Fragility
25.desc: Elemental Nova costs less mana, but you take increased cold damage if you have cast Elemental Nova recently (past 4 seconds).

26.name: Arcana Elementorum
26.desc: Elemental Nova deals more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a slightly larger area of effect. These effects are doubled when it is directly cast.

27.name: Melting Nova
27.desc: Elemental Nova has a chance to shred armour on hit and has increased critical strike chance.

28.name: Luminaire
28.desc: Elemental Nova becomes a channeled ability, unleashing 5 novas per second, and rapidly draining your mana. Elemental Nova has a smaller area of effect (multiplicative with other area modifiers).

29.name: Star Prism
29.desc: Elemental Nova costs less mana per second to channel

30.name: Silenced Spark
30.desc:
You have additional lightning resistance while channeling, but Lightning Nova is disabled.

If you have not taken the {Fire Nova} or {Ice Nova} nodes, then this node re-enables basic Elemental Nova.

32.name: Shatter Nova
32.desc: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against chilled enemies, frozen enemies, shocked enemies, and ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

34.name: Fiery Destruction
34.desc: Elemental Nova critical strikes deal more damage.

0.name: Firebrand
0.desc: A melee attack which grants you a stack of firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.

1.name: Searing Brand
1.desc: Firebrand deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Charring
2.desc: Firebrand deals more melee damage per stack of Firebrand (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Triple Strike
3.desc: Firebrand now shoots three lines instead of one in a cone in front of you, but costs more mana.

4.name: Hypothermia
4.desc: Using {Shatter Strike} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain {Frostbite} Chance per stack consumed.

5.name: Kindling
5.desc: Firebrand has increased melee critical strike chance per stack of Firebrand.
stats: 10% Increased Melee Crit Chance Per Stack

6.name: Inflame
6.desc: Firebrand has additional melee critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

7.name: Incineration
7.desc: Your next melee attack, that is not Firebrand, consumes all stacks of Firebrand and deals more damage per stack consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Illuminating Fire
8.desc: Consuming stacks of Firebrand with {Incineration} grants bonus critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier per stack.

9.name: Wildfire
9.desc: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks.

10.name: Insulation
10.desc: Firebrand grants additional armor and fire resistance per stack of Firebrand.

11.name: Galvanize
11.desc:
Firebrands's base fire damage and added melee fire damage from stacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to shock chance and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps Firebrand's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

12.name: Excitation
12.desc: While you have at least 1 stack of Firebrand, your next cast of {Lightning Blast} will consume all stacks to chain additional times per stack consumed.
stats: 2 Lightning Blast Chains per Firebrand Stack Consumed

13.name: Electrostatic
13.desc: Gain stacks of {Static} if Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

14.name: Pyroshielding
14.desc: You gain ward when Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

15.name: Warding Flames
15.desc: You gain ward per second per stack of Firebrand.

16.name: Undying Fire
16.desc: Stacks of Firebrand last longer.

17.name: Everflames
17.desc: You refresh the duration of all stacks of Firebrand when gaining a new stack.

18.name: Ardent Branding
18.desc: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks and deals more damage per stack, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Fulmination
19.desc: Firebrand attacks faster per stack of Firebrand, up to a maximum.

20.name: Brand of Arcanus
20.desc: Stacks of Firebrand now also grant added spell fire damage.

21.name: Arcane Sharpshooter
21.desc: Firebrand grants global spell critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

22.name: Pyre
22.desc: If Firebrand hits at least one enemy, it consumes mana to cast {Flame Wave}, a spell that deals fire damage in a line.

23.name: Flare
23.desc: Firebrand has a chance to ignite enemies.

24.name: Inferno
24.desc:
Firebrand has a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} when hitting an ignited enemy.

Stacks of Firebrand also grant more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against enemies afflicted by Spreading Flames.
stats: +2% More Fire Damage Per Stack vs Spreading Flames

25.name: Crossfire
25.desc: Each stack of Firebrand grants you global Ignite Chance.

26.name: Exothermic
26.desc: Using {Flame Reave} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain {Ignite} Chance per stack consumed.

27.name: Conflagrate
27.desc: You gain an additional stack of Firebrand when attacking, but Firebrand costs more mana.

28.name: Fading Flame
28.desc: You gain ward when a stack of Firebrand expires or is consumed.
stats: 15 Ward Per Stack Consumed or Expired

30.name: Heat Wave
30.desc: Directly using Firebrand has a chance to grant a stack of Fire Aura based on your current Firebrand stacks. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per second.
stats: +5% Fire Aura Chance per Firebrand Stack

1.name: Arcanist
1.desc: Runebolt has increased cast speed and it has a chance to grant you the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

2.name: Cryomantic Bolt
2.desc: Runebolt deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Frost Spikes
3.desc:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

4.name: Ice Shard
4.desc:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

5.name: Fulminating Bolt
5.desc: Runebolt deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Lightning Spear
6.desc:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to chill now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the {Cold Bolt's} {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

7.name: Jolting Spark
7.desc:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

8.name: Pyromantic Bolt
8.desc: Runebolt deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Blazing Flare
9.desc:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

10.name: Searing Dart
10.desc:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

{Frostbite} chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to {Frostbite} now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the {Cold Bolt's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

11.name: Efficient Experiment
11.desc:
Runebolt now randomly selects the element with each cast rather than by combo order. 

Directly casting Rune Bolt now has a chance to double cast if the previous cast was a different type. The chance is based on the amount of {Glyph of Chaos} you have in your crafting inventory.
stats: 1% Chance to Double Cast Per 5 Glyph of Chaos

12.name: Arcane Overcharge
12.desc: Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.

13.name: Supercharged Bolt
13.desc: Runebolt's chance to shoot extra projectiles from the {Arcane Overcharge} node and the amount of projectiles are doubled while standing in a {Glyph of Dominion}.

14.name: Runic Evocation
14.desc: Runebolt now shoots in a cone and the projectiles seek out enemies.

15.name: Attuned Recovery
15.desc: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you health if it was a {Fire Bolt}, ward if it was a {Lightning Bolt} and mana if it was a {Cold Bolt}.

16.name: Amplified Cascade
16.desc:
If your last three direct casts were all Runebolt, then any further cast of it becomes tri-elemental (fire, lightning and cold). Tri-elemental Runebolt deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and applies all the effects of the {Attuned Recovery} node.

Once you directly cast another skill, Runebolt loses all of these effects.

17.name: Inscription of Momentum
17.desc: When Runebolt passes through a {Frost Wall} it is intensified dealing more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gains increased projectile speed.

18.name: Punch Through Metal
18.desc: Runebolt hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

19.name: Kinetic Breach
19.desc: Runebolt deals additional physical damage per point of strength of you or your nearby ally with the highest amount of strength.
stats: +1 Physical Spell Damage per Strength from Nearby Ally

20.name: Runestone
20.desc:
Directly casting Runebolt now creates a {Runestone} in front of you if you do not currently have one nearby instead of casting a Runebolt. If you have a nearby {Runestone}, directly using Runebolt now casts two bolts from the {Runestone} towards the target.  

After several seconds {Runestone} consumes mana to explode.
stats: Runestone On Cast Instead Of Runebolt

21.name: Awakened Runestone
21.desc: Every second while channeling a skill, your nearest {Runestone} has a chance to cast Runebolt towards your target.

22.name: Devastator
22.desc: Runebolt now explodes when it reaches its target location or when hitting enemies or obstacles, dealing damage of the corresponding element in an area.

23.name: Wrecking Ball
23.desc: The explosion from {Devastator} deals damage in a larger area per uncapped resistance of the corresponding element.

24.name: Arcane Restoration
24.desc: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.

25.name: Runeweaver
25.desc: Casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Runeweave} up to a maximum.

26.name: Dissolve and Conquer
26.desc: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants you more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of armor shred on the target up to a maximum.
stats: +0.5% Elemental Damage per stack of Armor Shred
7% Maximum Damage Boost per stack of Runeweave

27.name: Cosmic Tapestry
27.desc: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants your {Runic Invocation} additional critical strike chance.
stats: +1% Runic Invocation Crit Chance per stack

28.name: Orderly Conduit
28.desc:
Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique {Rune} you have. Multiple {Runes} of the same type does not stack the effect.

{Rah Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
{Gon Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
{Heo Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on enemies.

29.name: Torrent of Evocation
29.desc: Runebolt's combo is now cast in a reversed order.
stats: Reverses order of Rune Bolt Combo

30.name: Focused Runewords
30.desc: Casting Runebolt now randomizes the runes of your {Runic Invocation}.
stats: Runic Invocation Runes Randomization on Cast

31.name: Echomancy
31.desc: Runebolt is now cast in a sequence with the same order of your most recent {Runic Invocation}
stats: Rune Bolt Sequence as Recent Runic Invocation

32.name: Imbued Runestone
32.desc:
If you have 3 {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} when you create a {Runestone}, the {Runes} are consumed to instead create an {Imbued Runestone} that fires three bolts. An {Imbued Runestone's} explosion has 100% more area of effect and damage.

This effect has a 20 second cooldown. When you cast {Runic Invocation} the remaining cooldown is reduced by 20% per {Rune} in the {Invocation}.

2.name: Piercing Heat
2.desc: Fireball now pierces enemies (continue through targets it hits), but costs more mana.

3.name: Immolated Core
3.desc: Fireball hits have additional fire penetration and lightning penetration.

4.name: Orb of Destruction
4.desc: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance.

5.name: Plasma Ball
5.desc:
Half of Fireball's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this portion of its damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fireball gains a {Lightning} tag.

Fireball also gains additional critical strike multiplier.

6.name: Winged Fire
6.desc: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and travels faster, causing it to travel farther.

7.name: Fire Spray
7.desc: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

8.name: Skira's Gambit
8.desc: Fireball has additional critical strike chance, but it has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Arcane Divergence
9.desc: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

10.name: Igneous Force
10.desc: Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.

11.name: Embers
11.desc: Directly cast Fireballs fire in sequence in the same direction and can now hit the same target, but Fireball releases fewer projectiles and has less cast speed for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target

12.name: Dancing Fire
12.desc: Fireball releases additional projectiles. These additional projectiles are NOT reduced by the extra projectiles penalty via the {Embers} node.

13.name: Conflagration
13.desc: Fireball hits have a higher chance to ignite enemies.

14.name: Spreading Inferno
14.desc:
Fireball hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}, an ailment which deals fire damage over time and spreads to nearby enemies.

Additionally all damage over time ailments applied by Fireball deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifier).

15.name: Wildfire
15.desc: {Spreading Flames} applied by fireball has additional fire penetration

16.name: Burning Wounds
16.desc: Fireball hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 25% More Crit Chance Against Ignited Enemies

17.name: Adept
17.desc: Fireball has increased cast speed.

18.name: Flammability
18.desc: Fireball hits have a chance to reduce enemy fire resistance.

19.name: Seeker's Ash
19.desc: Fireballs now seek nearby targets.

20.name: Flame Burst
20.desc: Hitting the same enemy with several fireballs triggers a {Flame Burst} around them.

21.name: Volatile flames
21.desc: Flame Burst requires fewer hits with Fireball to trigger.

22.name: Mana Sphere
22.desc: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

23.name: Unchained Fire
23.desc: Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.

24.name: Flamethrower
24.desc: Fireball becomes a channelled ability that rapidly spews fireballs from your hand, but rapidly drains your mana. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

25.name: Forbidden Flames
25.desc: Fireballs have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets it hits), but {Flamethrower} costs more mana per second to channel.

26.name: Eternal Fire
26.desc: {Flamethrower} costs less mana per second to channel.

27.name: Magma Shell
27.desc: You have additional Armor and Fire Resistance while channeling Fireball's {Flamethrower}.

28.name: Infernal Legacy
28.desc: Fireballs last longer, causing them to travel further.

2.name: Blazing Flux
2.desc: Flame Rush costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown. These effects are doubled if you have enough uncapped fire resistance.

3.name: Manafused Current
3.desc: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 40 current mana.

4.name: Glyph of Intention
4.desc:
Flame Rush now casts {Glyph of Dominion} at the target location instead of channeling and Flame Rush ends when reaching the Glyph.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Glyph of Dominion's} mana cost.
stats: Glyph of Dominion At Target Location

5.name: Magma Starter
5.desc:
Flame Rush now casts {Volcanic Orb} that is attached to you and only detonates when you end Flame Rush, alongside any other active {Volcanic Orbs}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volcanic Orb's} mana cost.

6.name: Runic Eclipse
6.desc:
You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) during Flame Rush.

This effect is doubled against damage over time effects.

7.name: Celestial Guidance
7.desc: All buff effects from the Flame Rush tree persist afterwards for a portion of the time equal to the duration you spent in Flame Rush.
stats: 15% Buff Duration Equal To Time In Flame Rush

8.name: Lunar Protection
8.desc: You gain ward per second during Flame Rush and you gain a burst of ward when Flame Rush ends.

9.name: Energy Equivalence
9.desc:
{Flame Rush's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

{Fire Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Lightning Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Fire Shred now depend on Lightning Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

10.name: Beta Decay
10.desc:
Flame Rush now also casts a {Static Orb} in the opposite direction.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Static Orb's} mana cost.

11.name: Snowballing
11.desc:
{Flame Rush's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Lightning Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Cold Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Lightning Shred now depend on Cold Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

13.name: Branding Cold
13.desc: Flame Rush now inflicts {Brand of Subjugation} to enemies you pass through. The Brand does not stack but deals a large amount of cold damage over time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per your chance to chill.
stats: Brand of Subjugation On Pass Through
+2% Brand of Subjugation Damage Per 1% Chill Chance

14.name: Fiery Overload
14.desc: You are granted the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration when you end Flame Rush.

15.name: Epilogue
15.desc:
You cast {Runic Invocation} when you exit Flame Rush, if you have it on your action bar.

This effect consumes mana equal to a percentage of {Runic Invocation's} mana cost.

16.name: Guidance of Flames
16.desc: Casting {Fireball} and then using Flame Rush in the same direction within 2 seconds causes that Flame Rush to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and grants you mana on cast.
stats: Flame Rush Buff In Fireball Direction

17.name: Breath of Fire
17.desc: Whenever you hit an enemy with {Fireball} during Flame Rush it causes a {Runic Burst} around the target.
stats: Runic Burst On Fireball During Rush

18.name: Smolder and Burn
18.desc: Flame Rush now applies {Fire Resistance Shred} on enemies it passes through.
stats: +1 Fire Shred Stacks On Pass Through

19.name: Fire Eater
19.desc:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy you gain ward and consume all your ignite stacks on that enemy. 

Consuming your ignite stacks this way grants you ward per your ignite stack on them, but they don't deal their remaining damage.
stats: +24 Ignited Enemy Ward Gain On Pass Through
+12 Ward Gain Per Ignite On Pass Through

20.name: Mark of the Forbidden Flame
20.desc:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy with Flame Rush, instead of gaining ward per stack of ignite on the enemy and consuming your ignite stacks without dealing damage, you lose 12 ward per stack of ignite and the ignite stacks instantly deal their remaining damage on the enemy.

If you do not have enough ward for this effect, a percentage of your remaining health is consumed instead, up to a
stats: 1% % Of Current Health Consumed Per Ignite Without Ward

21.name: Solar Rush
21.desc: You travel faster and further with Flame Rush.

22.name: Blazeborn
22.desc: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

23.name: Gas Powered
23.desc: Whenever you pass through a {Frost Wall} during Flame Rush it causes the explosion to deal damage in a much larger area and its chance to critically hit is doubled.

24.name: Ember Wake
24.desc: Every 0.4 seconds during Flame Rush you create a {Rune Ember}, up to a maximum. Every 0.25 seconds while not in Flame Rush you fire a {Rune Ember} at a nearby enemy if you have any.
stats: Fire Rune Embers While Not In Flame Rush

25.name: Flaring Coals
25.desc: {Rune Embers} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Living Embers
26.desc: Casting Flame Rush creates additional {Rune Embers}.

27.name: Keen Ignition
27.desc: {Rune Embers} now pierce enemies.

28.name: Signet of Ash
28.desc: You now have a chance to create a {Rune Ember} on kill during Flame Rush and you create {Rune Embers} faster during Flame Rush.
stats: +25% Rune Ember Frequency During Flame Rush

1.name: Biting Limit
1.desc: Frost Wall has a chance to inflict a stack of Frostbite to enemies inside the wall every 0.25 seconds.

2.name: Lightning Rod
2.desc:
One of Frost Wall's {Pillars} now casts {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies when you first pass through the wall.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

3.name: Charged Pylons
3.desc:
Frost Wall's outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies every other second.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

4.name: Amplified Currents
4.desc: After Frost Wall has existed for a short duration, its outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} more often, up to a maximum, every time an enemy passes through the wall.

5.name: Aspirant's Arrival
5.desc:
After you pass through your Frost Wall your next {Runic Invocation} or {Glyph of Dominion} cast within 5 seconds is empowered. 

An empowered spell cast this way, costs less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second the wall has existed, before you walk through it.

6.name: Purifying Gate
6.desc: Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.
stats: Cleanses Negative Ailments On Pass Through

7.name: Arch of Rimefrost
7.desc: Frost Wall deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

8.name: Crystals of Protection
8.desc:
Frost Wall now grants you and your allies ward and mana when they first pass through the wall.

These effects are doubled if the wall is placed at least 2 meters away from you.

9.name: Boosted Kickoff
9.desc:
Frost Wall now grants the {Haste} and {Frenzy} buffs for a short duration, up to a maximum, when you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

The maximum duration is equal to Frost Wall's age plus 1 second.

10.name: Runic Conclusion
10.desc: Frost Wall now creates three {Runic Detonations} shortly after you pass through it, dealing spell cold damage to nearby enemies.

11.name: Shattered to Pieces
11.desc: The {Runic Detonations} from {Runic Conclusion} intensify, destroying the wall in the process and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

12.name: Glyph of Direfrost
12.desc: The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

13.name: Prepared Wards
13.desc:
You now cast Flame Ward on you or your allies (excluding their minions) that pass through your Frost Wall, if it has existed for at least 0.2 seconds.

Frost Wall now has a cooldown, which it shares with Flame Ward. Using one will put the other on cooldown.
stats: Flame Ward On Ally Pass Through

14.name: Heaping Cold
14.desc: If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Marching Winter
15.desc: Frost Wall is larger and lasts longer.

16.name: Chilled Touch
16.desc: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled enemies while you have an active Frost Wall.

17.name: The Dark Cold
17.desc:
Frost Wall deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the wall has existed.

This does not affect ailments or subskills.
stats: +3% Damage Over Time Per Second Of Existence

18.name: Howling Rift
18.desc: When you cast Frost Wall while having an existing wall active with more than half its duration remaining, the existing wall is moved to the new target location instead of being replaced and you gain mana equal to half the Frost Wall’s mana cost.

19.name: Frigid Domination
19.desc: Frost Wall deals additional spell damage equal to a portion of your freeze rate multiplier.
stats: +1 Spell Damage Per 20% Freeze Rate Multiplier

20.name: Frozen Throne
20.desc:
Frost Wall's initial freeze has increased duration, and the wall deals more damage over time to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

21.name: Protection of the Apostate
21.desc: You are granted ward whenever enemies pass through the wall for the first time.
stats: 5 Ward Gain On Enemy Pass Through

22.name: Shelter of the Chef
22.desc: Whenever an enemy passes through the wall for the first time, and after it has existed for 0.2 seconds, you gain ward equal to a small portion of the enemy's maximum health, up to a maximum amount of ward per enemy.

23.name: Pyroglass
23.desc:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Ignite}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Fire Resistance Shred}.

Swaps {Frost Wall's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

24.name: Brand the Invaders
24.desc:
Frost Wall now inflicts Brand of Trespass to enemies inside the wall. This Brand does not stack, but deals a large amount of fire damage over time.

Brand of Trespass deals more damage equal to your ignite chance.
stats: Brand of Trespass On Enemy Pass Through

25.name: Flames Unchained
25.desc:
Whenever an enemy passes through your Frost Wall, you have a chance to cast {Fireball} towards them.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.
stats: 15% Fireball Chance On Enemy Pass Through

26.name: Crackling Barrier
26.desc:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Slow}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock}.

Swaps Frost Wall's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

27.name: Wall of Glyptic Art
27.desc:
Frost Wall now casts {Runebolt} in the original target direction the Wall was cast. The element of the bolts match the element of the Wall, regardless of {Runebolt's} tree.

This effect consumes 2 mana per projectile and does not cast if you are at negative mana.

28.name: Arcane Mosaic
28.desc: Frost Wall casts {Runebolt} more often.

2.name: Dancing Flames
2.desc: Flame Reave has increased attack speed and costs less mana, but travels more slowly, reducing its range.

3.name: Rhythm of Fire
3.desc: Using Flame Reave grants 4 stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}. If you already have 12 stacks, Flame Reave instead consumes all the stacks to gain significantly more width, range, and damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Versatility
4.desc:
Directly using Surge, Fireball, Mana Strike, or Firebrand also grants stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}.

These skills cannot consume stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} and you cannot exceed the number of stacks required for Flame Reave to consume stacks, which is 12 by default.

5.name: Engulfing Flames
5.desc:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Frenzied Flame
6.desc:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

In addition to Frenzy's base effect it now grants Flame Reave additional melee fire damage.
stats: +8 Flame Reave Fire Damage during Frenzy

7.name: Naurcrist
7.desc: Flame Reave hits deal additional melee fire damage per equipped sword.

8.name: Rolling Thunder
8.desc:
Half of Flame Reave's base damage is converted to lightning, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to lightning damage but not with increases to fire damage.

Fire damage bonuses from this tree now also apply to Lightning.

Ignite chance from this tree now also grants an equal amount of shock chance.

Flame Reave gains a {Lightning} tag.
stats: Fire Damage modifiers on tree also apply to Lightning Damage
Ignite Chance from tree also grants Shock Chance

9.name: Heat Wave
9.desc: Flame Reave deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

10.name: Scorched Earth
10.desc: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Fireball} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Fireball's mana cost.
stats: Fireball on Kill or Boss or Rare Hit

11.name: Thermopile
11.desc: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Lightning Blast} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Lightning Blast's mana cost.
stats: Lightning Blast on Kill or Rare or Boss Hit

12.name: Arcane Severance
12.desc: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it deals added melee damage based on your added spell damage.

13.name: Ember Infusion
13.desc: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Catalyst of Ash
14.desc: When you directly cast Flame Reave and consume {Rhythm of Fire}, you cast {Elemental Nova} with more area and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect consumes a percentage of Elemental Nova's mana cost.

16.name: Reflash
16.desc: Flame Reave now has a cooldown, but it expands and returns a second time. This can hit the same enemy two additional times.

17.name: Kindling
17.desc: Flame Reave can store an additional charge and has increased cooldown recovery rate, but it also has additional mana cost.

18.name: Flame Caller
18.desc: Flame Reave returns to you. This can hit the same enemy again.

19.name: Infernal Calling
19.desc: Each time Flame Reave returns, it pulls enemies to you and grants you {Haste} for a duration.

20.name: Precise Destruction
20.desc: Flame Reave has additional critical strike chance, but deals damage in a narrower area.

21.name: Infernal Alchemy
21.desc: When you attack with Flame Reave and critically strike at least one enemy you gain ward.

22.name: Slash and Burn
22.desc: Flame Reave hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

23.name: Scorching Tide
23.desc: Flame Reave hits deal more melee damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Chaos Flare
24.desc: Flame Reave melee hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Rolling Flames
25.desc: Flame Reave travels faster, increasing its range.

26.name: Ashen Waste
26.desc: Flame Reave's critical strikes deal more damage.

27.name: Unbound Flames
27.desc: Flame Reave deals damage in a larger area.

28.name: Worldfire
28.desc: Flame Reave hits enemies in an expanding circle centered on you, but has less range and costs significantly more mana.

29.name: Lingering Embers
29.desc:
You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you directly use Flame Reave. Flame Reave has additional chance to Ignite on hit per active Fire Aura.

These effects are tripled if Flame Reave has a cooldown.

30.name: Accelerando
30.desc:
Flame Reave requires fewer stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} to consume all stacks. This does not affect the bonuses from consuming stacks.

Additionally when Flame Reave consumes {Rhythm of Fire} stacks it gains additional critical strike chance.

1.name: Rending Cascade
1.desc: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze enemies and a higher chance to critically strike.

2.name: Glamdring
2.desc: Frost Claw deals additional spell damage based on your added melee damage.

3.name: Cold Star
3.desc: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its explosion deals damage in a larger area. These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 1200 ward.

4.name: Gift of Winter
4.desc: Directly casting Frost Claw costs less mana and you have a chance to regain mana when you cast it.
stats: 12% Chance to gain 12 mana on Direct Cast

5.name: Lava Talon
5.desc:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Chill chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

6.name: Spark Artillery
6.desc:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to lightning, unless it has already been converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

7.name: Fen of the Frozen
7.desc: Frost Claw hits have a chance to {Slow} and {Chill}.

8.name: Brightfrost
8.desc: You have increased cast speed with Frost Claw.

9.name: Artor's Sceptre
9.desc: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

10.name: Frost Beyond Time
10.desc: Frostbite, chill, slow, ignite, and shock inflicted by Frost Claw last longer.

11.name: Celestial Conflux
11.desc:
You have a chance to cast {Elemental Nova} when Frost Claw's projectiles reach the target.

This consumes mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

12.name: Cold and Calculating
12.desc: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze based on its critical strike chance.
stats: +5% Freeze Rate Multiplier per 1% Crit Chance

13.name: Kolheim Ballista
13.desc: If you have an active {Ice Barrage} when you hit an enemy with Frost Claw, that Ice Barrage fires faster for the rest of its duration, up to a maximum.
stats: +4% Ice Barrage Rate of Fire on Hit

14.name: Power Word: Hail
14.desc:
You have a chance to cast {Ice Barrage} in the target direction when you cast Frost Claw.

This consumes mana equal to Ice Barrage's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

16.name: Shiver Shell
16.desc:
When you are hit by an enemy you have a chance to retaliate with Frost Claw.

When you cast Frost Claw by any method you gain Ward.

17.name: Reowyn's Veil
17.desc: When you cast Frost Claw you gain ward based on its Freeze Rate Multiplier.

18.name: Macuahuitl
18.desc:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast Frost Claw towards it, or at another nearby enemy if the hit killed the original target.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of Frost Claw's mana cost.
stats: 10% Chance To Cast On Melee Hit

20.name: Frozen Sleeper
20.desc: Gain a stack of Frozen Sleeper every second up to a maximum. When you cast Frost Claw it consumes all stacks to gain cold penetration per stack and release an {Ice Spiral} for each stack.

21.name: Chaos Whirl
21.desc: When you cast {Ice Spirals} there is a chance that the number of projectiles will be doubled and they'll all deal double damage.

22.name: Age of Vengeance
22.desc: For each active {Ice Spiral}, Glacier gains increased area and additional cold penetration, and Snap Freeze gains increased area and freeze duration.
stats: +12% Glacier Cold Penetration per Ice Spiral
+16% Snap Freeze Area per Ice Spiral
+4% Snap Freeze Freeze Duration per Ice Spiral

24.name: On Through The Snow
24.desc:
Directly casting Frost Claw causes it to recast from the target location to a location 4 meters behind it. The second can hit the same enemies as the first cast.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

25.name: Ever Onward
25.desc:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} causes a third cast. The third cast can hit the same enemies as the first and second casts.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

26.name: Frozen Malice
26.desc:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} targets a random enemy that is 3 to 9 meters away from the original target location.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

27.name: A Crack in the Ice
27.desc:
When the second cast from {On Through The Snow} is released, Frost Claw is also cast back towards you.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased.

28.name: Hand of Morditas
28.desc:
Frost Claw has 2 additional projectiles allowing it to hit enemies in a wider area on the way to the target.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

29.name: Volley of Glass
29.desc:
Frost Claw no longer creates a burst of damage at the target, but its projectiles are now staggered and they can all hit the same target.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased, it no longer has the {Area} tag and it has a lowered base freeze rate.

30.name: Frozen Reign
30.desc: Frost Claw has a lower mana cost and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to frozen enemies, but its projectiles are slower.

32.name: Spark of Celerity
32.desc: Frost Claw's projectiles are faster and it costs less mana.

2.name: Infusion
2.desc:
Flame Ward grants increased fire damage while active

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this damage increase is also converted.

3.name: Retribution
3.desc: Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Telepyrosis
4.desc: Flame Ward's retaliation is centered on the enemy that hits you, but it hits in a smaller area.

5.name: Blast Field
5.desc: Flame Ward's retaliation hits in a larger area.

6.name: Frost Ward
6.desc:
Flame Ward is converted to Cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, granting it a freeze rate, and converts any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to cold and grants it a Freeze Rate.
stats: 48 Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second

7.name: Frostguard
7.desc: Flame Ward grants armor while active.

8.name: Glacial Reinforcement
8.desc: Flame Ward grants additional block chance, block effectiveness, and ward on block while active.

9.name: Rimeskin
9.desc: Flame Ward's retaliation hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

10.name: Lightning Ward
10.desc:
Flame Ward is converted to Lightning, unless it has been converted to cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, and any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to lightning, unless it has been converted to cold.

11.name: Dilation
11.desc: Flame Ward costs less mana. Flame Ward and Fire Aura last longer.

12.name: Fire Aura
12.desc: While active, Flame Ward grants you {Fire Aura}, a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

13.name: Eye of Flame
13.desc: {Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This also effects Fire Aura from sources other than Flame Ward.

14.name: Energize
14.desc: Flame Ward grants ward over time while active.

15.name: Recollection
15.desc: Flame Ward grants increased ward retention while active.

16.name: Through Flames
16.desc:
Flame Ward grants additional fire damage to attacks and spells while active.

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this added damage is also converted.

17.name: Stalwart Defense
17.desc: Flame Ward grants additional ward.

18.name: Barrier
18.desc: You take less damage from hits while Flame Ward is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Prismatic Buffer
19.desc: Flame Ward reduces elemental damage taken while active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Selfless Sorcery
20.desc:
Flame Ward can be cast on allies.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Mental Aegis} node.

21.name: Shrewd Shielding
21.desc: Flame Ward costs less mana.

22.name: Mental Aegis
22.desc: Mana now absorbs damage while Flame Ward is active. Each point of mana shields 5 health and ward.

23.name: Warmth
23.desc: Flame Ward grants increased mana regeneration while active.

25.name: Concentrated Shielding
25.desc: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.

27.name: Fortification
27.desc: Flame Ward grants significantly more ward, but no longer retaliates.

28.name: Desperate Defense
28.desc: Flame Ward grants additional ward equal to a percentage of your missing health.
stats: 12% Percent Of Missing Health Granted As Ward

29.name: Fuel The Flames
29.desc: Flame Ward grants more ward, but has a longer cooldown.

30.name: Dual Aegis
30.desc: Flame Ward can store an additional charge, allowing you to use it twice before it goes on cooldown.

31.name: Astonish
31.desc: Flame Ward is cast when you are stunned, if it is off cooldown and you have positive mana.

33.name: Flame Runner
33.desc: You have {Haste} while Flame Ward is active.

34.name: Warden Pulse
34.desc: Enemies around you are knocked back when you use Flame Ward

2.name: Chilling Force
2.desc: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to chill enemies.

3.name: Lesser Destruction
3.desc: Glacier’s smallest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Moderate Destruction
4.desc: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.desc: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Lesser Chilling
6.desc: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to chill enemies.

7.name: Moderate Chilling
7.desc: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

8.name: Greater Chilling
8.desc: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

9.name: Lesser Vortex
9.desc: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.

10.name: Moderate Vortex
10.desc: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased duration.

11.name: Greater Vortex
11.desc: Glacier’s largest explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased effect.

12.name: Whirlpools
12.desc: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.

13.name: Rime Caster
13.desc: When you cast Glacier you gain the {Rime} buff which increases your damage over time and freeze rate multiplier.

14.name: Lesser Glacier
14.desc: Glacier costs less mana, but the largest explosion is disabled.

15.name: Cold Snap
15.desc: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Glacier costs more mana.

16.name: Frost Grip
16.desc: Glacier has an increased chance to freeze and stun enemies.

17.name: Critical Rejuvenation
17.desc: Critical hits with Glacier grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, up to a limited number of times per second.

18.name: Cold Victory
18.desc: Glacier kills grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.
stats: 1% Percent Of Maximum Mana Gained On Kill

19.name: Fading Echoes
19.desc: Glacier’s explosions occur in reverse order.

20.name: Resplendent Frost
20.desc: Greatly improves Glacier’s base critical strike chance, but reduces its critical strike multiplier.

21.name: Static Collapse
21.desc: All of Glacier’s explosions occur at a target location, but Glacier's critical hits no longer deal extra damage (compared to non-critical hits).

22.name: Perma Frost
22.desc: Glacier has a higher chance to freeze enemies, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Breaking Point
24.desc: Glacier costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Engulfing Vortex
25.desc: {Ice Vortices} created by Glacier have a chance to instead become a {Greater Ice Vortex} that deals significantly more damage and has a larger radius.

26.name: Morditas' Bane
26.desc: Glacier deals more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +25% Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

27.name: Endless Frost
27.desc: Chill chance granted by this tree is doubled. Glacier hits deal more damage to chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.name: Critical Barrier
28.desc: You gain ward on critical strikes with Glacier.

30.name: Snow Blink
30.desc:
When you directly cast Glacier you are teleported to the target location, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Glacier also gains a cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
stats: Does not use the Teleport Skill or Tree

1.name: Herald of Domination
1.desc: The {Glyph} explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

2.name: Astromage
2.desc: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

3.name: Astral Extension
3.desc: You can now place down up to two Glyphs of Dominion, but Glyph of Dominion costs more mana. When the first {Glyph} explodes the second one does too. The second explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the further it is from the first one up to a maximum.
stats: +10% Second Glyph Damage Per 1 Meter Distance

4.name: Careful Drawings
4.desc: Glyph of Dominion expands slower and lasts a longer (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This increases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

5.name: Runecarver's Domain
5.desc: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

6.name: Attuned Shapes
6.desc: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) per amount of missing mana. This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.
stats: 1% More Expansion Speed Per 3 Missing Mana

7.name: Doom Scribe
7.desc: After Glyph of Dominion its full size it now has a short delay before it detonates.

8.name: Runic Dominance
8.desc: Glyph of Dominion now has a cooldown, which is refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}. It also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per rune from {Runic Invocation}, without consuming them.

9.name: Power Word: Devastation
9.desc:
Glyph of Dominion now consumes the {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} on cast to gain additional effects per {Rune} you have. 

{Rah Rune}: Glyph deals more damage in a larger area per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Glyph detonates additional times during the delay per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Glyph inflicts stacks of Frostbite per second per {Rune} of this type.
stats: +5 Frostbite Stacks Per Second Per Heo Rune

10.name: Perfect Design
10.desc: Glyph of Dominion has additional charges and all charges are refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}.

11.name: Evoker of Elements
11.desc: You cast {Elemental Nova} in the middle of the {Glyph} if you stand inside it when the delay from {Doom Scribe} starts and you gain stacks of {Fire Aura}.
stats: Cast Elemental Nova When Delay Starts

12.name: Wreak Havoc
12.desc: Glyph of Dominion's damage over time part deals more damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Atomization
13.desc: While standing on your {Glyph} you and your allies deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Armor Shred on the enemy, up to a maximum of 14 stacks.
stats: +1% Damage Over Time Per Armor Shred

14.name: Vaporizing Realm
14.desc: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Runes of Disintegration
15.desc: {Disintegrate} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you ward per second if you start channelling it while standing on your {Glyph}.
stats: +40 Disintegrate Grants Ward Gain Per Second

16.name: Amplified Expanse
16.desc: Glyph of Dominion deals damage in a larger area.

17.name: Charged Reflections
17.desc: Glyph of Dominion is now cast at your current location and it grants you and your allies ward per second per your uncapped resistance while standing on your {Glyph}.
stats: +1 Ward Per Second Per 5% Uncapped Resistances

18.name: Arcane Mirror
18.desc: You and your allies gain additional resistances while standing on your {Glyph}.

19.name: Static Sparks
19.desc: After casting Glyph of Dominion you gain {Static Charges} at an accelerating rate while standing still, until your {Glyph} detonates.

20.name: Sanctuary Threshold
20.desc:
Whenever you or your allies enters your Glyph of Dominion it cleanses ailments and grants the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Leaving and re-entering the same {Glyph} does not cause this effect to trigger again.

21.name: Shocking Grasp
21.desc: You and your allies gain additional Shock chance while standing on your {Glyph}.

22.name: Power Word: Stun
22.desc: Normal and Magic enemies have a chance to be stunned every half second while on your {Glyph}.
stats: 10% Stun Chance On Glyph Every 0.5 Seconds

23.name: Tendrils of the Invoker
23.desc: Your {Lightning Blast} now chains while you are standing on your {Glyph}, but consumes mana when cast this way while you are at positive mana.
stats: +1 Lightning Blast Additional Chains on Glyph

24.name: Mage's Decree
24.desc: You and your allies gain increased area to spells and attacks while standing on your {Glyph}.
stats: +30% Spells and Attacks Area on Glyph

25.name: Flaming Scroll
25.desc:
{Glyph of Dominion's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Glyph of Dominion and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps {Glyph of Dominion's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Ignite chance is halved for minio

26.name: Burning Symbol
26.desc: Glyph of Dominion ignites enemies on the {Glyph} every half second.

27.name: Fan the Inferno
27.desc: The ignite frequency from {Burning Symbol} is increased by your chance to ignite.
stats: 1% Increased Ignite Frequency Per Ignite Chance

When a target is frozen by Ice Barrage, you are granted increased cast speed for 4 seconds.

This effect can stack a limited number of times.

Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage has a higher chance of freezing enemies than the previous shard.

This effect resets when Ice Barrage is recast.

5.desc: When Ice Barrage hits an enemy it has a chance to cast {Frost Nova}, a cold spell that damages nearby enemies.

6.desc: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire.

7.desc: You have a chance to gain ward on hit with Ice Barrage.

8.name: Cryogenesis
8.desc: Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

9.desc: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire, but you move more slowly while it is active.

11.desc: When {Ice Shield} expires it explodes, freezing nearby enemies.

12.desc: {Ice Shield} lasts longer, but Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

13.desc: While {Ice Shield} is active, you deal more global cold damage and take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage deals more damage than the previous shard (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This bonus stacks, but is reset on recasting Ice Barrage.

15.name: Sleetfire
15.desc: Ice Barrage has significantly increased fire rate, but while it is active all skills have increased mana cost.

16.name: Eternal Winter
16.desc: Ice Barrage lasts longer.

17.desc: Ice Barrage hits against bosses and rare enemies grant increased fire rate to the remaining hits. This effect stacks up to a cap.

19.desc: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer seek nearby enemies.

21.desc: Ice Barrage deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more critical strike chance.

22.name: Nailed Shot
22.desc: Each ice shard cast by Ice Barrage has a chance to pierce all enemies (continue through enemies hit).

23.name: Hypothermia
23.desc: Ice Shards that pierce enemies have a chance to inflict them with {Frostbite}.

24.desc:
Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its ice shards become larger.

Ice Barrage has a slower fire rate, and there is a longer delay between each shard being created and released.

25.name: Wintry Blast
25.desc: Ice Barrage now fire 5 ice shards in a cone in front of you, but has a slower fire rate and costs more mana.

26.name: Yrun's Conquest
26.desc: Ice Barrage releases ice shards in a wider cone.

27.name: Brittle Fragments
27.desc: Ice Shards cast by Ice Barrage shatter and deal cold damage in a cone behind the target. This does not work on piercing projectiles.

28.name: Frozen Ballista
28.desc: Ice Barrage deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown, but now only lasts 1 second and fires 3 projectiles.

29.name: Jagged Ice
29.desc: Ice Barrage has more critical strike chance against frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 20% More Crit Chance Against Frozen Targets

30.name: Shattered Skin
30.desc: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage to frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 15% More Hit Damage To Frozen Targets

31.name: Ice Burst
31.desc: Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.

32.name: Arctic Storm
32.desc: Ice shards released via {Ice Burst} have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.desc: Lightning Blast chains an additional time for each Lightning Blast you have directly cast recently up to a maximum.

3.name: Surging Influence
3.desc: Lightning Blast chains have increased range.

4.name: Crackling Speed
4.desc: Lightning Blast has increased cast speed.

5.name: Shattershock
5.desc: Lightning Blast hits deal more damage to chilled or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Closed Circuit
6.desc: Lightning Blast can now chain to you or your allies, granting increased damage and critical strike chance for 4 seconds. This buff cannot stack.

7.desc: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to blind enemies.

9.desc: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to shock enemies.
