Shock chance from this tree is converted to chill chance.

11.name: Bitter Burst
11.desc: Lightning Blast has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.name: Positive Protection
12.desc: Lightning Blast hits grant you ward.

13.name: Insidious Conduction
13.desc:
Lightning Blast is now a powerful channelled attack, hitting enemies caught within it but costs mana per second to channel and provides less ward when you hit enemies. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

This is incompatible with the {Focal Blast} node. If you have taken both, this will not work.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast and only chains every 5th cast if it is channelled.

Li

15.name: Storm Razor
15.desc: Improves Lightning Blast's base critical strike chance, and Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Chain Lightning
16.desc: Lightning blast can chain additional times, but costs more mana.

17.name: Focal Blast
17.desc:
Lightning Blast now deals damage to all enemies in a line, but no longer chains or forks. Lightning Blast hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time it would have chained (up to your maximum).

This node is incompatible with the {Insidious Conduction} node. If you have taken both, {Insidious Conduction} will not work.

18.name: Convergence
18.desc: Lightning Blast chains now hit the same target after a delay, but no longer chains to additional enemies. Lightning Blast chains half as many times rounded up.
stats: Lightning Blast Chains Only To First Target Hit

19.name: Divergence
19.desc: Lightning Blast hits have added lightning damage, and Lightning Blast chains can fork in addition to chain.
stats: Lightning Blast Can Fork Or Chain

21.desc: When you cast Lightning Blast you have a chance to be granted {Lightning Aegis,} which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

22.name: Overcharge
22.desc:
Lightning Blast has a chance to double cast, and Lightning Blast critical strikes deal more damage.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast if it is channelled or cast by another skill.

24.name: Frontloaded
24.desc: Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but this damage bonus is lessened each time Lightning Blast chains.

25.name: Cloud Answer
25.desc: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge}.

26.name: Mortal Capacitor
26.desc: {Spark Charges} applied by Lightning Blast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.name: Final Spark
27.desc: If Lightning Blast hits an enemy already affected by {Spark Charge} the Spark Charge explodes, dealing lightning damage to all nearby enemies.

28.name: Innate Conduit
28.desc: While out of mana, Lightning Blast has no cost, but cannot chain.

30.name: Hypercharge
30.desc:
When double casting, Lightning Blast instead has a chance to quadruple cast.

Lightning Blast cannot quadruple cast if it is channelled.

32.name: Countenance of Mana
32.desc: Reduces Lightning Blast's channel cost if Lightning Blast cannot chain.
stats: -10 Mana Cost Per Second if Lightning Blast Cannot Chain

2.name: Infernal Descent
2.desc: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Meteor has reduced cast speed.

3.name: Celestial Celerity
3.desc: Meteor has increased cast speed, but costs more mana. Meteors fall faster.

4.name: Crushing Force
4.desc: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and even more against enemies at full health.

5.name: Shattering Star
5.desc: Meteor has a chance to break into {Shrapnel} on impact, hitting nearby enemies.

6.name: Jagged Fragments
6.desc: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Rapid Break Up
7.desc: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to travel further.

8.name: Piercing Remnants
8.desc: {Shrapnel} projectiles pierce (continue through targets they hit), but travel slower.

9.name: Force of Impact
9.desc: Meteor has a chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflict last longer.

10.name: Stardust
10.desc: Meteors deal more damage of all types except fire (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Rapid Descent
11.desc: Meteor falls faster.

12.name: Twin Meteors
12.desc: When directly cast, an additional Meteor falls within a 4m radius of the first, but Meteor costs much more mana.

13.name: Distant Craters
13.desc: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but meteors fall further apart.

14.name: Meteor Shower
14.desc: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast, but individual Meteors deal damage in a smaller area.
stats: +1 Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

15.name: Rapid Impacts
15.desc: Meteors fall more frequently. This does not affect the total number of Meteors that fall.

16.name: Infernal Column
16.desc: Meteors fall in a line towards where you aim, but Meteor costs more mana.

17.name: Mana Fall
17.desc: Meteor costs less mana.

18.name: Apocalyptic Impact
18.desc: Meteors deals damage in a larger area of effect.

19.name: Extinction
19.desc: Improves Meteor's base critical strike chance. Meteor has a chance to deal damage in a significantly increased area.

20.name: Astral Cataclysm
20.desc: Meteor critical strikes deal more damage.

22.name: Rain of Fire
22.desc: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast.
stats: +1 Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts

23.name: World Ender
23.desc: Meteor always crits if you have more than 400 mana before you cast it.

24.name: Aftermath
24.desc:
After you cast Meteor you recover a portion of the mana spent over the next three seconds. 

You can only recover mana from one cast at once, so if you cast meteor again within three seconds you lose the remaining mana you would have recovered from the first cast.

25.name: Craterborn
25.desc: Casting Meteor grants the {Craterborn} buff, granting additional fire penetration and increased cast speed for a short duration. Craterborn does not stack.

26.name: Cycle of Fire
26.desc: Directly casting Fireball while you have {Craterborn} grants ward and restores your mana.

27.name: Heat Flux
27.desc: Meteors cast {Frost Claw} towards a nearby enemy on impact, consuming 120% of Frost Claw's mana cost.

2.name: Swift Sap
2.desc: Mana Strike has increased attack speed.

3.name: Breaking Current
3.desc: Mana Strike has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance and a chance to shock enemies.

4.name: Rune Sap
4.desc: Mana Strike hits grant you increased spell damage for 4 seconds. This effect can stack, and is doubled when hitting a boss or rare enemy.
stats: 4% Global Spell Damage Per Enemy Hit

5.name: Teleporting Strikes
5.desc: Mana Strike hits enemies near the target location, rather than in front of you, but grants significantly less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) from mana orbs and instant restoration.

6.name: Bountiful Victory
6.desc: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it kills an enemy, or when it hits a boss or rare enemy.
stats: 3 Mana Instantly Restored on Boss or Rare Hit

7.name: Critical Mana
7.desc: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it critically strikes an enemy.

8.name: Critical Rejuvenation
8.desc: Mana Strike has significant additional critical strike chance, but Mana Strike's critical strikes no longer deal extra damage.

9.name: Mana Drain
9.desc: Mana Strike grants more mana gained (multiplicative with other modifiers) from its mana orbs and instant restoration.

10.name: Mana Cleave
10.desc: Mana Strike now has a cooldown. It grants more mana gained from mana orbs and instant restoration, and it has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Repulsing Strikes
11.desc:
Mana Strike has a chance to knock enemies back on hit.

12.name: Spark Charges
12.desc: Mana Strike hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}.

13.name: Celestial Precision
13.desc: Mana Strike gains additional critical strike chance equal to a percentage of your current mana, but its base critical strike chance is removed.

14.name: Mana Spark
14.desc: Mana Strike has additional melee lightning damage equal to a percentage of your current mana.
stats: 5% Current Mana -> Added Melee Lightning Damage

15.name: Starved Strikes
15.desc: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are not on full mana.

16.name: Avatar of Hunger
16.desc: Mana Strike leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health while you are not on full mana.

17.name: Mana Storm
17.desc: Mana Strike additionally strikes enemies it hits with {Mana Arc} while you are not out of mana. {Mana Arc} consumes 10 mana.
stats: Casts Mana Arc At Positive Mana

18.name: Explosive Flurry
18.desc: Mana Strike has increased attack speed. {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is reduced.

19.name: Power Surge
19.desc: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is increased.

20.name: Sprite Blade
20.desc: Mana Strike has an increased area of effect.

21.name: Reclamation
21.desc: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana while you are out of mana.
stats: +5 Mana from Mana Orbs while Out Of Mana

22.name: Shocking Force
22.desc: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to shock enemies.

23.name: Arcanist's Blade
23.desc: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana.

24.name: Transfusion
24.desc: A portion of the mana gained from Mana Strike's mana orbs is instead gained as twice as much ward.
stats: 25% Mana Gain -> Twice as Much Ward Gain

25.name: Mind Warden
25.desc: {Transfusion} grants more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Star Guide
26.desc:
When you directly use Mana Strike and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast {Static Orb}. This chance is doubled while you are above 80% mana. This effect can occur up to 3 times per 2 seconds, and consumes 120% of Static Orb's mana cost.

If Mana Strike has a cooldown, this effect is guaranteed.

28.name: Frigid Grasp
28.desc:
Mana Strike's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Mana Strike.

Swaps Mana Strike's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

2.name: Unbridled Ruin
2.desc: Runic Invocation deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Rune} consumed.

3.name: Stride to Safety
3.desc:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation you leap backwards a short distance, hovering in the air for a moment. In this state you take less damage and directly casting Runic Invocation deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers). 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

4.name: Warmage's Initiative
4.desc:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation now leap forwards instead of backwards. 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

5.name: Interlude
5.desc:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first two {Runes}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least two runes for this effect to occur.

6.name: Prologue
6.desc:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.

7.name: Attuned Approach
7.desc: Runic Invocation grants ward per {Rune} consumed and on direct casts you refund a portion of its mana cost.

8.name: Rune Slinger
8.desc: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.

9.name: Elementalist's Call
9.desc: When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

10.name: Mastery of the Invoker
10.desc: When you consume {Runes} with a skill other than Runic Invocation you have a chance to also cast the corresponding {Invocation} for those runes.
stats: 6% Invocations Chance On Other Skill Use

11.name: Glyphcarver's Dominance
11.desc: {Invocations} that deal damage in an area now deal damage in a larger area.

12.name: Word of Rahyeh
12.desc: {Invocations} that include at least one {Rah Rune} have a chance to ignite enemies and deal additional spell fire damage.
stats: +6 Spell Fire Damage With Rah Rune

13.name: Inscribed Patterns
13.desc:
Runes now provide you with passive effects while you have them.

{Rah Rune}: Grants increased mana regeneration per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Grants ward per second per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Grants a higher chance to freeze enemies per {Rune} of this type.
stats: 2% Increased Mana Regen per Rah Rune
+4 Ward Gain Per Second per Gon Rune
+8% Freeze Rate Multiplier per Heo Rune

14.name: Runic Energy
14.desc: Every second you go without casting a Runic Invocation you gain a stack of {Runic Energy} up to a maximum. {Invocations} consume all {Runic Energy} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Runic Energy}.

15.name: Spell Cascade
15.desc:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation with at least 12 {Runic Energy} you also proc a random equipped non-channeling skill of the same element as each of the {Runes} consumed.

This effect consumes these skills' mana costs and puts them on cooldown (excluding movement skills and skills that are currently on cooldown).

These skills are cast at 0.24 second intervals after the {Invocation}.
stats: Cast Random Equipped Skill With 12 Energy

16.name: Copied Scrolls
16.desc: Runic Invocation now has a chance to be repeated per stack of {Runic Energy}.

17.name: Rune Powercore
17.desc: While you have 3 runes and your combination of runes changes without casting an invocation, you gain {Runic Energy}.
stats: +1 Gain Runic Energy While At 3 Runes

18.name: Arcane Battery
18.desc: Your maximum {Runic Energy} is tripled, but bonuses per {Runic Energy} are halved. When you cast a skill you gain {Runic Energy} per mana spent.

19.name: Runic Energizer
19.desc: Each unique {Invocation} you directly cast causes {Runic Energy} to accumulate faster until you repeat an {Invocation}.
stats: Accumulation Speed Resets On Repeat Invocation

20.name: Word of Heorot
20.desc: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.
stats: +60% Freeze Rate Multiplier With Heo Rune

21.name: Author of Arcana
21.desc: Directly casting Runic Invocation now refunds its mana cost and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown when cast this way.

22.name: Immutable Order
22.desc:
Whenever you gain a {Rune}, instead of it depending on the type of skill cast, it always results in your sequence of {Runes} mirroring the first three skills on your action bar from left to right.

This effect ignores skills that don't have an elemental tag.
stats: Rune Gain Depend On Skills On Action Bar

23.name: Adept Runescribing
23.desc: Runic Invocation has a shorter cooldown.

24.name: Consolidator
24.desc: While you have 3 {Runes} and your combination of {Runes} changes without casting an {Invocation}, Runic Invocation's remaining cooldown is reduced.
stats: 6% Cooldown Reduction When Rune Combination Changes

25.name: Enigma
25.desc:
Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.

26.name: Transcriber of Power
26.desc:
After casting Runic Invocation you gain additional spell damage and cast speed for a short duration. 

The buff duration scales with amount of {Runes} consumed.

27.name: Word of Lagon
27.desc: {Invocations} that include at least one {Gon Rune} have a chance to shock enemies and have a higher chance to critically hit enemies.
stats: +3% Critical Strike Chance With Gon Rune

28.name: Devastating Starfall
28.desc: Runic Invocation deals more damage per type of {Rune} consumed.

29.name: Cosmic Mind
29.desc: When you cast an {Invocation} using a sequence of three different {Runes} you gain ward per point of intelligence.
stats: 3 Ward Gain Per Intelligence With Different Runes

30.name: Elemental Starfield
30.desc:
Whenever you cast Runic Invocation, you also cast up to one of each type of {Elemental Nova} that you can cast directly. Each unique {Rune} you have when casting Runic Invocation represents different {Elemental Nova}. 

These {Novas} are cast with a 0.3 second interval.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Elemental Nova's} mana cost.
stats: Cast Elemental Novas From Runes In Invocation

32.name: Scrivener's Haste
32.desc:
You gain {Runes} faster while channelling.

You gain a burst of ward based on your maximum mana when your number of runes increases from channelling.

34.name: Elemental Lore
34.desc: Runic Invocation penetrates elemental resistances per point of Intelligence.

11.desc: Ignites consumed by {Conflagrate} deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.desc:
{Passive:} {Fire Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.desc: Enchant Weapon is active for longer.

15.desc: {Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks proportional to how much mana you are missing when Enchant Weapon is activated.

17.desc: When you directly use a melee attack, Enchant Weapon will automatically activate if it is not on cooldown.

18.name: Power Vent
18.desc: {Active:} You gain stacks of {Fire Aura} every second.

19.name: Frozen Sparks
19.desc: {Active:} You deal additional cold and lightning damage with melee attacks based on your weapon's melee damage.
stats: +1 Melee Lightning Damage Per 5 Melee Damage
+1 Melee Cold Damage Per 5 Melee Damage

20.desc:
{Passive:} You have a chance to chill enemies with melee attacks, and you gain a chance to inflict frostbite on enemies based on your chill chance.

{Active:} Both of these effects are doubled.
stats: +20% Percent of Chill Chance gained as Frostbite Chance

21.name: Icicle Strike
21.desc:
{Passive:} Your melee attacks have a chance to cast piercing {Ice Shards} towards enemies they hit, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} The chance to cast Ice Shards is tripled.

22.name: To The Bone
22.desc: {Active:} {Ice Shards} fires 2 additional projectiles.

23.desc: {Active:} You deal additional cold damage with melee attacks, and deal increased cold damage with melee attacks.

24.desc: Activating Enchant Weapon causes your next melee elemental attack to be free.

25.desc: Activating Enchant Weapon cleanses negative ailments.

26.name: Unstable Enchantment
26.desc:
Enchant Weapon has a reduced cooldown and duration.

{Active:} You cast {Elemental Nova} when you activate Enchant Weapon and when its active duration ends, consuming mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost.
stats: Casts Elemental Nova on Active Start and End

3.desc: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 25 maximum mana, but Static Orb costs additional mana equal to a portion of your maximum mana, up to a maximum.

4.name: Static Ground
4.desc: The explosion now leaves behind {Charged Ground} dealing lightning damage over time in an area. Creating another Charged Ground halves the remaining duration of all existing ones.

5.name: Electrocuting Cascade
5.desc: {Charged Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per additonal critical strike multiplier.

6.desc: You and allies have additonal shock chance and increased shock effectiveness while inside {Charged Ground's} area.

7.desc: Static Orb costs less mana, but it no longer pulls enemies.

Static Orb costs significantly less mana, but it now has a chance to not explode.

If you {Scatter Blast} then you only have a chance to create small orbs, and if you have {Orbital Fulmination} all static orbs orbit you for a reduced duration.
stats: 20% Small Orb Chance with Scatter Blast

9.name: Recurring Orb
9.desc:
If Static Orb does not explode it returns to you and deals damage on the way back, but it costs more mana.

This node has no effect if you have {Orbital Fulmination}.

10.name: Biting Force
10.desc:
Static Orb's base lightning damage is converted to cold and it gains a base freeze rate, but it no longer pulls enemies. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

11.name: Wintry Power
11.desc: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.name: Glacial Orb
12.desc: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies, but the explosion no longer creates Tendrils.

13.name: Orbital Fulmination
13.desc:
The orb now orbits you for up to 3 seconds before exploding, but you are limited to a few orbs and casting more will detonate older ones.

Static Orb gains damage and explosion area with time rather than travel distance, but scales up to the same maximum as before.

14.name: Storm Conductor
14.desc: Static Orb deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

15.name: Arcane Current
15.desc: Static Orb generates {Static Charges} on hit.

16.name: Overwhelming Barrage
16.desc: The explosion has a higher chance to stun, increased stun duration and you gain ward on stun with the explosion.

17.name: Critical Trajectory
17.desc: Static Orb's critical strikes deal more damage.

18.name: Forking Surge
18.desc: The explosion creates additional {Tendrils} to hit enemies outside the explosion area.

19.name: Static Armor
19.desc: Static Orb grants you {Lightning Aegis} for a short duration on cast, which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

20.name: Storm Burst
20.desc: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, but automatically explodes after 4 meters.

21.name: Volatile Outburst
21.desc: The explosion's damage ramps up more with distance, but it travels slower.

22.name: Storm Artillery
22.desc: Static Orb deals more damage and now travel faster and in an arcing trajectory rather than a straight line, but it no longer pulls or hits enemies until it explodes.

23.name: Fusionblast
23.desc: After using Static Orb the next {Lightning Blasts} cast from any source chain 2 additonal times.

24.name: Atomic Manipulation
24.desc:
For 4 seconds after using Static Orb directly casting {Lightning Blast} and hitting at least one enemy will return 25% of Static Orb's mana cost. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times.

25.name: Open Circuit
25.desc: Static Orb travels faster and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Overcharged Detonation
26.desc: Static Orb explodes on hit rather than piercing enemies. The orb deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost.
stats: +1% Orb Hit Damage Per 1 Mana Cost

27.name: Auxiliary Capacity
27.desc: You have a chance to cast an additional Static Orb towards the target when it hits a rare enemy or boss. This effect has a short cooldown.

28.name: Scatter Blast
28.desc: Casting Static Orb sends out smaller orbs in a cone in front of you. These small orbs can hit the same target as the large orb, but cannot explode and do not pull.

3.name: Frostbitten
3.desc: Shatter Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite}.

18.desc: You deal more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and are more likely to freeze enemies if you have used Shatter Strike recently (past 4 seconds).

stats: 5% Less Cold Damage Taken On Hit

21.desc:
Shatter Strike hits grant ward.

22.name: Frozen Shrapnel
22.desc:
Shatter Strike fires 8 {Ice Spikes}. Indirect casts create half as many Ice Spikes.

An enemy can be hit by both Shatter Strike and up to 1 Ice Spike from each cast.

23.desc: {Ice Spikes} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Ice Spikes from direct casts of Shatter Strike move faster, causing them to travel farther.
stats: +15% Ice Spikes Projectile Speed for Direct Casts

24.name: Solidify
24.desc: Shatter Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies and costs less mana.

25.name: Glacial Smash
25.desc:
Shatter Strike's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

26.desc: {Ice Spikes} have a chance on hit to create a random size {Glacier}, consuming a percentage of Glacier's mana cost.

28.desc:
Shatter Strike's base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.
Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.

23.desc: Surge now moves you in a zig zag motion rather than a straight line and deals more spell lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.desc: Consuming stacks of {Dormant Energy} grants you ward per stack consumed.

26.name: Fulmination
26.desc: You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you consume a stack of {Dormant Energy}.

27.desc:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage. 

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

2.desc: Snap Freeze has increased cast speed.

3.name: Flash Freeze
3.desc: Snap Freeze has a shorter cooldown, but Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has reduced duration.

4.name: Gale Force
4.desc: Snap Freeze knocks enemies back.

5.name: Lasting Cold
5.desc: Snap Freeze has a chance to chill enemies.

6.name: Permafrost
6.desc: Chill caused by Snap Freeze has increased duration. If you have taken the {Snap Shock} node, this increases Shock duration instead.

7.name: Shatter
7.desc: Snap Freeze hits and deals spell cold damage and can apply on-hit effects, but costs more mana.

8.name: Deathly cold
8.desc: Snap Freeze hits deal additional spell cold damage.

Snap Freeze no longer freezes and its base cold damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. 

All chill chance is converted to shock chance, and all nodes which rely on targets being frozen or chilled now work on shocked enemies instead.

10.name: Focused Current
10.desc: Improves Snap Freeze’s base critical strike chance.

11.name: Electrocute
11.desc: Snap Freeze critical strikes deal more damage.

15.desc: {Frostbite} inflicted by Snap Freeze has additional Cold Penetration.

16.name: Frozen Ground
16.desc: Snap Freeze leaves a patch of {Frozen Ground} for 5 seconds, which chills all enemies who walk on it. Frostbite inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

17.name: Focused Frost
17.desc: Snap Freeze costs less mana, but has a narrower area of effect.

18.name: Wandering Fog
18.desc: Snap Freeze’s area of effect extends further away from you.

19.name: Freezing Mist
19.desc: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has a longer duration, but has a narrower area of effect.

20.name: Shiver Armor
20.desc: You have additional armor and cold resistance while Snap Freeze is on cooldown.

21.name: Cryomancy
21.desc: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

22.name: Sap Warmth
22.desc: You steal cold resistance from enemies hit by Snap Freeze, causing you to gain cold resistance for 4 seconds and the enemies hit to lose it.

23.name: Memory of Frost
23.desc: You can store an additional charge of Snap Freeze, but Snap Freeze has a longer cooldown.

24.name: Frozen Monolith
24.desc: Snap Freeze also freezes yourself for 2 seconds. You cannot take damage while frozen this way.

5.desc: Teleport has a shorter cooldown.

12.desc: Teleport grants ward on cast.

14.name: Stable Bubble
14.desc: You have increased ward retention if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

16.desc: Teleport knocks enemies further back.

17.desc: Teleport costs less mana.

24.name: Rock Phase
24.desc: You cannot be stunned if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

26.desc: Teleport has a shorter cooldown and if you have {Haste} when you cast Teleport its duration is reset.

5.desc: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

13.desc: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} more frequently, but costs more mana.

2.desc: Abyssal Echoes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Rippling Corrosion
3.desc: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst shreds enemy armor.

4.name: Tides of Rust
4.desc: Armor shred applied by Abyssal Decay has increased effect.

5.name: Time Compression
5.desc: Abyssal Echoes no longer has a cooldown, but costs more mana.

6.name: Abyssal Dispersion
6.desc: Abyssal Echoes costs less mana.

7.name: Nether Breach
7.desc: Directly using Abyssal Echoes has a chance to cast a {Void Rift} from each nearby {Devouring Orb}.

8.name: Dark Torrent
8.desc: Abyssal Echoes can now be cast at the target location.

9.name: Turbulence
9.desc: Abyssal Decay has increased duration.

10.name: Myopia
10.desc: Abyssal Decay now blinds enemies.

11.name: Fragility
11.desc: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to have reduced physical resistance, but it is no longer consumed when the enemy is hit.

12.name: Crumbling
12.desc: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to take increased damage over time.

13.name: Impair the Weak
13.desc: Abyssal Decay now deals damage when the enemy is hit, rather than over time. Each hit deals a portion of the full damage Abyssal Decay would have dealt over its full duration. This damage still counts as damage over time.
stats: DoT -> Damage To Enemy On Hit

14.name: Embrace the Darkness
14.desc: Directly using Abyssal Echoes grants you {Nether Coating} for 5 seconds, granting you increased attack speed with your melee and throwing attacks and causing you to deal more damage to blinded enemies.

15.name: Abyssal Tendrils
15.desc: {Nether Coating} also grants you a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on hit.

16.name: Sanguine Eruption
16.desc: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst consumes all stacks of bleed on the enemy, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

17.name: Crippling Waves
17.desc: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst slows enemies.

18.name: Freedom of Movement
18.desc: Abyssal Decay causes Enemies that would apply {Slow} to instead grant their target {Haste} for 1 second.

19.name: Void Supremacy
19.desc: After casting Abyssal Echoes your next {Erasing Strike} and {Void Cleave} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to slowed enemies.

20.name: Deep Expanse
20.desc: Abyssal Echoes affects a larger area.

21.name: Fiery Chasm
21.desc: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst has a chance to ignite enemies.

22.name: Potent Corruption
22.desc: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now hits and deals spell void damage, but no longer inflicts Abyssal Decay.

23.name: Void Purifier
23.desc:
Spell void damage from {Potent Corruption}, {Vorpal Reverberation} and attribute scaling is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now also heals you and your allies and nodes on this tree that grant more damage also grant more healing.

24.name: Heavenly Gift
24.desc: Abyssal Echoes' damage now scales with attunement rather than vitality, and its healing effectiveness is also increased by attunement.

25.name: Vorpal Explosion
25.desc: Abyssal Echoes deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer chains.

26.name: Spreading Chaos
26.desc: Abyssal Decay now spreads to several nearby enemies after 1 second.

27.name: Overwhelming Doom
27.desc: Abyssal Decay spreads to enemies further away and can spread to more enemies when it spreads.

28.name: Shrieking Echoes
28.desc: {Abyssal Rifts} cast additional Abyssal Echoes.

29.name: Screaming Rifts
29.desc: Abyssal Echoes now creates an {Abyssal Rift} at the target location that casts Abyssal Echoes for you 3 times at its location before expiring.

31.name: Corrupting Harness
31.desc:
Abyssal Echoes can chain additional times. 

This effect is tripled for echoed casts.

32.name: Resounding Abyss
32.desc: Echoed casts deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Flame Burst
2.desc:
Your melee hits apply 10 stacks of {Fiery Inquisition} and the melee hits of other allies affected by the aura apply 1 stack. If an enemy reaches 60 stacks, the stacks are consumed to release a {Flame Burst}, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

While Holy Aura is active twice as many stacks are applied.

The {Flame Burst} scales with the stats of the player or minion that triggers it.

3.name: Improved Flame Burst
3.desc: If you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Fanaticism
4.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed.

5.name: True Strike
5.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance.

6.name: Extreme Zeal
6.desc: Holy Aura causes you and your allies' critical strikes to deal more damage.

7.name: Firestorm
7.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased fire and lightning damage.

8.name: Rahyeh's Devotion
8.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a chance to ignite and electrify enemies.

9.name: Rahyeh's Fury
9.desc: Holy Aura causes you and your allies to penetrate enemy fire and lightning resistance.

10.name: Call To Arms
10.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased physical damage.

11.name: Strength From Afar
11.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased throwing attack damage and increased stun chance with throwing attacks.

12.name: Shelter from the Storm
12.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional elemental resistance and endurance threshold.

13.name: Swiftness
13.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional dodge chance.

14.name: Redemption
14.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.

15.name: Concentration
15.desc: Holy Aura's active duration lasts longer, but Holy Aura's cooldown lasts longer and its passive is disabled during its cooldown.

16.name: Purification
16.desc:
Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional poison resistance.
Activating Holy Aura cleanses ailments for you and your allies.

17.name: Demoralizing Aura
17.desc: Activating Holy Aura grants you a chance to slow surrounding enemies each second.

18.name: Expedite
18.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increasing throwing attack speed and a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.

19.name: Vital Boon
19.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased health regeneration.

20.name: Faith
20.desc: Holy Aura regenerates ward for you and nearby allies.

21.name: Shielded By Faith
21.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased ward retention.

22.name: Faith's Reward
22.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a burst of ward when activated, but Holy Aura has a longer cooldown.

23.name: Mighty Shield
23.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional block effectiveness and health when blocking attacks.

24.name: Against The Odds
24.desc: Holy Aura grants you and your allies ward when blocking attacks.

26.name: Hope
26.desc: When an enemy dies in Holy Aura's area of effect, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe}, healing for 70 health.

28.name: Inner Flame
28.desc: Your melee hits apply an additional stack of {Fiery Inquisition} and if you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals damage in an increased area.

1.name: Emission
1.desc: Anomaly hits enemies in a larger area.

2.name: Red Shift
2.desc: Anomaly lasts longer.

3.name: Borrowed Time
3.desc: Anomaly is cast instantly, but Anomaly has a longer cooldown.

4.name: Time Wave
4.desc: When enemies return to the present a {Time Wave} is released, a spell dealing void damage to nearby enemies.
stats: Time Wave Cast On Enemy Return

5.name: Temporal Expanse
5.desc: {Time Wave} deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, and increases to Anomaly's area also affect Time Wave.

6.name: Tides of Time
6.desc: An additional {Time Wave} is released when you cast Anomaly.

7.name: Anticipation
7.desc: Anomaly has a shorter cooldown.

8.name: Reflection
8.desc: {Future Strike} is applied to all enemies hit by Anomaly.

9.name: Resonate
9.desc: {Future Strikes} applied by Anomaly have additional Void Penetration

10.name: Quicksand
10.desc: When enemies return to the present, all damaging ailments currently applied to them apply faster.

11.name: Cycle of Decay
11.desc: When enemies return to the present, the duration of damaging ailments applied to them is reset.

12.name: Void Touched
12.desc: Enemies hit by Anomaly are afflicted with {Time Rot} when they return.

13.name: Exacerbate
13.desc: {Time Rot} inflicted by Anomaly lasts longer and has additional Void Penetration

14.name: Mark of Rot
14.desc: When enemies return to the present, they take increased void damage for a duration.

15.name: Voidfire
15.desc: Anomaly now applies Ignite instead of Time Rot. Modifiers to Time Rot apply to Ignite instead.

16.name: Hour of Flame
16.desc: Anomaly applies additional stacks of ignite.

17.name: Time Bubble
17.desc: Anomaly leaves behind a {Time Bubble} for 5 seconds, which slows enemies and shreds their void resistance.
stats: 2 Void Res Shred Stacks per Second

18.name: Decimation
18.desc: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance while in its area.

19.name: Temporal Mastery
19.desc: {Time Bubble} lasts longer.

20.name: Time Lord
20.desc: {Time Bubble} is now cast on yourself and moves with you, but Anomaly costs more mana.
stats: Time Bubble Is Cast On You

22.desc: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed while in its area.

23.name: Swiftrest
23.desc: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased cooldown recovery speed while in its area.

24.name: Time Eater
24.desc: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies global health leech. This is doubled for void damage.

25.name: Void Maw
25.desc: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased health leech while in its area.

26.name: Immediacy
26.desc: Anomaly no longer sends enemies foward in time. Effects that would be triggered when enemies return to the present are instead triggered immediately.
stats: No Longer Sends Enemies Forward In Time

27.name: Time Lock
27.desc:
When enemies return to the present they are afflicted by {Time Lock,} rendering them unable to move, attack, or cast spells for 2 seconds.

Anomaly costs more mana.

10% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you {Time Lock} an enemy with Anomaly. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

28.name: Temporal Prison
28.desc: {Time Lock} lasts longer.

29.name: Stasis
29.desc: When enemies return to the present, enemies within the area of Anomaly's original cast are also time locked for 2 seconds.
stats: Nearby Enemies Afflicted With Time Lock On Return

30.name: Lingering Memory
30.desc: When allies or enemies exit {Time Bubble's} area of effect, effects caused or granted by Time Bubble persist for 2 seconds.
stats: Time Bubble Effects Persist For 2 Seconds On Exit

2.name: Dark Moon
2.desc: Devouring Orb now orbits you, but has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

3.name: Distant Satellite
3.desc: Devouring Orb deals more damage and orbits you at a greater distance.

4.name: Abyssal Rush
4.desc:
While you are moving, you will automatically cast Devouring Orb if it is not on cooldown and you have enough mana.

This effect puts Devouring Orb on cooldown.

5.name: Cosmic Impact
5.desc: Devouring Orb now deals void damage to enemies it collides with.

6.name: Extinction
6.desc:
Devouring Orb deals more hit damage to enemies it collides with (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This ONLY affects the damage that devouring orb deals when the orb itself collides with an enemy, not the damage dealt by its void rifts or other sub skills.

7.name: Void Adept
7.desc:
You deal more global void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased mana regen while a Devouring Orb is active.

These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 90 vitality.

8.name: Hollow Orb
8.desc: Devouring Orb lasts longer, but a Devouring Orb's {Void Rifts} no longer increase in size or damage for each successive rift.
stats: Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Damage
Successive Void Rifts Do Not Gain Area

9.name: Abyssal Emission
9.desc: Every 3 seconds Devouring Orb releases an {Abyssal Orb}, a spell which seeks enemies and detonates, dealing void damage in an area.

10.name: Chaotic Torrent
10.desc: The rate at which Devouring Orbs cast {Abyssal Orb} is increased by a random amount.

11.name: Cataclysm
11.desc:
Devouring Orb now erupts at the end of its duration, creating a {Void Eruption}.

Devouring Orb has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

12.name: Fleeting Orb
12.desc: Devouring Orb costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

13.name: Dust Channeller
13.desc: Devouring Orb has increased cast speed and a shorter cooldown.

14.name: Orb Master
14.desc: Devouring Orb has a shorter cooldown and {Void Eruption} deals more damage

15.name: Rift Caller
15.desc: All damage from Devouring Orb penetrates enemy void resistance. This includes {Void Rifts} and other sub skills and sources of damage added by this tree, and any ailments they inflict

16.name: Soul Eater
16.desc: The rate at which {Void Rift} hit damage and area increments when a nearby enemy dies is increased.
stats: +15% Damage Increment When Nearby Enemy Dies
+10% Area Inrement When Nearby Enemy Dies

17.name: Soul Gorger
17.desc: {Void Rift} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Time Rotting} enemies.
stats: +20% Hit Damage To Time Rotting Enemies

18.name: Abyssal Expanse
18.desc: Devouring Orb deals damage in a larger area.

19.name: All Consuming
19.desc: When you directly cast non-orbiting Devouring Orb within the area of an existing Devouring Orb, the new Orb consumes all existing Orbs to deal more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers), per Orb consumed. However, the new Orb also deals less ailment damage per Orb consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: World Rot
20.desc:
Devouring Orb lasts longer and it has a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on enemies each second inside its area of effect.

This chance also applies to hits from its subskills.

21.name: Rotting Prey
21.desc: Devouring Orb has a chance to apply frailty to enemies within its area of effect each second.

22.name: Eldritch Bloom
22.desc: Devouring Orb gains more radius each second, up to a maximum.

23.name: Eternal Decay
23.desc: Devouring Orb deals more damage over time, but less hit damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Sightless Star
24.desc: Whenever {Abyssal Rush} triggers, it has a chance to consume only 50% of Devouring Orb's cooldown and mana cost.

25.name: Patient Hunger
25.desc: Devouring orb gains additional charges, but costs more mana.

26.name: Abyssal Juggernaut
26.desc: You have a chance to gain a {Void Essence} when Devouring Orb expires.

28.name: The Rending Maw
28.desc: Devouring Orb hits have a chance to slow and shred enemy void resistance.

2.name: Dust To Wind
2.desc: Erasing Strike and {Void Rifts} it creates deals damage in a larger area.

3.name: Rifts of Decay
3.desc: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot}, an ailment that deals void damage over time, increases stun duration by 5%, lasts 3 seconds, and stacks up to 12 times.

4.name: Regicide
4.desc: When Erasing Strike hits a boss or rare enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

5.name: Dematerialize
5.desc: Erasing Strike deals more damage over time.

6.name: Iriesha's Fall
6.desc: Erasing Strike always creates a {Void Rift} at its impact location.

7.name: Mark of the End
7.desc: Erasing Strike hits shred enemy void resistance.

8.name: Void Pyre
8.desc: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

9.name: Merciful
9.desc: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and deals more melee damage to enemies that are already damaged (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Ruthless
10.desc: Erasing Strike deals more melee damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +25% Melee Damage Vs Full Health Enemies

11.name: Erasure of the Living
11.desc: Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

12.name: Void Lens
12.desc: All {Void Beams} created by Erasing Strike deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Time Loop
13.desc: Erasing Strike consumes mana to cause additional echoes when used. Each echo will appear one second after the last. These additional echos cannot be created while you have negative mana.

14.name: Shattered Continuity
14.desc: Erasing Strike no longer has a cooldown, but it deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Chamber of Fate
15.desc: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to slow and deals more melee damage to slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Obliteration
16.desc:
Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This bonus is doubled while wielding two handed weapon.

17.name: Prophet's Onslaught
17.desc:
Improves Erasing Strike's base critical strike chance.

Additionally, Erasing Strike's hits cannot be dodged.

18.name: Essence of the End
18.desc:
Erasing Strike critical strikes have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}, which grants 3% more void damage, 3% more melee damage, and 15% reduced duration of stuns received.

You can have a maximum of 3 void essences at once.

19.name: Certain Erasure
19.desc: Erasing Strike critical strikes deal more damage.

20.name: Absorb the Remains
20.desc: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy you regain health equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health.
stats: 1% Health Gained On Rare or Boss Hit

21.name: Moments Stolen
21.desc: You gain the {Haste} buff for 1 second, granting 30% increased movement speed when Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy.

22.name: Ravenous Void
22.desc: If you kill 5 or more enemies simultaneously with Erasing Strike, you create 4 {Void Beams} which travel at random, damaging surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

23.name: Void Bringer
23.desc: The kills required to summon {Void Beams} via the {Ravenous Void} node require less kills to trigger, but Erasing Strike costs more mana.

24.name: Implements of Destruction
24.desc:
Erasing Strike deals more void damage if you are using a two handed mace (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed if you are using a two handed sword.

Erasing Strike's melee hit and void rifts have a larger area of effect if you are using a two handed axe.

26.name: Final Hour
26.desc:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance for Erasing Strike and effects related to bleed now depend on Time Rot instead. 

Erasing Strike deals more melee damage against targets with 12 stacks of Time Rot (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +100% Melee Damage vs 12 stacks of Time Rot

27.name: Twin Cataclysms
27.desc: You can store an additional charge of Erasing Strike.

28.name: Hastened Cataclysm
28.desc: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed, but also has a higher mana cost.

1.name: Ironbound
1.desc: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance, and critical strikes deal more damage.

3.desc: You are granted ward when Forge Strike summons a {Forged Weapon}.

4.desc: {Forged Weapons} no longer move or attack, but generate ward when you are near them.

5.desc: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance and its hits inflict bleeding on hit, but your maximum number of {Forged Weapons} is halved.

6.desc:
Converts Forge Strike into a sword that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), cannot crit, and critical strike multiplier from the tree is converted to additional Physical Penetration for Bleed.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Spear Forge} node.
stats: Crit Multiplier -> Physical Penetration for Bleed

7.name: Spear Forge
7.desc:
Converts Forge Strike into a spear that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike critical strikes deal significantly more damage, but it hits in a smaller area.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Put To The Sword} node.

8.name: Heavy Strike
8.desc: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

9.name: Rending Descent
9.desc: Forge Strike hits reduce enemy armor, and armor shred applied by it last longer with increased effect.

10.name: Eagle Strike
10.desc: Forge Strike can now be cast at your target instead of in front of you.

11.name: Reinforce Weapon
11.desc: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

12.name: Reinforce Armor
12.desc: You have increased armor if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

14.name: Goliath Strike
14.desc: Forge Strike hits deal more damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 25% More Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

15.name: Engines of War
15.desc: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons'} hits deal damage in a larger area

16.name: Anvil Blow
16.desc:
Converts Forge Strike into an anvil that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has an increased chance to stun enemies, and stuns it inflicts lasts longer, but it has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you directly use Forge Strike it deals more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Temper
17.desc: Forge Strike deals additional melee fire damage and more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Detonating Ground
18.desc: Forge Strike causes {Detonating Ground}, sending out cracks which erupt after 1.5 seconds, dealing melee fire damage and igniting enemies.

19.name: Lava Burn
19.desc: {Detonating Ground} hits deal more damage.

20.name: Ignited Grounds
20.desc: {Detonating Ground} has a chance to ignite enemies on hit.

21.name: Forged by Fire
21.desc:
{Forged Weapons} deal additional melee fire damage.

{Forged Weapons} gain the {fire} tag.

22.name: Well Forged Weapons
22.desc: {Forged Weapons} last longer and you can control more forged weapons at once.

23.name: Forgemaster
23.desc: {Forged Weapons} now have a chance to become a {Great Axe} on summon, which deal more damage in a larger area, but attack slower.
stats: 30% Chance To Convert To Great Axe

24.name: Mass Production
24.desc: Forge Strike has a higher chance to summon {Forged Weapons}. This added chance is much higher against bosses and rare enemies.

25.name: Shrapnel
25.desc: {Forged Weapons} have a much shorter duration, but deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and explode when they expire, dealing fire and physical damage to nearby enemies.

26.name: Serrated Blade
26.desc: Bleed inflicted by Forge Strike has additional Physical Penetration and lasts longer.

28.name: Beneath Solarum
28.desc: Forge Strike has no cooldown, but costs additional mana.

29.name: Bellows
29.desc: Ailments inflicted by Forge Strike deal increased damage over time equal to your increased stun chance.

30.name: Fan The Flames
30.desc: You have additional global Fire Penetration if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

2.name: Double Riposte
2.desc: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy, but Riposte mitigates less damage.

3.name: Dark Duellist
3.desc: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while preparing to riposte.

4.name: Zealot's Technique
4.desc: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy.

5.name: Rapid Strikes
5.desc: Vengeance has increased attack speed.

6.name: Vengeful Fighter
6.desc:
Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you have blocked or parried a hit recently.

7.name: Blade Assault
7.desc: Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade}.
