8.desc:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred fire resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

9.name: Vital Puncture
9.desc: {Iron Blade} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Shattering Blade
10.desc: {Iron Blade} has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

11.name: Winged Steel
11.desc:
{Iron Blade} travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

Additionally, Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade} per point of Attunement up to a maximum.

12.name: Precision Strike
12.desc: Vengeance critical strikes deal more damage.

13.name: Gladiator's Arsenal
13.desc:
{Iron Blades} and {Riposte} gains different benefits depending on your equipped weapons.

Mace: Riposte deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Axe: Riposte instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
Sword: Improves {Iron Blades'} base critical strike chance.
Spear: {Iron Blades} have increased bleed duration.
stats: +3% Iron Blades Critical Chance With Sword
+15% Iron Blades Bleed Duration With Spear

14.name: Weaponsmith's Reprisal
14.desc: {Iron Blades} now have a chance to be summoned as {Forged Weapons} instead.

15.name: Bladewall
15.desc: You gain an additional chance to parry per {Forged Weapon} for 4 seconds after using Vengeance.

16.name: Executioner
16.desc:
Vengeance hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on low health (below 35% health).

17.name: Disarming Strike
17.desc: Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} on enemies.

18.name: Blade of Darkness
18.desc:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred void resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot} for Vengeance.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical}

19.name: Bolster
19.desc: You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased armor if you've hit an enemy with Vengeance in the past 2 seconds.

20.name: Essence of Revenge
20.desc: Vengeance and {Riposte} hits have a chance to grant a {Void Essence}.
stats: +15% Void Essence Chance On Vengeance Or Riposte

21.name: Abyssal Retribution
21.desc: Your next {Void Cleave} or {Erasing Strike} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after you use and hit with Vengeance.
stats: +15% Void Cleave Damage After Vengeance Use
+15% Erasing Strike Damage After Vengeance Use

22.name: Smelter's Vengeance
22.desc: Vengeance hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and physical resistance.

23.name: Woundcarver
23.desc: Vengeance hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

24.name: Eviscerating Blades
24.desc: Increases the effectiveness of all armor shred applied by Vengeance and {Riposte}.

26.name: Blade Paladin
26.desc: Vengeance gains additional physical penetration with bleed per 1% overcapped physical resistance.

28.name: Molten Riposte
28.desc: Riposte deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

30.name: Perfect Riposte
30.desc:
Hits that you {Riposte} cannot critically strike you.

Additionally, improves Vengeance's base critical strike chance.

32.name: Endless Dark
32.desc:
Vengeance hits have a chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Additionally, Vengeance has additional chance to Echo if it can Echo.

33.name: Vengeful Echoes
33.desc:
Vengeance deals more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional melee void damage.

Additionally, Echoed Vengeance cannot be dodged.

34.name: Fiery Frenzy
34.desc:
Vengeance has a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 2 seconds when hitting ignited enemies.

Additionally, Vengeance deals more fire hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per ignite on the enemy, up to a maximum.

1.name: Searing Light
1.desc: Healing Hands now hits enemies within its area of effect, dealing spell fire damage. Added spell damage applies to it at 200% effectiveness.

2.name: Bane of Evil
2.desc: Healing hands deals additional spell damage based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.
stats: +1 Spell Damage per 20% increased Healing Effectiveness

3.name: Halted Scourge
3.desc:
Healing Hands {Immobilizes} void enemies for 1 second on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less void damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.

4.name: Turn Undead
4.desc:
Healing Hands fears Undead Enemies for 2 to 3 seconds on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less necrotic damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.

5.name: Cleric's Wrath
5.desc: Healing hands deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the combined levels of your specialised Buff skills.
stats: +0.5% Damage per Level of Specialised Buff Skills

6.name: Consecrated Storm
6.desc: Healing hands has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

7.name: Holy Winds
7.desc: Healing Hands deals more lightning damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and when you hit an electrified enemy with Healing Hands it spreads all stacks of your stacks of electrify from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

8.name: Seraph Blade
8.desc:
Healing Hands is converted into a melee attack that hits in a wide arc in front of you. It now scales with melee damage instead of spell damage and effects on this tree that granted spell damage now grant melee damage instead.

Healing Hands still heals you, as well as allies within its area of affect.

9.name: Prayer of the Fallen
9.desc: Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness. This bonus is doubled if there is a dead player within 30 meters.

10.name: Blessed Parish
10.desc: Healing Hands has an increased area of effect and a lower mana cost.

11.name: Purity of Thought
11.desc: Healing Hands has a lower mana cost.

12.name: Divine Catalyst
12.desc:
You cast {Divine Bolt} at nearby enemies when you directly cast healing hands and heal yourself or an ally.

Divine Bolt is affected by specific passives from the Paladin tree and if you take this node then Divine Bolt from all sources scales with nodes on this tree.

13.name: Divine Barrier
13.desc:
Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Attunement.

If the ally has an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health, then it will not heal them, but will provide a percentage of its healing as ward.

14.name: Homeward
14.desc:
If Healing Hands would not affect any allied players at the chosen target location, it is cast centered on you instead.

Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness.
stats: Cast at self if not targeting ally

15.name: Synthesis of Light
15.desc: Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.

16.name: Unbroken Prayer
16.desc: Healing Hands becomes a channeled ability, casting 4 times per second regardless of cast speed, and draining your mana.

17.name: Guardian's Chant
17.desc:
Healing Hands also grants ward per second for three seconds after being cast on an ally.

The ward per second is equal to a proportion of the ward granted up front by the other nodes on this tree and by items that cause you to grant ward with Healing Hands.

This effect cannot stack multiple times, casting again on the same ally just refreshes the duration.
stats: 10% Upfront Ward gained as Ward per Second

18.name: Urgent Healing
18.desc: Healing Hands restores additional health up front.

19.name: Vow of Restoration
19.desc: Healing Hands restores additional health over time. This lasts for three seconds just like Healing Hands' inherent healing over time effect.

20.name: Cleric's Hammer
20.desc:
When you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target. This consumes mana based on Healing Hands's mana cost.

Healing Hands restores less up front health when cast indirectly.
stats: 25% Healing Hands Chance on Melee Hit

21.name: Hand of Aurelus
21.desc: When you directly cast Smite, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target location. This consumes 70% of its mana cost.
stats: 25% Healing Hands Chance on Smite Cast

22.name: Rahyeh's Chariot
22.desc:
When you directly use Healing Hands you dash to the target location first. However, Healing Hands now has a cooldown and counts a {Traversal} skill.

This does not affect indirect casts of Healing Hands.

23.name: Cloud Voyager
23.desc: A portion of Healing Hands' remaining cooldown is recovered if you use it to heal an ally other than yourself. This effect can occur once per direct cast of Healing Hands.

24.name: Sacred Gift
24.desc: When you cast Healing Hands, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe} at a random point inside the area of effect. When an ally walks over the globe, it is consumed, healing them for 70 health.

26.name: Sun Shroud
26.desc: You are immune to damage while moving with Healing Hands.

28.name: Virtue of Patience
28.desc: Healing Hands takes longer to cast, but deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased healing effectiveness and a larger area of effect.

30.name: Font of Salvation
30.desc:
If you heal an allied player other than yourself that was below half prior to healing, Healing Hands restores them to full health and grants them ward equal to 80% of their max health.

This has no effect on you, nor on minions, nor players that have an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health.
stats: 80% Health Gained as Ward when Healing to Full

32.name: Skyfall
32.desc:
While channelling Healing Hands you also call down a beam from the sky that deals fire damage over time to enemies around the target area and heals allies within its area of effect.

Healing Hands costs additional mana per second while channelling.

2.name: Rapid Throw
2.desc: Hammer Throw has increased attack speed.

3.name: Weighted Hammers
3.desc: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hammers travels slower.

4.name: Enra's Technique
4.desc:
Hammer Throw can no longer spiral, chain, or orbit.

If your hammers would spiral, they instead deal significantly more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If your hammers would chain, they instead deal more critical damage for each time they would chain.

If your hammers would orbit you, they instead have additional base critical strike chance.

Hammer Throw hits deal increased dam

5.name: Mana Starved Forging
5.desc: When you are out of mana Hammer Throw is free.

6.name: Shattering Force
6.desc: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

7.name: Disintegrating Aura
7.desc: Your hammers gain a {Disintegrating Aura}, causing enemies nearby them to take void damage over time, but Hammer Throw costs additional mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Rapid Disintegration
8.desc: {Disintegrating Aura} deals more damage, and Hammer Throw costs less mana.

9.name: Force of Impact
9.desc: Hammer Throw deals more damage, and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

10.name: Collision
10.desc: Hammer Throw deals more damage, but Hammer Throw hits no longer pierce (travel through enemies hit). Its hits have a higher chance to stun enemies, and the stuns they inflict last longer.

11.name: Ricochet
11.desc: Hammers chain to nearby enemies instead of returning to you. Hammer Throw can no longer throw extra projectiles, but it gains more damage and more attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each extra projectile you would have thrown.

12.name: Chaining Hammers
12.desc: Hammers chain to additional enemies.

13.name: Overwhelm
13.desc: Hammer Throw deals more hit damage against stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the stuns they inflict last longer

14.name: Battle Rouse
14.desc: Hammer Throw has a chance to grant you health on hit.

15.name: Hammer of Want
15.desc: Hammer Throw rips a {Dark Orb} from enemies on hit, which travels back to you and grants 6 health and mana. Hammer Throw has a 5 second cooldown.

16.name: Winged Hammers
16.desc: Hammers travel faster.

17.name: Steadfast Path
17.desc: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to deal double damage, but hammers no longer return to you.

18.name: Catapult
18.desc:
Hammer Throw launches additional hammers, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

Hammers from the same throw cannot hit the same enemy, unless they spiral.

19.name: Avatar of the Spire
19.desc: Hammers are now thrown in a nova, with double the amount of additional hammers unless your hammers spiral. Hammer Throw hits deal additional throwing physical damage.

20.name: Iron Spiral
20.desc: Hammers now travel in a spiral around you, but halves your amount of additional hammers and Hammer Throw costs more mana.

21.name: Hammer Vortex
21.desc: Your spiralling hammers now orbit you, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

22.name: Ballista
22.desc: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

23.name: Zealot's Conviction
23.desc: Hammer Throw hits have a higher chance to deal double damage.

24.name: Guardian's Zeal
24.desc: Using Hammer Throw grants you a stack of {Zeal} for 4 seconds, which increases your damage and critical strike chance by 10% per stack.
stats: 10% Global Increased Damage Per Zeal Stack
10% Global Increased Crit Chance Per Zeal Stack

25.name: Rahyeh's Legacy
25.desc: Each stack of {Zeal} also grants you added global ignite chance.
stats: +10% Global Ignite Chance Per Zeal Stack

2.name: Go for the Legs
2.desc: Javelin hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow.

4.name: Keen Outlook
4.desc: Javelin hits deal more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies the farther away they are, up to a maximum of 15 meters.

5.name: Forceful Hurl
5.desc: Javelin gains physical and lightning penetration for each second you have been standing still up to a maximum duration.

6.name: Strategic Patience
6.desc: Javelin deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Holy Spears
7.desc: Javelin deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional lightning damage.

8.name: Warrior's Mark
8.desc: Javelin hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} per point of Strength and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance per point of Dexterity.
stats: +1% Physical Res Shred Chance Per Dex

9.name: Divine Throws
9.desc:
Javelin's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Ignite and bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Electrify} for Javelin and effects related to bleed or ignite now depend on Electrify instead.

Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resis

10.name: Purifying Lightning
10.desc: Javelin has a chance to {Electrify} enemies on hit. Electrify applied by Javelin has additional Lightning Penetration.

11.name: Divine Fury
11.desc: When Javelin hits an enemy it now splits into additional piercing lightning spears which aim towards enemies close to the target, but Javelin itself can no longer pierce and it costs more mana.

12.name: Monster Piercer
12.desc:
Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on high health.

13.name: Horde Spiker
13.desc: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum, for each enemy pierced.

14.name: Beast Ender
14.desc: Improves Javelin's base critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

15.name: Serrated Javelin
15.desc: Javelin hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

16.name: Excellent Balance
16.desc: Javelin costs less mana.

17.name: Perfect Setup
17.desc: Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.

18.name: Sacred Forge
18.desc: Directly using Javelin and hitting an enemy causes your next {Judgement} or {Forge Strike} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Mighty Delivery
19.desc: Javelin deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased attack speed.

20.name: Burning Strength
20.desc: Javelin hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

21.name: Siege Barrage
21.desc: You now throw Javelin into the air causing 4 javelins to rain down at target location dealing damage in an area, but it costs more mana.

22.name: Battle Standard
22.desc:
Now only 1 Javelin rains down at the target location, it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and persists for 4 seconds, but has a cooldown.

It has a {Battle Standard} attached granting you and other allies in its radius increased damage and added endurance threshold based on your attunement.

23.name: Banner of Restoration
23.desc: The {Battle Standard} now heals allies around it each second. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

24.name: Ardent Symbol
24.desc: The {Battle Standard} now lasts longer, but is still limited to one standard.

25.name: Capture the Flag
25.desc: If an enemy walks over the {Battle Standard} it captures it and carries the flag until it expires.

26.name: Divine Intervention
26.desc: The {Battle Standard} now casts {Smite} at targets nearby every 1.5 seconds.

27.name: Righteous Descend
27.desc: The {Battle Standard} casts {Smite} more frequently and Smite cast this way has improved base critical strike chance.

28.name: Surprise Initiative
28.desc:
Javelin is now a combo ability, the first part throws down the {Battle Standard} and the second part causes you to {Dash} to the flag.

Javelin's cooldown is now longer.

29.name: Spiked Bombardment
29.desc: Additional Javelins rain down, but Javelin costs more mana.

31.name: Holy Trail
31.desc: Javelin now leaves behind a {Holy Trail}, that deals fire and lightning damage to enemies each second, heals you and your allies each second and lasts for 6 seconds, but Javelin now has a cooldown. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness

32.name: Pilgrimage
32.desc: Javelin deals more fire and lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have a chance to ignite and electrify enemies with melee attacks while Javelin is on cooldown.

33.name: Spear to the Thigh
33.desc: Javelin deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

35.name: Path of Judgement
35.desc: {Holy Trail} gains additional spell damage based on your increased healing effectiveness.
stats: +1 Spell Damage per 5% Increased Healing Effectivenes

2.name: Dawn Charge
2.desc: You regain a percentage of your missing health when you use Lunge.

3.name: Broadside
3.desc: Lunge deals damage in a wider area along its path.

4.name: Double Strike
4.desc: Lunge gains an additional charge, but it has a longer cooldown.

6.name: Slipstream
6.desc: Other allies caught in the path gain {Haste} for a short duration.

7.name: To Your Aid
7.desc: You can now Lunge to other allies.

8.name: Healing Rush
8.desc: You now heal allies and cleanse negative ailments on allies you Lunge to. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

9.name: Blade Stream
9.desc: Lunge now hits all enemies along its path to your target.

11.name: Rough Cuts
11.desc: Lunge hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed along its path but not its final hit.

12.name: Visceral Path
12.desc: Lunge deals more damage to enemies along its path and with its final hit.

14.name: Torchbearer
14.desc:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Voidbringer} node.

15.name: Juggernaut Dash
15.desc: You have a high chance to block while Lunging.

16.name: Disarming Blow
16.desc: Lunge's final hit has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

17.name: Impairing Strike
17.desc: Lunge's final hit now {Immobilizes} enemies for a short duration.

18.name: Deadly Stab
18.desc: Improves Lunge's base critical strike chance when using a spear.

20.name: Initiate's Onslaught
20.desc: Lunge's final hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

21.name: Cull the Weak
21.desc:
Lunge hits instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). The threshold is based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

22.name: Crusader's Fury
22.desc: After using Lunge you gain additional physical penetration per enemy hit along the path. This buff lasts 4 seconds.

24.name: Holy Incursion
24.desc: Lunge's final hit has a chance to cast {Smite} at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

25.name: Unstoppable
25.desc: You are invulnerable while Lunging.

27.name: Reckless Skirmish
27.desc: Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you {Frenzy} for a short duration.

28.name: Voidbringer
28.desc:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

29.name: Ready or Not
29.desc: Killing an enemy with Lunge resets the cooldowns of {Void Cleave}, {Erasing Strike}, {Forge Strike} and {Judgement}

30.name: Art of the Spear
30.desc: Lunge's final hit now deals damage in an extended rectangle instead of a circle when using a spear.

31.name: Pilum Assault
31.desc:
Lunge's final hit now causes you to use {Javelin} when using a spear.

This consumes Javelin's mana cost.

32.name: Warrior's Renewal
32.desc:
You reduce a portion of Lunge's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Lunge.

33.name: Ambuscade
33.desc: Lunge deals more melee damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

34.name: Lead the Charge
34.desc: You grant other nearby allies {Haste} at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.

35.name: Endless Will
35.desc: {Warrior's Renewal} recovers an additional amount of Lunge's cooldown and also grants you health when it triggers.

1.name: Platemail
1.desc: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your body armor.

2.name: Force of Impact
2.desc: Your Manifest Armor gains melee physical damage equal to a proportion of the armour on your body armour.
stats: 1 Melee Physical Damage per 10 Armor On Chest

3.name: Bulwark
3.desc: Manifested Armor has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Shield-Bearer
4.desc: Manifested Armor gains a shield which scales with the stats of your equipped shield.

5.name: Self Repair
5.desc: Manifested Armor gains additional health regeneration.

6.name: Lambent Metal
6.desc: Manifested Armor gains increased effect for health regeneration from all items that affect Manifest Armor.

7.name: Vengeful Guardian
7.desc: Manifested Armor reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

8.name: Thornmail
8.desc: Manifested Armor reflects damage back to attackers for an amount equal to your attunement.
stats: +1 Damage Reflected Per Point Of Attunement

9.name: Great Helm
9.desc: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your helmet.

10.name: Burning Armor
10.desc: Manifested Armor deals additional melee and spell fire damage as well as more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Blast Forge
11.desc: Manifested Armor now also attacks with {Forgebreath}, a fire spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies in a cone in front of it. 3 second cooldown.

12.name: Bellow
12.desc: {Forgebreath} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

13.name: Forged Fire
13.desc: {Forgebreath} has additional ignite chance and a shorter cooldown.

14.name: Heated Metal
14.desc: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to ignite enemies.

15.name: Whirlwind
15.desc:
Manifested Armor gains the ability to use {Whirlwind Strike}, a spinning attack which hits all nearby enemies multiple times and travels a short distance. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

16.name: Steel Greaves
16.desc: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your boots.

17.name: Warstomp
17.desc: Manifested Armor has a chance to taunt nearby enemies each second.

18.name: Thick Padding
18.desc: Manifested Armor cannot be stunned.

19.name: Dash Boots
19.desc: Manifested Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through. 6 second cooldown.

20.name: Lethargy
20.desc: Manifested Armor has a chance to slow attacking enemies when hit.

21.name: Iron Grasp
21.desc: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your gloves.

22.name: Sharpened Metal
22.desc: Manifested Armor's melee physical attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

23.name: Sharper Metal
23.desc: Manifested Armor deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Bladed Armour
24.desc: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

25.name: Redistributed Steel
25.desc: Manifested Armor deals more damage, but has less armor (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Titan Sword
26.desc: Manifested Armor gains a sword which scales with your equipped weapon's stats.

2.name: Way of the Sword
2.desc: Armament stacks last longer and grant you additional melee physical damage per stack.

3.name: Guarding Stance
3.desc: You have additional armor and block effectiveness per stack of Armament.

4.name: Bladed Focus
4.desc: When you drop below 0 mana, you consume all stacks of Armament to restore mana per stack.

5.name: Flanking Strikes
5.desc: When you have 0 stacks of Armament you have an additional sword when using Multistrike, as if you had 1 stack.

6.name: Hallowed Arsenal
6.desc:
Each additional sword is replaced with {Smite}.

Smite cast this way costs its full mana cost per cast.

7.name: Vengeful
7.desc:
You have a chance to retaliate with Multistrike swords on block. 

This effect has a 1 second cooldown and doesn't include the initial strike.

8.name: Echoed Warfare
8.desc: Multistrike attacks repeated by your {Echoes} have additional swords.

9.name: Initiate
9.desc: The initial strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Path of the Knight
10.desc: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 30 armor, up to a maximum.

11.name: Heated Forge
11.desc: Directly using {Forge Strike} consumes all stacks of Armament to summon additional {Forged Weapons} per stack.

12.name: Forgemastery
12.desc: Multistrike has a chance to consume a stack of Armament while at maximum stacks to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

13.name: Hack and Slash
13.desc: You now strike twice with Multistrike, but the full attack takes significantly longer. Each additional sword is now replaced with an axe that strikes its target twice.

14.name: Alpha Cuts
14.desc: Improves Multistrike's base critical strike chance.

15.name: Bladestorm
15.desc: When you create more additional swords than there are nearby enemies, each remaining sword can consume mana to strike the nearest enemy, even if it was hit by the initial attack.

16.name: Relentless Advance
16.desc: Multistrike has increased attack speed.

17.name: Determination
17.desc: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are at maximum stacks of Armament.

18.name: Blitz
18.desc: Multistrike penetrates enemy physical resistance.

19.name: Decimate
19.desc: Multistrike hits have a chance to inflict bleed on enemies per stack of Armament.

20.name: Guillotine
20.desc: Multistrike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

21.name: Jousting
21.desc:
Each additional sword is replaced with a spear, which stabs in an elongated area rather than a slash. This has no effect if swords are already converted to axes.

Additionally, Multistrike's critical strikes deal more damage while wielding a spear.

22.name: Sweeping Blows
22.desc: Multistrike deals damage in a larger area and its created swords can strike enemies further away.

23.name: Victory Strikes
23.desc:
If a sword kills an enemy it will create an additional sword to strike another enemy.

This effect cannot be triggered from additional swords created this way.

24.name: Perfect Steel
24.desc: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament.

25.name: Doctrine of the Anvil
25.desc: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament, but Multistrike has less attack speed per stack (multipicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Fiery Justice
26.desc: While at maximum stacks of Armament and positive mana, attacking with Multistrike will consume all stacks and 40 mana to use {Forge Strike}.

27.name: Aggressive Cadence
27.desc: Multistrike has an additional sword while you are at maximum stacks of Armament and wielding a two-handed weapon.
stats: Additional Sword At Max Stacks With 2h

28.name: Nullifying Carve
28.desc: {Void Cleave} consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.

1.name: Sanctified Serenity
1.desc: {Consecrated Ground} has increased healing effectiveness.

2.name: Lingering Force
2.desc: {Consecrated Ground} lasts longer.

3.name: Anointed
3.desc: {Consecrated Ground} becomes a {Consecrating Aura} which surrounds you and has a longer duration, but Judgement costs more mana. Judgement deals significantly more damage over time.

4.name: Destructive Impact
4.desc: {Consecrated Ground} heals allies and deals damage in a larger area.

5.name: Holy Eruption
5.desc: When {Consecrated Ground} finishes, it casts {Holy Eruption}, dealing fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals you and all your nearby allies for 80 health.

6.name: Holy Blast
6.desc: {Holy Eruption} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restore more health.

7.name: Cleansing Light
7.desc: {Holy Eruption} cleanses negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, on you and allies. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.

8.name: Expedite
8.desc: {Consecrated Ground} restores more health, but has a shorter duration.

9.name: Sanctification
9.desc: Judgement now pulls in enemies and slows them, but its initial hit no longer deals damage.

10.name: Flaming Soul
10.desc: {Consecrated Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Ashes To Dust
11.desc: {Consecrated Ground} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

12.name: Divine Destruction
12.desc: Judgement hits and {Conscrated Ground} deal more damage against enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +20% Conscrated Ground Damage Against High Health

13.name: Scourgebane
13.desc: Judgement hits deal more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +20% Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

14.name: Symbol of Sacrifice

3.desc: Rebuke has a shorter cooldown, but costs more mana.

5.desc: You have more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channelling Rebuke.

12.desc: While channelling Rebuke, you have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames} to nearby enemies each second.

15.desc: Ignite, armor shred, and spreading flames applied to enemies while channelling Rebuke last longer.

16.desc: Rebuke hits deal additional base void damage.

17.desc: Rebuke hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

18.desc: Rebuke has an increased maximum duration, allowing you to absorb more damage, but has a longer cooldown.

19.desc: While channeling Rebuke the healing from the {Redemption} node increases each second.

21.desc: The buffs you are granted via the {Augmented Plating} and {Brave the Elements} nodes now persist after you finish channelling Rebuke. Their duration is equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

22.desc: Regenerate mana when you are hit while channelling Rebuke.

24.name: Reclaimed Refuge
24.desc:
You reduce a portion of Rebuke's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Rebuke, and the effect is doubled while wielding a two handed weapon.

25.name: Stoic Challenge
25.desc: Rebuke now has an additonal charge.

1.name: Reinforcement
1.desc: You summon additional shields.

2.desc: Every 6 seconds each Shield heals nearby allies.

3.desc: When Shields heal allies, they also increase their armor for 4 seconds. This effect does not stack.

4.desc: When Shields heal allies, they also grant them a non stacking increased block effectiveness buff for 4 seconds.

5.desc: While using {Warpath}, your Shields spin faster and take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.desc: Shields have increased healing effectiveness.

7.desc: Ring of Shields costs less mana, but Shields have reduced health.

9.desc: Shields shatter into {Shrapnel} when they die, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies.

11.desc: You have additional chance to block and a higher block effectiveness if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

12.desc: You are invulnerable for 1 second after casting Ring of Shields, but you cannot move or use abilities.

14.desc: Shields have a chance to slow enemies that hit them.

16.desc: Shields have increased health and additional physical resistance.

21.desc: Shields now emanate {Forge Flames}, dealing fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

23.desc: You deal additional fire damage with spells and attacks if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

24.desc: Shields rotate around you at a greater distance.

26.desc: Ring of Shields summons additional Shields, but costs more mana.

28.desc: You deal increased melee fire damage if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

1% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 100%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.desc: You can summon an additional Symbol.

29.desc: Symbols grant you and your allies additional fire damage.

34.desc: Your Symbols of Hope have increased effect on your other allies.

Rive deals additional melee physical damage per point of Dexterity if you are using a Sword.

28.desc: Rive's third strike deals damage in a larger area.

19.desc: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact deal more damage.

20.desc: Shield Rush's final impact strikes a second time after a 0.5s delay, but Shield Rush hits deal less damage.

21.name: Stretched Time
21.desc: Shield Rush's final impact echo deals significantly more hit damage, but the delay between the final impacts is longer.

22.name: Critical Echo
22.desc: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact echo.
stats: +4% Final Impact Echo Base Crit Chance

23.name: Obliterating Echo
23.desc: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact echo deal more damage.

2.name: Blacksmith's Breadth
2.desc: Smelter's Wrath charges up faster to reach its maximum area sooner.

3.name: Soldering Strike
3.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to ignite enemies for each second channelled.

4.name: Stinging Steel
4.desc:
Smelter's Wrath has additional critical strike chance for each second channeled.

Additionally, it has additional critical strike multiplier for each second channeled.
stats: +5% Added Critical Strike Chance Per Second

5.name: Vulcanic Mastery
5.desc: Smelter's Wrath has doubled crit chance and deals more damage when fully charged (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 100% More Crit Chance At Full Charge

6.name: Backdraft
6.desc: When Smelter's Wrath is released, a duplicate attack is released in the opposite direction.

7.name: Heavy Strike
7.desc: Smelter's Wrath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled.

8.name: Bolster
8.desc: While charging Smelter's Wrath you have more armor and endurance threshold (multiplicative with other modifiers)

9.name: Whetstone
9.desc: Smelter's Wrath deals more melee damage and fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). These bonuses are increased by charging for longer.

10.name: Tempered Blows
10.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage (multiplciative with other modifiers) for each second channelled, but Smelter's Wrath charges more slowly.

11.name: Stoked Flames
11.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to ignited enemies per stack of ignite, up to a maximum of 150%.  This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers.
stats: +15% More Hit Damage Per Ignite Stack

12.name: Furnace
12.desc: Smelter's Wrath spews {Furnace} while charging, a fire spell that deals damage over time in a cone to enemies.

13.name: Bellows
13.desc: {Furnace} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Forged By Fire
14.desc: {Furnace} has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

15.name: Quench
15.desc: {Furnace} has a chance to slow enemies each second.

16.name: Liquefy
16.desc: {Furnace} has a chance to reduce enemy armor each second.

17.name: Ferrous Smash
17.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits have an increased chance to stun enemies per second channelled.

18.name: Rebuff
18.desc:
Smelter's Wrath charges up slower to reach its maximum area later (multiplicative with other channel speed modifiers).

Additionally, Smeler's Wrath gains additional physical and fire penetration per second channeled.

19.name: Axe Volley
19.desc: When releasing a fully charged Smelter's Wrath you also release five throwing axes in a cone in front of you, a throwing attack dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

20.name: Bury The Hatchet
20.desc: {Axe Volley} hits deal more hit damage per point of Dexterity.
stats: +2% Axe Volley Hit Damage per Dexterity

21.name: Brightsmith
21.desc: Smelter's Wrath converts your increased attack speed to increased critical strike chance.
stats: Increased Attack Speed -> Increased Critical Chance

22.name: Valiance
22.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 20% More Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses

23.name: Final Strike
23.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). This kill threshold is doubled at maximum charge.

24.name: Forge Scale
24.desc: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to shred enemies' armor for each second channelled.

25.name: Detonation
25.desc: Smelter's Wrath now releases in a nova around you instead of a cone, but costs additional mana.

26.name: Crucible
26.desc:
When fully charged, Smelter's Wrath leaves behind a {Burning Patch} for 6 seconds which ignites all enemies who stand in it twice per second.

Smelter's Wrath costs additional mana.

28.name: Sulphurous Sublimation
28.desc: Increased Area for Area Skills stats no longer increases Smelter's Wrath's charge speed and instead grants its more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: 3% More Fire Damage Over Time per 1% Increased Area
Increased Area no longer affects Charge Speed

2.name: Siege Breaker
2.desc: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shield Throw has a longer cooldown.

3.name: Steel Defender
3.desc: Shield Throw can target and ricochet to allies other than yourself, and when it hits allies they are granted {Steel Defense} for a duration, granting them additional armor.

4.name: Manifest Inspiration
4.desc:
If your {Manifest Armor} is hit by the shield, it performs a sweeping melee attack.

This attack cannot be triggered when the shield has no ricochets remaining.
stats: Manifest Armor Casts Sweeping Melee Attack When Hit

5.name: Faithguard
5.desc: {Steel Defense} also grants allies stun avoidance when Shield Throw hits them.

6.name: Testament of Light
6.desc: The benefits granted by {Steel Defense} scale with your Attunement.

7.name: Eruption of Coals
7.desc: Whenever Shield Throw ricochets on an enemy or ally, it casts {Lava Burst}, a spell dealing fire damage to all enemies near the impact.

8.name: Forceful Breaking
8.desc: {Lava Burst} deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

9.name: Magma Rage
9.desc: {Lava Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Forgeborn
10.desc: Shield Throw deals additional throwing fire damage and penetrate enemy fire resistance.

11.name: Molten Shield
11.desc:
Shield Throw's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Shield Throw. 
Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance for Shield Throw.
stats: Phys Shred -> Fire Res Shred Chance

12.name: Molten Toss
12.desc: Shield Throw deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Burning Crusade
13.desc: Shield Throw and {Lava Burst} hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites it inflicts last longer.

14.name: Sleek Buckler
14.desc: Shield Throw has increased attack speed and projectile speed.

15.name: Ricochet
15.desc: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets, but it costs additional mana.

16.name: Aeroplates
16.desc: Shield Throw costs less mana.

17.name: Colossus
17.desc:
Shield Throw's hits grant you a stack of {Colossus} for 4 seconds. This can stack up to 20 times.

Each stack grants you increased armor and additional physical penetration.

18.name: Vampiric Steel
18.desc:
Shield Throw leeches a portion of its damage to you.

Additionally you steal armor from enemies you hit for 4 seconds, meaning you reduce their armor and gain additional armor yourself.

19.name: Iron Monger
19.desc: Shield Throw's hits shred enemy armor.

20.name: Hemrin's Technique
20.desc: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets and you regain health whenever Shield Throw Ricochets, scaling with your Dexterity.

21.name: Heavy Shield
21.desc: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional throwing damage.

22.name: Sharpened Rim
22.desc: Improves Shield Throw's base critical strike chance.

23.name: Spiked Plates
23.desc: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your block chance.

24.name: Rygar's Fury
24.desc: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to 100% of your block chance, but you have reduced all resistances while Shield Throw is released.

25.name: Crippling Throw
25.desc: Shield Throw has a chance to slow and increased chance to stun enemies.

26.name: Shredding Edge
26.desc: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to inflict bleed and shred enemy physical resistance.

27.name: Fleet of Foot
27.desc: When you use Shield Throw, you are granted {Haste} for a duration.

28.name: Defender's Rage
28.desc: Shield Throw's hits grants you the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration.

29.name: Avenger's Wrath
29.desc: Shield Throw has additional critical strike multiplier scaling with your block effectiveness.

30.name: Disarming Blow
30.desc: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to apply {Frailty}.

31.name: Throwing Arm
31.desc: Shield Throw can ricochet between additional targets, including you if there are no other targets.

33.name: Shield Barrage
33.desc:
Shield Throw can be thrown while you have a shield out, but shields are smaller and deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This node has no effect if {Siege Breaker} is allocated.

2.name: Riftflame
2.desc:
Void Cleave hits ignite enemies and half of its base damage is converted to fire, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to fire damage but not with increases to void damage.

Ignite inflicted by Void Cleave gains additional fire penetration based on your increased void damage.

Void Cleave gains the {fire} tag.
stats: 1% Fire Penetration with Ignite per 10% increased Void Damage

3.name: Hellish Chasm
3.desc:
All of Void Cleave's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Additionally your next non-channeled fire attack or spell after Void Cleave deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Void resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred and effect
stats: Void Res -> Fire Res Shred Chance
+30% Damage On Next Fire Attack Or Spell

4.name: Molten Blades
4.desc: When you use Void Cleave and hit at least one enemy, your minions gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} for 4 seconds, granting them additional melee fire damage and a chance to ignite enemies.

5.name: Scorching Path
5.desc: Minions only gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} when you directly hit them with Void Cleave, but {Molten Infusion} has significantly increased effect.
stats: Molten Infusion Only On Minion Hit

6.name: Abyssal Walker
6.desc: You can travel farther with Void Cleave and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Momentum
7.desc: After channelling {Warpath} for at least 2 seconds your next Void Cleave within 1 second deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Into the Depths
8.desc: Void Cleave deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in an increased area.

9.name: Precognition
9.desc: Improves Void Cleave's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

10.name: Deadly Omen
10.desc: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.

11.name: Rift Maker
11.desc: Void Cleave hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} and Void Cleave has increased critical strike chance.

12.name: Champion of the Void
12.desc: Void Cleave critical strikes deal more damage and you gain mana with Void Cleave critical strikes.

13.name: Obliterator
13.desc: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next {Erasing Strike} is always a critical strike.

14.name: Crushing Echo
14.desc:
Void Cleave deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is tripled for echoed Void Cleaves.

15.name: Abolisher
15.desc: Void Cleave deals significantly more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health.
stats: +50% Melee Void Damage To Low Health

16.name: Ruining Sweep
16.desc: Void Cleave hits slow enemies, have increased stun chance and increased stun duration.

17.name: Dark Pathway
17.desc: Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.

18.name: Fraying Strikes
18.desc: Void Cleave hits shred enemy void resistance.

19.name: Resonating Cleave
19.desc:
You cast {Abyssal Echoes} after using Void Cleave.

Abyssal Echoes cast this way uses its mana cost.

20.name: Warped Decay
20.desc: Void Cleave hits inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

21.name: Ravager
21.desc: When you use Void Cleave you gain {Ravaging Aura} for a short duration scaling with the amount of enemies hit up to 10.

22.name: Annuling Presence
22.desc: {Ravaging Aura} deals additional spell void damage and has an increased area of effect.

23.name: Endless Hunger
23.desc: {Ravaging Aura} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

24.name: Dismantling Throws
24.desc: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack inflicts enemies with {Time Rot}.
stats: +1 Time Rot Stacks For Next Throwing

25.name: Entropic Blows
25.desc: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Time Rot} on the target.

26.name: Armor Sunderer
26.desc: Void Cleave hits shred enemy armor and {Armor Shred} applied by Void Cleave has increased effect and duration.

27.name: Voidfused Projectiles
27.desc: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack deals additional void damage.

28.name: Nether Charge
28.desc: You can store an additional charge of Void Cleave, but Void Cleave costs more mana.

29.name: Vorpal Force
29.desc: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

30.name: Blazing Steel
30.desc: Your increases to physical damage also apply to fire damage for Void Cleave.

32.name: Gravity's Edge
32.desc: You can travel much further with Void Cleave (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it has a longer cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

2.name: Void Spiral
2.desc:
Warpath deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

4.name: Apocalypse Whirl
4.desc:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Warpath has a chance to inflict {Time Rot}. Bleed and ignite chance from all sources are converted to Time Rot chance for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.
stats: Bleed And Ignite -> Time Rot Chance

5.name: Maw of the Deep
5.desc: Warpath hits deal more damage against enemies per stack of {Time Rot} on them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Juggernaut Stance
6.desc: While spinning, you have additional block chance and block effectiveness.

7.name: Battlemaster's Blade
7.desc: Warpath deals damage in a larger area while wielding a two handed weapon.

8.name: Dark Nexus
8.desc: While spinning, you gain mana every three seconds while wielding a two handed weapon.

9.name: Gorebringer
9.desc:
Warpath hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed stacks inflicted by Warpath have increased duration.

Both effects will instead apply to ignite or time rot if you have {Earthscorcher} or {Apocalypse Whirl}.

10.name: Earthscorcher
10.desc:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

11.name: Path of Fire
11.desc: While spinning, you leave behind a burning trail that ignites enemies each second. If ignite has been converted to {Time Rot} with {Apocalypse Whirl} this trail inflicts Time Rot instead.
stats: 1 Ignite Stacks In Trail Each Second

12.name: Iron Reach
12.desc: Warpath deals damage in a larger area.

13.name: Quicksilver Wind
13.desc: While spinning, you have increased movement speed.

14.name: Whirling Steel
14.desc:
Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon or dual wielding.

16.name: Path of Heavens
16.desc: While spinning, you have additional spell damage.

17.name: Way of the Cleric
17.desc: While spinning, you and your allies are healed each second within Warpath's area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

18.name: Winds of Justice
18.desc:
While spinning, you have a chance to cast {Smite} each second on a nearby enemy.

This consumes Smite's mana cost.

19.name: Arsenal of Flame
19.desc: Warpath hits deal more melee fire damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and ignite it inflicts has additional Fire Penetration

20.name: Warrior's Fury
20.desc: For each second you continuously spin, Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area, but costs additional mana per second. These effects will stop scaling after a duration.

21.name: Giant Splitter
21.desc: After spinning for at least 2 seconds you do a {Warslash} when you stop spinning. This deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second you spent spinning, up to a maximum duration.

22.name: Way of the Executioner
22.desc: Warpath deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Unchained
23.desc: Warpath costs less mana per second.

25.name: Cyclone of War
25.desc: While spinning, you have additional melee leech while wielding an axe, additional base crit chance while wielding a sword, additional physical penetration while wielding a mace and additional fire penetration while wielding a sceptre.
stats: +2% Global Melee Health Leech With Axe
+2% Global Base Critical Chance With Sword

27.name: Reckless Spin
27.desc: Warpath costs significantly less mana per second, but you have reduced elemental resistance while spinning.

28.name: Molten Path
28.desc: Warpath hits shred enemy armor.

29.name: Forgemaster Stance
29.desc: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} every 5 seconds as if you had hit an enemy with {Forge Strike}.

30.name: Moving Forge
30.desc: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} more frequently.

31.name: Echo Knight
31.desc:
While spinning, you deal increased void damage and you have a chance each second to create an {Echo} at a recent location that uses Warpath on the spot for 2 seconds. This chance is equal to twice your chance for skills to echo.

You can only create a Warpath echo if you have been spinning for at least 2 seconds and have travelled at least 4 metres in the past 2 seconds.

32.name: Abyssal Tempest
32.desc:
While spinning, you cast {Abyssal Echoes} every 5 seconds.

This consumes Abyssal Echoes' mana cost.

2.name: Swift Echoes
2.desc: Volatile Reversal has a shorter cooldown.

3.desc: Volatile Reversal's forwards jump has a significantly shorter maximum distance, but its cooldown is reduced.

4.name: Rending Maw
4.desc: Volatile Reversal has additional critical strike chance.

5.name: Voidstep Siphon
5.desc: When you critically strike at least one enemy with Volatile Reversal you regain mana.

6.name: Catching Up
6.desc: You gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration, when you jump backwards in time.

7.name: Phased Reality
7.desc: While you are able to jump backwards in time, a percentage of your armor mitigation also applies to damage over time.
stats: 5% Armor Mitigation Applied to Damage Over Time

8.name: Warped Time
8.desc: You gain the {Frenzy} buff, while you are able to jump backwards in time.
stats: Frenzy While Able To Jump Back

9.name: Temporal Dilation
9.desc: You can use Volatile Reversal's second combo ability for a longer period of time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Accelerationist
10.desc:
When you jump forwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become older.

This causes them to expire sooner.

11.name: Chrono-Devourer
11.desc: When you jump backwards in time, {Devouring Orb} recovers some of its cooldown scaling with the amount of {Devouring Orbs} that expired after jumping forwards in time.

12.name: Nether Convergence
12.desc: When you jump forwards in time, all your {Devouring Orbs} are pulled towards you and trigger a {Void Rift}, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

13.name: Eternal Banquet
13.desc:
When you jump backwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become younger.

This causes them to expire later, and each orb can only benefit from this once.

14.name: Immutable Past
14.desc: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability is removed, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

15.name: Termination
15.desc: Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Future Focus
16.desc: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability now jumps you forward in time to your target location, instead of backwards.

17.name: Dark Expanse
17.desc: Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

18.name: Hellfire Rifts
18.desc:
Volatile Reversal's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Time Rot chance from this tree is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Volatile Reversal's {Void} tag for a {Fire} tag.

19.name: Volatile Power
19.desc: When you jump forwards in time, your arrival location is slightly randomized, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

20.name: Dissipation
20.desc: Volatile Reversal's hits have a chance to slow enemies and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the enemy.

21.name: Reclaimed Action
21.desc: When you travel at least 4 meters by jumping through time, your next direct melee attack or spell is guaranteed to {Echo}, if it is able to.
stats: Guaranteed Echoed Skill With Far Jump

22.name: Voidbound Momentum
22.desc: When you jump backwards in time, Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per meter travelled, up to a maximum.

23.name: Eldritch Infusion
23.desc: Volatile Reversal's melee hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

24.name: Incipient Void Bolt
24.desc: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your starting location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

25.name: Food for Wyrms
25.desc: Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} have a chance to inflict time rot.

26.name: Time Rifts
26.desc: Enemies hit by Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} take increased damage over time for several seconds. This effect does not stack.

27.name: Returning Corruption
27.desc:
Your {Void Bolts} return to you.

All returning Void Bolts can hit the same targets again. (This means a single cast of the Void Bolt spell can hit a single enemy up to 4 times)
stats: Returning Void Bolts Can Hit Again

28.name: Terminal Void Bolt
28.desc: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your arrival location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

29.name: Hollow Cascade
29.desc:
The {Void Bolts} from the {Terminal Void Bolt} node are now replaced with a single cast of {Abyssal Echoes}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Abyssal Echoes'} mana cost.
stats: Abyssal Echoes Instead Of Void Bolts

3.name: Mania of Mortality
3.desc: You have additional ward decay threshold. Additionally, whenever a nearby enemy, ally, or minion dies, you have a chance to gain ward.
stats: 10% Chance To Gain Ward On Nearby Death

5.name: Ethereal Revenant
5.desc: When damage leaves you below half health, you summon a {Revenant,} a melee minion with decaying health whose damage scales with your intelligence. This effect has a 15 second cooldown.
bonus: 1% More Revenant Damage Per Minion Skill Level

6.name: Blood Pact
6.desc: You deal increased damage, but you lose a percentage of your current health each second if you have killed an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).
stats: 1% Current Health Drained Per Second On Kill

8.name: Putrid Demise
8.desc: You have a chance to poison on hit, and additional poison resistance.

10.name: Elixir of Hunger
bonus: 50% Minion Health Consumed On Potion Use

12.name: Unbound Necromancy
12.desc: You have a chance when one of your Skeletons dies to summon a new one after 3 seconds.

13.name: Soul Conduits
13.desc: You have additional ward per second for each minion you have active, up to 20 minions.

14.name: Cursed Blood
14.desc: You and your minions deal increased physical and necrotic damage.
bonus: Minion Deaths Mark Nearby Enemies For Death

15.name: Reclamation of Souls
15.desc: You have increased ward retention, and are granted ward whenever one of your minions die.

18.name: Sharpened Bones
18.desc: Your minions have additional chance to critically strike.

19.name: Towering Death
bonus: 30% Shared Reduced Bonus Damage Taken From Crits

20.name: Invigorated Dead
bonus: 100% Minion Added Melee Physical -> Minion Added Throwing Physical

22.name: Scornful Blood
22.desc: Instead of healing you, your leech drains the health of an enemy within 6 meters every 0.25 seconds.

24.name: Cling To Life
24.desc: Grants you Vitality and all resistances, and grants your minions all resistances.

28.name: Forbidden Teachings
bonus: 1% Minion Increased Crit Chance Per Intelligence
1% Minion More Damage Over Time Per Vitality

29.name: Dance with Death
29.desc: You deal increased damage. This bonus is tripled when you are at low life.

32.name: Biting Frost
32.desc: You and your minions have a chance to inflict bleed and frostbite on hit.

34.name: Desolation
34.desc: You and your minions deal increased damage over time.

35.name: Reaper
35.desc: Your spells and melee attacks instantly kill enemies that they leave below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

36.name: Soul Barrier
36.desc: When a hit taken leaves you below half health, you gain ward based on your uncapped poison resistance. This effect has a 6 second cooldown.
stats: 1 Ward Gained per 1% Uncapped Poison Resistance

38.name: Excoriating Insight
38.desc: You have additional Intelligence, but your elemental resistances are lowered.

39.name: Bed of Souls
39.desc: You have additional Vitality, and you and your minions have increased health regeneration.

42.desc: Your and your minions deal additional spell necrotic damage and melee necrotic damage.

43.name: Executioner
43.desc: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a dagger or axe in your offhand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: Can Equip Axes Or Daggers In Offhand
+20% Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

44.name: Impact Ward
44.desc: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).
bonus: Damage Over Time Taken Bypasses Ward

45.name: Instruments of Death
45.desc: You have increased movement speed with a dagger equipped, more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with an axe equipped, and additional ward per second with a catalyst equipped.
stats: 2% Increased Movement Speed With A Dagger
+15 Ward Per Second With A Catalyst

46.name: Decaying Form
46.desc: You have a chance to poison on hit, and take less poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
bonus: 50% Damage Over Time Taken As Poison

47.name: Wands of the Fallen
47.desc: You deal increased spell damage if you do not have a shield equipped.

48.name: Mind Over Body
bonus: 5% Missing Health Gained As Ward Per Second

50.name: Soul Stealer
bonus: 13% Chance Per Curse to gain Mana on hit

52.name: Chaos Flames
52.desc:
You deal increased fire damage and have a chance to ignite on hit with fire skills, and you deal increased necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict damned on hit with necrotic skills.

These effects also apply to your minions.

53.name: Spiteful Decay
bonus: 4% More Damage over Time to Cursed

54.name: Harrowing Armor
bonus: 3% More Armor per Curse on Target

55.name: Dark Rituals
55.desc: Your minions have increased attack and cast speed. This bonus also applies to you if you have used a minion skill in the last 10 seconds.
bonus: Applies To Player For 10 Seconds On Minion Skill Use

56.name: Crimson Gluttony
56.desc: A percentage of your current health is drained each second, but you gain a percentage of your missing health as ward each second.

25.name: Betrayal
25.desc: If you only control one Golem, it has a much higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when damaged by hits from allies.

26.name: Breath of Formosus
26.desc: Your Golem's {Freezing Grasp} spell now has additional spell damage and base freeze rate per point of Vitality.
stats: +1 Freezing Grasp Freeze Rate per Vitality

28.name: Bone Kindling
28.desc: Your {Skeletons} and {Skeletal Mages} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more fire damage over time to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.
stats: +25% Infernal Aura Damage Per Skeleton or Skeletal Mage

2.name: Bone Knives
2.desc: Marrow Shards deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer pierces.

3.name: Marrow Hunger
3.desc: You leech a portion of physical damage as health if you have cast Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

4.name: Splintering Impact
4.desc: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone behind the enemy when destroyed, damaging other enemies, but Marrow Shards no longer pierces and costs more health.

5.name: Carving
5.desc: {Bone Splinters} deal more damage.

6.name: Ghost Splinters
6.desc: {Bone Splinters} travel faster and further.

7.name: Gouging Splinters
7.desc: {Bone Splinters} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

8.name: Crimson Ivory
8.desc: {Bone Splinters} hits deal more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Dark Precision
9.desc: {Bone Splinters} have additional critical strike chance.

10.name: Ivory Obliteration
10.desc: {Bone Splinters} have additional critical strike multiplier.

11.name: Dead Weight
11.desc: Marrow Shards deals more damage, but its range is reduced.

12.name: Blood Assassin
12.desc: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier.

13.name: Marrow Death
13.desc: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike multiplier.

14.name: Femoral Offering
14.desc: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike multiplier, but you lose health when you critically strike with Marrow Shards.

16.name: Bone Splinters
16.desc: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone when destroyed, which damage enemies, but Marrow Shards travels less far and costs more health.

17.name: Marrow Caster
17.desc:
Marrow Shards are now instantly destroyed, creating a {Splinter Nova} around you instead of {Bone Splinters}. Splinter Nova hits all enemies in an area around you.
Splinter Nova is affected by all modifiers to Marrow Shards and Bone Splinters. Modifiers to the projectile speed of Bone Splinters grant increased area for Splinter Nova.

18.name: Ossumancy
18.desc:
When you directly cast Marrow Shards, you have a chance to immediately cast a second instance of Marrow Shards.

Indirect casts of Marrow Shards, such as from this effect, do not cost health.

19.name: Shredding Bones
19.desc: Marrow Shards hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

20.name: Apathy
20.desc:
Marrow Shards deals more damage, but Marrow Shards can hit and damage your own minions. 

On hit effects, such as health gained on hit, do not proc when you hit your minions.

21.name: Treachery
21.desc: You gain health when you kill one of your own minions.

22.name: Dark Reverie
22.desc: Grants you increased critical strike chance if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

23.name: Blood Reverie
23.desc: You leech a portion of physical damage as life if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

24.name: Soul Blood
24.desc: Marrow Shards has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but costs more health.

25.name: Bones Of The Follower
25.desc: Marrow Shards deals significantly more damage, but consumes one of your minions when you cast it.

26.name: Rip Marrow
26.desc: Marrow Shards has a chance to create a {Marrow Orb} on hit that returns 15 health to you. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.

27.name: Marrow Eater
27.desc: {Marrow Orbs} return more health.

28.name: Life Blood
28.desc: Marrow Shards hits have a higher chance to create a {Marrow Orb}.

29.name: Spirit Feast
29.desc: {Marrow Orbs} also replenish mana.

30.name: Demise
30.desc: Marrow Shards deals more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

32.name: Frigid Shards
32.desc:
Marrow Shards's base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not to physical damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Marrow Shards's physical tag for a cold tag.

34.name: Second Sight
34.desc: The second cast of Marrow Shards from {Ossumancy} will target a random enemy within 15 meters.

2.name: Fragile Crust
2.desc:
Chthonic Fissure costs less mana and it refunds some of its mana cost if there is a cursed player, rare enemy or boss within 20 meters when you cast it.

This effect also works if you are Cursed.

3.name: Fell Fire
3.desc: {Tormenting} an ignited enemy spreads all of your ignite stacks from it to a number of other enemies around it.

4.name: Stygian Current
4.desc: The Fissure releases {Spirits} more frequently.

5.name: Of Gloom and Flames
5.desc: Chthonic Fissure now creates a secondary Fissure in the opposite direction that casts its own {Spirits}. Enemies can take damage from both Fissures if they stand on both, but Chthonic Fissure costs significantly more mana.

6.name: Chaotic Rupture
6.desc:
{Spirits} now have a chance to be replaced by a cast of {Chaos Bolts} that consumes a portion of its mana cost and scales with your {Chaos Bolts} tree.

{Chaos Bolts} cast this way have a chance to have no additional projectiles.
stats: 13% Chance to replace Spirits with Chaos Bolts

7.name: Spirit Gale
7.desc: When {Tormented} enemies die they have a chance to release the {Spirit} to inflict and {Torment} another enemy within 8 meters.

8.name: Severed Wards
8.desc: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy necrotic resistance.

9.name: Singed by Terror
9.desc: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy fire resistance.

10.name: Return Below
10.desc: When {Spirits} {Torment} an enemy afflicted by an {Infernal Shade} they consume the Shade, causing it to instantly deal its remaining damage and increases all existing Chthonic Fissures' frequency of releasing {Spirits} up to a maximum.
stats: Infernal Shade deals its Remaining Damage

11.name: Damned Waters
11.desc: The {Spirits'} hits inflict enemies with {Damned}.

12.name: Grim Tide
12.desc: Chthonic Fissure and ailments it inflicts deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% Added Critical Strike Multiplier.
stats: +1% Necrotic Damage per 1% Added Crit Multi

13.name: Twisted Waves
13.desc: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your uncapped necrotic resistance.

14.name: Eradication
14.desc:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses.

This effect is doubled if the enemy or you are cursed.

15.name: Beacon of Torment
15.desc:
{Spirits} now target you instead of enemies, and whenever you are {Tormented} or {Torment's} duration on you is refreshed, you gain additional spell damage and Endurance Threshold.

This buff can stack and has the same duration as {Torment}, but persists if {Torment} is cleansed.

16.name: Grasp of the Undying
16.desc: The Fissure deals more direct damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it does.
stats: +2% Fissure Direct Damage bonus per Second

17.name: The Sunderer's Domain
17.desc:
You can now have additional Fissures active at a time, but {Spirits} are released less frequently.

If a Fissure is placed over an existing one, the new Fissure closes after 1 second.

18.name: Deepest Ravine
18.desc: Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer releases {Spirits}.

19.name: Rekindled Graves
19.desc:
Fissures now cast {Volatile Zombies} every 2 seconds, but consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volatile Zombies} mana cost.

{Volatile Zombie} cast this way has a chance to not create multiple {Zombies} if it would otherwise.

20.name: Death from Below
20.desc:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you are cursed.

21.name: Pyrochasm
21.desc: The Fissure's initial impact now hits enemies dealing spell fire damage, with added damage applying at 300% effectiveness for this hit.

22.name: Fissure of Wrath
22.desc:
The Fissure's initial hit now deals additional spell damage with a higher chance to stun per 2% ignite chance.

This effects scales with bleed or poison if the Fissure is converted to physical or poison respectively.
stats: +1 Fissure Spell Damage per 2% Ignite Chance
5% Fissure Increased Stun Chance per 2% Ignite Chance

23.name: Forbidden Chasm
23.desc: The Fissure's initial hit now Curse enemies with {Acid Skin}, which causes them to take poison damage over time and a chance to be critically struck by any hit.

24.name: Acidbane
24.desc:
Your hits against enemies cursed by {Acid Skin} have additional base critical strike chance per 10% of your global increased poison damage.

This bonus critical strike chance is not affected by other critical strike chance modifiers.
stats: +1% Bonus Crit Chance per 10% Inc Poison Damage

25.name: Ash Cloud
25.desc: The Fissure's initial impact now spreads all of your ignite stacks from the target to nearby enemies up to a maximum.

26.name: Chthonic Passage
26.desc:
When directly casting Chthonic Fissure you now travel along the Fissure as it opens, but this adds a cooldown to Chthonic Fissure.

Chthonic Fissure gains the {Traversal} tag.

27.name: Mantle of Flames
27.desc:
The Fissure gains a percentage of your global chance to ignite on hit as ignite chance per second. 

Additionally, the Fissure has a base chance to ignite enemies each second.
stats: 100% Your Ignite Chance -> Ignite Chance per Second

28.name: Blood Gulch
28.desc:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Physical} tag.

29.name: Chronicles of Ruin
29.desc: {Torment} lasts longer and any ignite, poison and bleed inflicted by Chthonic Fissure also last longer.

30.name: Tombgorger
30.desc: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to ignited, poisoned or bleeding enemies.

31.name: Valley of Defilement
31.desc:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to poison chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Poison} tag.

1.name: Abrupt Chaos
1.desc: Chaos Bolts has increased cast speed, and its projectiles travel faster.

2.name: Sanguine Reverie
2.desc:
Chaos Bolts' base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Damned chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

4.name: Scatter
4.desc: Chaos Bolts' hits now have a chance to fear enemies, but the projectiles target a wider area.

6.name: Condemned to Chaos
6.desc: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to inflict enemies with damned.

7.name: Blood Tithe
7.desc: Chaos Bolts costs less mana, but now consumes a portion of your current health and ward on cast.

8.name: A Grave for Two
8.desc: Chaos Bolts deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your missing health.

9.name: The Gate
9.desc:
Hitting your minions with Chaos Bolts grants them any damned, ignite, bleed or frostbite chance that Chaos Bolts gains from this tree.

This buff lasts 10 seconds, and does not stack.
stats: Ailment Chances to Minions on Hit

10.name: The Burn
10.desc:
Directly casting Chaos Bolts extends the duration of your active {Cthonic Fissures} and {Infernal Shades}. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

11.name: Exult in Misery
11.desc: Chaos Bolts' hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to damned, ignited, bleeding and frostbitten.

12.name: Mania in Flames
12.desc: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

13.name: Call of Morditas
13.desc:
Chaos Bolts' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

14.name: Chance of Snow
14.desc:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to chill enemies. 

Additionally, Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to deal double hit damage to chilled enemies.

15.name: Torment of the Red Tundra
15.desc:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies per 1% uncapped cold resistance.

Additionally, Chaos Bolts deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 4% uncapped cold resistance.
stats: +6% Freeze Rate Multiplier per 1% Cold Res
+1% Physical Damage over Time per 4% Cold Res

16.name: Pandemonium
16.desc: Chaos Bolts explosions have a chance to deal damage in a much large area.

17.name: Cthonic Aurora
17.desc: Chaos Bolts releases additional projectiles, but it has a higher mana cost.

18.name: Mana Anarchy
18.desc: Chaos Bolts' projectiles have a chance to consume additional mana causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Revolution
19.desc:
Whenever mana is consumed by the {Mana Anarchy} node, your minions gain additional spell damage based on your maximum mana and they also gain increased cast speed.

This buff lasts 13 seconds.

20.name: Chains of the Betrayer
20.desc:
Chaos Bolts no longer shoots multiple projectiles, but now instead shoots one large projectile causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other multipliers) in a larger area. 

These effects scale with the amount of projectiles Chaos Bolts would have shot.

21.name: Volatile Kindling
21.desc: Chaos Bolts' hitting one of your {Volatile Zombies} causes it to instantly explode. Zombies exploding this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

22.name: Sudden Putrescence
22.desc: {Volatile Zombies} exploding from the {Volatile Kindling} node deal even more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and poisons enemies.

23.name: Destructive Intensity
23.desc:
Whenever you cast Chaos Bolts you gain a stack of {Destructive Intensity} up to a maximum.
