Each stack reduces the target area and improves Chaos Bolts base critical strike chance.

If you go 2 seconds without gaining a stack, all stacks are lost.

24.name: Doom's Vindication
24.desc: Chaos Bolts deals more damage and its hits deal more damage to {Cursed} enemies (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Reaper of Mayhem
25.desc:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Dexterity to cause you to attack with {Harvest} from the location of enemies hit, hitting them and enemies around them.

This effect can occur a maximum of 3 times per second.

26.name: Devour the Damned
26.desc: Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies regain health and mana.

27.name: Seed of Chaos
27.desc:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies has a chance to cause you to recast Chaos Bolts from their location towards another nearby enemy, consuming a portion of its mana cost. 

The recast has a minimum range of 5 meters, and will not cast at enemies within that range.

28.name: Exacted Libation
28.desc:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Intelligence to cast {Rip Blood} at target enemies.

This effect can occur a maximum of 2 times per second.

29.name: Cursed Blood
29.desc: Chaos Bolts hits refreshes the duration of your {Curses} on them and grants you health per curse.

30.name: Another Affliction
30.desc:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies casts {Bone Curse} at their location.

This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

2.name: Empowered Drain
2.desc: Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Soul Blast
3.desc: When a target is killed by Drain Life you cast Soul Blast at their location, dealing spell necrotic damage to enemies in an area around them.

4.name: Malignant Discharge
4.desc: {Soul Blast} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

6.name: Hecatomb
6.desc: Drain Life can now target your minions. You gain 10 mana per second for each minion you are draining.

7.name: Necrotic Feast
7.desc: Drain Life can now only target minions. Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health.

8.name: Lay Waste
8.desc: Drain Life deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the health leech from its base effect and nodes on this tree is removed.

9.name: Soul Bond
9.desc: Drain Life has a chance to summon a {Soul Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion that deals necrotic damage to enemies.

10.name: Virulence
10.desc:
Drain Life's base necrotic damage is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Swaps Drain Life's {Necrotic} tag for a {Poison} tag.

11.name: Blood Pact
11.desc: Drain Life no longer costs mana. Instead, it drains a portion of your current health per second while channelling. Nodes that modify mana drain now modify this health drain instead.

12.name: Death's Barrier
12.desc: You are granted ward when Drain Life kills an enemy.

13.name: Horrify
13.desc: Drain Life has a chance to slow and fear its targets each second.

14.name: Shadowy Tendril
14.desc: Drain Life can drain an additional target.

15.name: Contempt
15.desc:
You gain a stack of {Contempt} when you have channelled on the same enemy for 2 seconds.

Contempt grants more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and adds to all resistances. All stacks of Contempt are lost when you stop channelling.

16.name: Enduring Contempt
16.desc: {Contempt} stacks last for a duration after you stop channelling Drain Life.

17.name: Stagger
17.desc: When Drain Life has channelled on the same target for 2 seconds, it stuns them for 2 seconds.

18.name: Stupefy
18.desc: The stun inflicted by {Stagger} lasts longer and Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

19.name: Thoughtsteal
19.desc: Drain Life costs less mana per second.

20.name: Condemnation
20.desc: Drain Life applies stacks of {Damned} each second. {Damned} is an ailment that deals necrotic damage over time.

21.name: Word Of Conviction
21.desc: {Damned} inflicted by Drain Life lasts longer.

22.name: Eternal Servitude
22.desc: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you start channeling Drain Life it does not expire until you stop channeling.
stats: Wandering Spirits does not expire while channeling

23.name: Ravenous
23.desc: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to targets that are on low health.

24.name: Insatiable
24.desc: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health, but costs more mana per second.

25.name: Dark Shackles
25.desc: Drain Life is now cast instead of channelled. Lasts for 3 seconds. Adds an up-front mana cost, and this cost is affected by modifiers to mana drain, except for the {Blood Pact} node.

26.name: Enduring Night
26.desc: {Dark Shackles} lasts longer, but Drain Life costs more mana.

27.name: Grasp Of The Damned
27.desc: {Dark Shackles} can hit up to 10 additional targets, and slows enemies hit each second, but Drain Life costs significantly more mana.

28.name: Chilling Demise
28.desc: When a target is killed by Drain Life, you chill enemies in an area around them for a duration.

30.name: Unholy Mass
30.desc: Drain Life deals 3% more damage per stack of {Damned} on enemies affected by {Damned}, up to a cap (multiplicative with other modifiers).

32.name: Circle of Sacrifice
32.desc:
You gain ward over time while channelling based on your maximum mana.

Drain Life can affect enemies in a wider area. This does not affect the maximum number of enemies you can drain from at a time.

33.name: Cloak of Solitude
33.desc: Increased Area stats from this tree and other sources has no effect on Drain Life's area of effect, but instead grants you additional Ward Retention while channelling Drain Life.
stats: Increased Area Stats no longer affect Area

0.name: Dread Shade
0.desc: Target minion takes 3% max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and minions around it deal 25% more damage. Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Expires after 20 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

2.name: Wisdom of the Dead
2.desc: Dread Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

3.name: Martyrdom
3.desc: Dread Shade now grants minions armor based on your vitality, but Dread Shade decays your minions faster.

4.name: Congregation of Shades
4.desc: You can control one additional Dread Shade or Infernal Shade at once.

6.name: Frenzied Phantom
6.desc: Dread Shade now grants frenzy to affected minions for a fixed duration after being cast.

7.name: Scorching Brand
7.desc: Dread Shade now grants the targeted minion {Haste} while it persists, but it also applies a stack of ignite to the targeted minion each second.

8.name: Lingering Doom
8.desc: Dread Shade drains your minions' health more slowly and all affected minions deal additional necrotic damage with spells and attacks.

9.name: Spectral Distance
9.desc: Dread Shade has increased area of effect per active minion when cast, up to a maximum benefit.

10.name: Pernicious Pact
10.desc: Dread Shade no longer decays your minions' health, but instead inflicts a stack of {Everlasting Poison} each second.

12.name: Egoism
12.desc: The minion targeted by Dread Shade has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier, but also has additional chance to be critically hit.

13.name: Deadlock
13.desc: Dread Shade now roots the targeted minion and causes it to taunt enemies around it.

14.name: All For One
14.desc: Dread Shade grants the targeted minion significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dread Shade no longer buffs other minions.

15.name: Blind Fury
15.desc: Dread Shade now increases the attack and cast speed of the targeted minion, but they have less critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Dying Coven
16.desc: Dread Shade grants affected minions increased attack and cast speed.

17.name: Duskheart
17.desc: Minions affected by Dread Shade have a chance to inflict {Damned} to enemies they hit.

18.name: Dying Light
18.desc: Dread Shade now inflicts {Damned} each second to all enemies and friendly minions in its area.

19.name: Spectral Presence
19.desc: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area.

20.name: Grim Fate
20.desc: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area and grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the targeted minion's health decays more quickly.

21.name: Bane of Death
21.desc:
Dread Shade applies {Mark for Death} to nearby enemies and minions when it expires.

Mark for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

22.name: Final Grasp
22.desc: When any of your minions targeted by Dread Shade dies, it casts {Sacrifice} on additional minions, with each cast consuming mana equal to Sacrifice's mana cost.

23.name: Enemy of My Enemies
23.desc:
Dread Shade now attaches to enemies instead, still buffing your minions, but Dread Shade now has a duration, and this duration cannot be increased.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.

24.name: Symbiotic Apparition
24.desc: You are affected by the beneficial buffs of Dread Shade's aura.

25.name: Doom Brand
25.desc: Dread Shade now drains the health of other minions, and marks them with {Doom Brand}. When they die, the brand explodes dealing necrotic spell damage to surrounding enemies.

26.name: Dark Binding
26.desc: {Doom Brand} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.name: Flesh Harvest
27.desc: Dread Shade grants increased effect of all its buffs for each 3% of missing health on the targeted minion.
stats: 1% Increased Buff Effect Per 3% Missing Health

28.name: Infernal Dread
28.desc: Casting Dread Shade refreshes the duration of your {Infernal Shades.} Each Infernal Shade can only be refreshed a maximum number of times.
stats: Refresh Infernal Shade Duration On Cast

29.name: Dread Plague
29.desc: Dread Shade applies {Spirit Plague} to a nearby enemy whenever it expires.

30.name: Beyond Death
30.desc: When a minion targeted by a Dread Shade dies, you have a chance to summon a single {Volatile Zombie} from its corpse.

31.name: Lone Watcher
31.desc: Dread Shade no longer drains the health of the minion it is attached to, but you are limited to one active Dread Shade. Increases to health drain from this tree instead increase damage taken by the minion.
stats: Health Drain Increases -> increased Damage Taken

32.name: Vile Ghast
32.desc: Dread Shade now increases poison damage instead of necrotic damage, and converts added necrotic damage from the base skill and this tree to chance to poison on hit.
stats: 5% Poison Chance per 1 Added Necrotic Damage

34.name: Wasting Essence
34.desc: Dread Shade grants affected minions more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.name: Death Seal
0.desc:
Combo skill. Seals your health at your current amount of health, draining your ward to 0 and preventing you from gaining health or ward for up to 5 seconds. For that duration you gain more damage equal to your percent missing health.

Reactivate to release a wave of death dealing damage based on how long the seal has been active, and percent missing health.

2.name: Glimpse of Pain
2.desc: When you kill an enemy while sealed, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

3.name: Radiated Suffering
3.desc: The Wave of Death has a chance to shred necrotic resistance.
stats: +25% Wave of Death Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance

4.name: Entreat The Damned
4.desc: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you activate Death Seal it is granted additional duration.

5.name: Corrupted Consciousness
5.desc: When Death Seal ends, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

6.name: Mortal Pulse
6.desc: You release a Wave of Death each second while sealed and upon activation, in addition to when you release Death Seal, but your waves of death deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: Death Wave Cast Every Second While Sealed

7.name: Tachycardia
7.desc:
You release a Wave of Death when you cast {Reap} or {Evade}.

Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to work.
stats: Wave of Death on Reap or Evade

8.name: Desperate Shroud
8.desc: For the duration of Death Seal, you gain armor and stun avoidance for each 10 health you were missing when Death Seal was activated.

9.name: Life Tap
9.desc: If you drop below 10% health while you are sealed, Death Seal is released automatically.

11.name: Deadlock
11.desc: If your health is above 33% of your maximum when you activate Death Seal, it is reduced to 33% of your maximum health.

12.name: Pustulent Presence
12.desc: While sealed, you take less poison damage per 10% missing health, up to 50% missing health.
stats: 3% Less Poison Damage Taken per 10% Missing Health

13.name: Cycle of Decay
13.desc: Wave of Death hits deal more damage against poisoned targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +20% Death Wave Hit Damage To Poisoned Enemies

14.name: Curdled Flesh
14.desc: Wave of Death hits deal more damage per stack of poison up to a maximum (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +2% Death Wave Hit Damage Per Poison

15.name: Carrion Breath
15.desc: The Wave of Death has increased area of effect and additional critical strike chance.

16.name: Lethal Release
16.desc: Wave of Death deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Sanguine Wave
17.desc: Wave of Death hits now leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

18.name: Corporeal Cascade
18.desc:
Wave of Death's base damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to physical resistance and physical resistance shred.
stats: Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance -> Physical Resistance Shred Chance

19.name: Skeletal Sheath
19.desc: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Bone Armor}, which grants less damage taken for the duration that Death Seal was active.

20.name: Condemnation
20.desc: Death Seal's waves of death instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold.

21.name: Blood Bond
21.desc: Minions hit by a Wave of Death deal more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.name: Soul Stability
22.desc: Death Seal prevents health loss from effects that continously drain a percentage of your current health.

23.name: The Quick And The Dead
23.desc: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Haste} for 4 seconds.

24.name: Flesh Pact
24.desc: When you release Death Seal, you recover a percentage of your missing health.

25.name: Doomcall
25.desc:
You gain a stack of {Damned} for each second you remain sealed. Waves of Death hits now deal more damage per stack of Damned on you (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit. 

You are cleansed of all Damned stacks when you release Death Seal.

26.name: Moratorium
26.desc: Death Seal's maximum duration is increased.

27.name: Seal of Servitude
27.desc: Death Seal now targets only minions.

28.name: Frenzied Accord
28.desc: When used on a minion, Death Seal also grants it more damage and critical strike chance (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Death Stranded
29.desc: Minions targeted by Death Seal are rooted in place for its duration. When Death Seal is released, the minion explodes in addition to releasing the wave of death at its location.

30.name: Devouring Release
30.desc: You now repeatedly cast {Hungering Souls} while you are sealed. Hungering Souls cast this way has a 70% chance to have only 1 projectile.

31.name: Insatiable Soul
31.desc:
You release {Hungering Souls} more frequently.

Additionally, whenever you cast Reap or Evade, you gain this effect for a percentage of Death Seal's maximum duration. Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to occur.
stats: +25% Percent Effect Duration on Reap or Evade

32.name: Frozen Form
32.desc:
The Wave of Death's base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to cold resistance and cold resistance shred.
stats: Necrotic Resistance Shred -> Cold Resistance Shred

1.name: Hunger
1.desc: Soul Feast has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

2.name: Grand Imprint
2.desc: Soul Feast no longer requires targets to be {Cursed} and no longer has a target limit, but now hits all enemies a small cone in front of you.

3.name: Winds of Affliction
3.desc: Soul Feast deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to apply {Frailty} on hit.

4.name: Grim Affliction
4.desc: Soul Feast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Soul Fragments} grant less ward.

5.name: Infernal Hunger
5.desc: If you go 2 seconds without directly casting Soul Feast you gain a stack of {Infernal Hunger}. When you next cast Soul Feast directly, all stacks of {Infernal Hunger} are consumed to cast Soul Feast an additional time per stack.

6.name: Waning Life
6.desc: Damned inflicted by Soul Feast has additional necrotic penetration.

7.name: Sharpened Influence
7.desc: Soul Feast costs less mana and can hit more targets.

8.name: Poisoned Husks
8.desc: Soul Feast's hits have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

9.name: Diseased Soul
9.desc: Casting Soul Feast grant you a chance to poison enemies with all hits for 4 seconds, but also inflicts you with poison. This buff cannot stack.

10.name: Toxic Craving
10.desc:
Soul Feast consumes poison stacks you applied on the target, granting you more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance per stack.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and can stack a maximum number of times.

Poison stacks applied by minions or other party members are not cleansed and are not counted for the buff.

11.name: Soul Seeker
11.desc: {Soul Fragments} grant additional ward based on your intelligence.

12.name: Blood Feast
12.desc:
Soul Feast's base necrotic damage is converted to physical damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

{Soul Fragments} now restore health instead of granting ward. The health restored is equal to the ward you would have been granted.

13.name: Incision
13.desc:
Soul Feast has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

Physical ailments inflicted by Soul Feast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your missing health.
stats: +1% Physical Ailment Damage per 100 Missing Health

14.name: Blood Tethers
14.desc: Soul Feast has a chance to cast {Blood Tether} on enemies it hits.

15.name: Blood from Souls
15.desc: When you kill an enemy with Soul Feast it has a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} around the target.

16.name: Hellmind
16.desc: Soul Feast has additional chance to inflict damned on hit based on your Intelligence.

17.name: No Rest for the Wicked
17.desc: When you kill a damned enemy with Soul Feast, you have a chance to grant your minions {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.
stats: 13% Minion Frenzy Chance On Damned Kills

18.name: Original Sin
18.desc: If the number of cursed enemies within 15 meters is at or below a threshold shortly after you cast Soul Feast, then a number of enemies within that range are {Marked for Death} to reach that threshold of cursed enemies.
stats: Marks For Death to reach threshold

19.name: Bones of the Accursed
19.desc: For each {Curse} on the target, Soul Feast hits grant more ward and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Wrest
20.desc: {Soul Fragments} from bosses or rare enemies grant significantly more ward.
stats: +85% Ward Granted From Rares Or Bosses

21.name: Usurp
21.desc: {Soul Fragments} from rare or boss enemies also grant you mana. Modifiers to the amount of ward granted by Soul Fragments also apply to the amount of mana gained from this node.
stats: 6 Mana Granted From Rares Or Bosses

22.name: Queen of Flies
22.desc:
When you hit a poisoned enemy with Soul Feast it spreads all stacks of your stacks of poison from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

Has no effect if you have the {Toxic Craving} node.

23.name: Engorged
23.desc: Soul Feast costs less mana and has a chance based on your current mana to draw back {Greater Soul Fragments}, which grant more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Another Strife
24.desc: When Soul Feast hits an enemy {Cursed} with {Spirit Plague}, {Decrepify}, {Marked for Death}, or {Penance} it spreads those {Cursed} from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

25.name: Celerity
25.desc: {Soul Fragments} return to you faster and Soul Feast has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 4 seconds.

26.name: Crimson Bounty
26.desc: Soul Feast can hit more targets.

27.name: Withering Maw
27.desc: Soul Feast inflicts {Withering} on hit, an ailment which increases the curse damage taken.

28.name: Thought Corrosion
28.desc:
Poison Chance from all sources is converted to armor shred for Soul Feast and armor shred applied by Soul Feast has increased effect.

The {Diseased Soul} node now inflicts you with armor shred on cast instead of poison.
stats: Poison Self on Cast -> Armor Shred

2.name: Gravecrawler
2.desc: Flay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has a chance to chill on hit.

3.name: Plasma Fountain
3.desc: Every second melee attack with Flay which hits a boss or rare enemy has a chance to trigger a Blood Eruption.
stats: +34# Blood Eruption Chance Every Second Attack

4.name: Decree of Slaughter
4.desc: Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), doubled against low life enemies.

5.name: Scent of Death
5.desc: Enemies hit by Flay are inflicted with Marked for Death for a duration, and Flay hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

6.name: Trepidation Blade
6.desc: While using a dagger, Flay has increased attack speed.

7.name: Spirit Stride
7.desc:
When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to gain Haste for 2 seconds. This chance is tripled if Flay is a traversal skill.

Flay's Spirit Step can move you from a further distance.

8.name: Open Wounds
8.desc: When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack, your active {Aura of Decay} is granted more ailment frequency (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased radius for 4 seconds.
stats: 2% Aura of Decay More Ailment Frequency

9.name: Transference
9.desc:
Hitting a boss or rare enemy with Flay's melee attack transfers your active Aura of Decay to them for up to 6 seconds.

While the aura is attached to an enemy, you can move away from it to avoid the self-inflicted ailments.
stats: Aura of Decay Transferable to Boss or Rare Enemies

10.name: Thirst of Dread
10.desc: Flay has increased area of effect and additional spell damage. These effects are doubled if there is a bleeding enemy within 15 meters.

11.name: Bloodsoaked Blade
11.desc: A percentage of the melee damage on your equipped axes or daggers is also applied as spell damage for the Blood Eruption.
stats: 25% Melee Damage On Axes Or Daggers As Spell Damage

12.name: Deadly Plot
12.desc:
Flay and all skills triggered by its skill tree deal more spell damage per 100 maximum mana. 
Flay has additional mana cost.

13.name: Chaos Rip
13.desc:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy with the melee attack has a chance per 1 maximum mana to release a {Chaos Bolt} towards an enemy.
This effect consumes 2 mana per Chaos Bolt released.
stats: 0.5% Chaos Bolt Chance per 1 Maximum Mana

14.name: Go For The Throat
14.desc: Flay has additional critical strike chance, and leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health.

15.name: Marrow Gnawer
15.desc:
Flay has additional critical strike multiplier.
Critically hitting at least one enemy with Flay's melee attack has a chance to release Marrow Shards towards another nearby enemy within 6 meters.

16.name: Corrosive Slash
16.desc: Flay inflicts {Exposed Flesh} on hit, a Curse which reduces cold resistance and armor, and increases the target's chance to be frozen.

17.name: Misfortune
17.desc: Blood Eruption has increased area of effect and deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your curses that were on the enemy.
stats: +8% Blood Eruption Increased Area per Curse
+8% Blood Eruption Hit Damage per Curse

18.name: Spirit Geyser
18.desc: Blood Eruption consumes mana to release a Wandering Spirit. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

19.name: Blood Waltz
19.desc: Blood Eruption spreads all bleeds on that enemy to a limited amount of other enemies within its range.

20.name: Hemorrhage
20.desc: Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and bleeds inflicted by Flay have increased duration.

21.name: Chill of the Grave
21.desc:
Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled or frozen enemies.

Flay has additional freeze rate per active skeleton or bone golem.
stats: +10% Hit Damage to Chilled or Frozen
+10 Freeze Rate per Skeleton or Golem

22.name: Prince of Pain
22.desc: If you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, but do not hit a boss or rare enemy, a spectral copy of Flay strikes a random nearby boss or rare enemy.
stats: Spectral Flay on nearby Boss or Rare

23.name: Spectral Nightmare
23.desc:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to trigger a spectral copy of Flay against a nearby enemy if one would not be triggered otherwise.

Spectral copies of Flay have increased area of effect.

24.name: Occult Offerings
24.desc: Directly using Flay consumes a percentage of your current health and ward. Flay gains additional melee damage per 30 health consumed and additional spell damage per 30 ward consumed by this effect, up to a limited amount of each.

25.name: Macabre Dance
25.desc:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy reduces the remaining cooldown of Reaper Form by a percentage. This can occur a limited number of times per use of Reaper Form or Reap.
stats: 3 Limit per Use of Reaper Form or Reap

26.name: Dismember
26.desc:
Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and Flay deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.name: Spirit Leap
27.desc: Flay is now a traversal skill with a cooldown. The Spirit Step can move you from a much further distance and no longer requires a target.

28.name: Doom Whisperer
28.desc: The Spirit Step is removed, and Flay has increased attack speed.

29.name: Exquisite Blood
29.desc:
Flay's melee attack is removed. Flay becomes a spell that directly creates the Blood Eruption, and is now affected by cast speed instead of attack speed.

Any modifiers to Flay's attack speed in its skill tree instead apply to cast speed.
stats: Attack Speed on Tree -> Cast Speed

30.name: Frostblight
30.desc:
Flay's base damage is converted to cold and it now has a chance to freeze. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} is allocated.

31.name: Soul Ripper
31.desc:
Flay's base damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to damned chance.

32.name: Corrupted Blood
32.desc:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} or {Frostblight} are allocated.

33.name: Blood Revelry
33.desc:
When you create a {Blood Eruption}, you gain a stack of {Blood Revelry}, up to 5. Direct uses of Harvest or Rip Blood can consume a stack of Blood Revelry to deal more damage and gain increased area of effect.

Blood Eruptions have a significantly reduced delay before erupting.
stats: +10% Harvest or Rip Blood Damage on Stack Consumed
+10% Harvest or Rip Blood Area on Stack Consumed

34.name: Hew
34.desc:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

1.name: Dread Furnace
1.desc: Ghostflame has a chance to inflict damned and ignite enemies each second.

2.name: Arteries of Malice
2.desc:
Ghostflames's base necrotic and fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic or fire damage.

Damned and ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second.

Ghostflame now drains a portion of your health each second.

Swaps Ghostflames's {Necrotic} and {Fire} tags for a {Physical} tag.

3.name: Phantom Transfusion
3.desc:
You leech a portion of the physical damage you deal as health while channeling Ghostflame.

A portion of your global bleed chance on hit now applies as bleed chance per second for Ghostflame.
stats: 50% Bleed Chance -> Bleed Chance per second

4.name: Feast of Bones
4.desc:
Damaging an enemy with Ghostflame causes you to cast {Marrow Shards} towards them.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times each second.
stats: 1 Max Marrow Shards per second against 1 target

5.name: Fuel of Anguish
5.desc:
Increases the frequency of {Marrow Shards} per second from the {Feast of Bones} node.

Improves the {Marrow Shards'} base critical strike chance cast this way.

6.name: Occult Embers
6.desc: Ghostflame has increased ignite and damned duration per point of Intelligence.

7.name: Flames of Misery
7.desc:
A portion of your global ignite chance on hit now applies as ignite chance per second for Ghostflame.

A portion of your global damned chance on hit now applies as damned chance per second for Ghostflame.
stats: 40% Ignite Chance -> Ignite Chance per second
60% Damned Chance -> Damned Chance per second

8.name: Decrepit Mortals
8.desc:
After channelling Ghostflame for a short duration, the skull releases a terrible screech, cursing all nearby enemies with {Decrepify}.

Ghost Flame gains the {Curse} tag, but its direct damage still does not scale with increased curse damage.

9.name: Horrifying Shriek
9.desc: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node has a shorter delay before being released and a larger area.

10.name: Banshee
10.desc: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node now also fears enemies and Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared enemies.

11.name: Atrocity
11.desc: Ghostflame deals more damage, but has a higher channel cost (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Disdain
12.desc: You take less damage from ignited, damned or bleeding enemies while channeling Ghostflame, but it costs more mana to channel.

13.name: Domain of Torment
13.desc: Ghostflame deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

14.name: Enfeebled Prey
14.desc:
You leech a portion of the damage you deal as health against {Cursed} enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

Additionally, Ghostflame has a chance to inflict Frailty each second.

15.name: Lingering Warmth
15.desc:
When you stop channeling Ghostflame after having channeled for at least 1 second, you gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Additionally, when you stop channeling you gain ward per {Cursed} enemy.
stats: 15 Ward Gain per Cursed enemy after Channeling

16.name: Memorial of Flames
16.desc:
After channeling for 1.1 seconds Ghostflame detaches itself, and persists for short duration without you needing to channel.

This effect ends early if you start channeling Ghostflame again.

17.name: Unending Ruin
17.desc: The duration from the {Memorial of Flames} node is longer, but Ghostflame now has an upfront mana cost.

18.name: The Burning Skull
18.desc: The detached Ghostflame now slowly seeks out nearby enemies.

19.name: Silver Oblation
19.desc: After channeling for 1 second, Ghostflame consumes a portion of your current ward, and it deals damage in a larger area per ward consumed.

20.name: Stygian Beams
20.desc:
For each 200 ward consumed by the {Silver Oblation} node you now cast a {Stygian Beam} at a nearby enemy dealing spell necrotic damage.

Enemies cannot be hit by more than 1 beam.

21.name: Spirit Kindling
21.desc:
All your {Wraiths}, {Spectres}, and {Revenants} gain a stack of {Spirit Kindling} every 0.5 seconds while they are inside Ghostflame's area of effect.

Each stack of {Spirit Kindling} lasts 5 seconds, drains health per second, and grants increased movement speed, melee attack speed, and ignite chance equal to a portion of your ignite chance.
stats: 2% Current Health Drain per second per stack
30% Ignite Chance -> Minion Ignite Chance per stack

22.name: Fiery Desecration
22.desc: Ghostflame now deals damage in a full circle around you, but it has a higher channel cost.

23.name: Spirit of Dread
23.desc: You now move towards the target location while channeling Ghostflame with increased movement speed, but it has a higher channel cost.

24.name: Harrowing Path
24.desc: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost, but you move slower while channeling Ghostflame.

25.name: Doom Surge
25.desc: You move faster while channeling Ghostflame.

26.name: Domain of Agony
26.desc: Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second you spend channeling Ghostflame.

27.name: Spectral Menace
27.desc: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost and you gain a portion of your current mana as ward each second while channeling Ghostflame.
stats: 14% Current Mana -> Ward Gain while Channeling

28.name: Wraith Form
28.desc: You gain additional dodge rating per intelligence while channeling Ghostflame, as well as more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channeling Ghostflame.
stats: +1 Dodge Rating per Intelligence while Channeling

29.name: Ethereal Blockade
29.desc: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while channeling Ghostflame.

2.name: Harrowing Blade
2.desc: Harvest hits have a chance to reduce enemy necrotic resistance, and Harvest deals more damage over time.

3.name: Life Eater
3.desc:
Harvest grants you health each time it hits a cursed enemy.

Health gained scales with your intelligence stat.
stats: 1 Health Gained Per Point Of Intelligence

4.name: Mark of the Locust
4.desc: When Harvest hits a target afflicted by Spirit Plague, it applies Withering and has a chance to spread Spirit Plague to an additional target.

5.name: Great Scythe
5.desc: Harvest has increased area of effect, and is increased further if using a two handed weapon.

6.name: Spectral Whetstone
6.desc: Improves Harvest's base critical strike chance, and increases Harvest's attack speed.

7.name: Learned Weakness
7.desc: You have increased critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier if you have hit a {Cursed} enemy with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

8.name: Steal Youth
8.desc: Critical hits with Harvest have a chance to grant Haste for 2 seconds.

9.name: Symbol of Loss
9.desc: Harvest hits deal more damage against {Cursed} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Mind Harvest
10.desc:
Harvest grants you ward when it hits a {Cursed} enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
Harvest also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Ghost Conduit
12.desc: When you directly use Harvest, you restore mana for each enemy killed or each boss or rare enemy hit.
stats: 1 Mana Restored on Boss or Rare Enemy Hit

13.name: Agonizing Siphon
13.desc:
When Harvest kills an enemy or hits at least one boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to gain a stack of {Stolen Spirit}, up to 5.

At 5 stacks, your next Harvest hit against a boss or rare enemy consumes all stacks to release a Wandering Spirit per stack.
stats: +25% Chance to Gain Stack on Kill
+25% Chance to Gain Stack on Boss or Rare Hit

14.name: Putrid Reaper
14.desc: Harvest hits have a chance to poison enemies.

15.name: Death Inside
15.desc: Harvest hits deal more hit damage per unique ailment on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit.

16.name: Crimson Death
16.desc:
Harvest's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Harvest now gains bleed chance per point of intelligence. Harvest's added damage per dexterity scaling is now added physical melee damage.

Swaps Harvest's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

17.name: Blood Bringer
17.desc: Harvest has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

18.name: Double Edged Scythe
18.desc:
When you hit an enemy with Harvest both you and the enemy are inflicted with bleed. Bleed stacks on enemies inflicted by Harvest have additional Physical Penetration.

The self-inflicted bleed does not scale with your stats.

19.name: Wraith Skin
19.desc: When you directly use Harvest and hit at least one enemy, gain a percentage of your missing health as ward.
stats: 5% Percent Missing Health Gained as Ward

20.name: Iron Mouths
20.desc: Harvest has additional critical strike chance and critical multiplier, but a percentage of your current health is also consumed on use.
stats: 5% Percent Current Health Consumed On Use

21.name: Legion of the Lich
21.desc: Minions have increased critical strike chance if you have landed a critical strike with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

22.name: Finality
22.desc: Harvest hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), and Harvest deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Seeds of Undeath
23.desc: When Harvest kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Volatile Zombie}, consuming a percentage of its mana cost. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

24.name: Undead Harvest
24.desc: Harvest hits leave a trace on enemies, causing enemies to take increased damage and be prioritized by your minions. Traces last for 5 seconds.

25.name: Blood Sculptor
25.desc: Harvest has a chance to summon a {Blood Specter} when it kills an enemy. You cannot summon more than one Blood Specter every 2 seconds.

26.name: Red Reapers
26.desc: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest have a significantly increased critical strike chance.

27.name: Spectral Feast
27.desc: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest leech a signficant portion of the damage they deal as health.

28.name: Necrotic Blood
28.desc: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest deal additional melee necrotic damage.

29.name: Shatter

30.name: Morbid Fury
30.desc: Harvest has increased attack speed, and is increased further if dual wielding.

2.name: Forbidden Pact
2.desc: Souls deal additional spell damage based on your maximum mana, but fewer Souls are created with each cast.

3.name: Isolation
3.desc: Souls are significantly larger and deal more hit damage, but only one is created with each cast.

4.name: Piercing Gaze
4.desc: Improves Hungering Souls' base critical strike chance.

5.name: Hungering Eyes
5.desc: Souls' critical strikes deal more damage.

6.name: Great Soul
6.desc: Souls are larger and deal more hit damage, but Hungering Souls costs more mana.

7.name: Soul Drain
7.desc: Souls have a chance to grant you mana when they kill an enemy.
stats: 10% Chance To Grant Mana On Kill

8.name: Mind Harvest
8.desc: Souls grant you more mana when they kill an enemy.

9.name: Focused Wrath
9.desc: Hungering Souls fires projectiles in a narrower cone.

10.name: Caustic Wretches
10.desc: Souls have a chance to poison enemies.

11.name: Decayed Mind
11.desc: Souls have an increased chance to poison enemies, and they cost less mana.

12.name: Inspired Hunger
12.desc: Directly casting Hungering Souls causes you to deal more damage over time against Possessed Enemies for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

13.name: Risen Cemetery
13.desc: Hungering Souls has a chance to fire additional projectiles.

14.name: Soul Swarm
14.desc: Hungering Souls fires additional projectiles, but costs more mana.

15.name: Dominion Of Undeath
15.desc: Hungering Souls costs less mana, and fires projectiles in a wider cone.

16.name: Life Hunt
16.desc: Hungering Souls has increased cast speed and its souls travel faster, causing them to go further before they expire.

17.name: Reaper's Gaze
17.desc:
Souls hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

18.name: Ravenous
18.desc: Souls deal additional necrotic damage on Hit.

19.name: Vengeful Souls
19.desc: You have a chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit, but Souls cast this way have a 70% chance to only have one projectile.
stats: 7% Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit
70% Chance for Single Projectile When Hit

20.name: Soul Catcher
20.desc: Hungering Souls cost less mana and has a chance to grant ward on kill.

21.name: Lament
21.desc:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you gain Ward.
stats: +3% Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit

22.name: Risen Hatred
22.desc:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you have a chance to cast it twice in quick succession.
stats: +4% Chance To Cast Hungering Souls When Hit

23.name: Grave Bond
23.desc: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least one minion.

24.name: Necromantic Emanation
24.desc: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each minion you have.

25.name: Unholy Trinity
25.desc: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have exactly three minions.

27.name: Fire Skull
27.desc:
Hungering Souls' base damage is increased and converted to fire and its hits ignite instead of possessing. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Souls deal more hit damage.

28.name: Eternal Pyre
28.desc: Ignites inflicted by Hungering Souls last longer and have additional Fire Penetration

29.name: Descent Into Madness
29.desc: Souls deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.name: Infernal Shade
0.desc: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second . Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

1.name: Ignition
1.desc: Infernal Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

2.name: Blaze Shade
2.desc: You have a chance to create a {Blaze Shade} which deals more damage in a significantly larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +200% Area of Effect with Blaze Shade

3.name: Fleeting Shade
3.desc: {Blaze Shade} deals more damage, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Fanning the Flames
4.desc: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

5.name: Lingering Flames
5.desc: If no target is within range of your target location the shade will wait up to 10 seconds for a target to come within range and then attach to it.

6.name: Purgatory
6.desc: Infernal Shade gains 15% fire penetration each second that it is unattached to a target.

7.name: Legion
7.desc:
When directly casting Infernal Shade you will create extra shades if there are nearby enemies.

Infernal Shade costs more mana to cast.

Has no effect if you have taken the Hellfire node.

8.name: Wildfires
8.desc: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced duration.

9.name: Combustion
9.desc: When Infernal Shade expires there is a large explosion which deals fire damage to nearby enemies.

10.name: Fiery Conclusion
10.desc: The explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and affects a larger area.

11.name: Flame Burst
11.desc: Infernal Shade has reduce duration and the explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires has added critical strike chance.

12.name: Heart of Fire
12.desc: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

13.name: Cackling Flames
13.desc: Infernal Shade has increased duration.

14.name: Brimstone
14.desc: Infernal Shade has a chance to slow nearby enemies each second.

15.name: Hellfire
15.desc:
Infernal Shade is now ground targeted and cannot attach to any targets.

Infernal Shade applies a stack of Fire Resistance Shred each second but now has a cooldown.

Prevents additional Shades from the Legion node being created.

16.name: Fiend Hunter
16.desc: Infernal Shade has a shorter cooldown.

17.name: Flight of Fire
17.desc: You can cast an additional Infernal Shade or Dread Shade.

18.name: Shifting Doom
18.desc: When Infernal Shade's target dies it has a chance to move to a new target.

19.name: Influence
19.desc: Infernal Shade deals damage in a larger area.

20.name: Devour in Flames
20.desc: Infernal Shade can now only attach to your minions, but your minions are also damaged by Infernal Shade.

21.name: Burn Trail
21.desc: Your minions gain {Haste} while they have an Infernal Shade attached to them.

22.name: Subjugation
22.desc: Infernal Shade deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second it has been active, up to a maximum.

23.name: Soulfire
23.desc: Infernal Shades which attach to minions have unlimited increased duration.

24.name: Manic Pyre
24.desc: Minions which have an Infernal Shade attached to them gain increased movement, attack and cast speed each second up to a maximum.

25.name: Torment Beacon
25.desc: Infernal Shade has a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second.

26.name: Baneful
26.desc: Ignited inflicted by Infernal Shade has additional Fire Penetration

27.name: Blood Shade
27.desc:
Infernal Shade's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to bleed chance and effects related to ignite now depend on bleed instead.

28.name: Corrosion
28.desc: Infernal Shade has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies each second.

2.name: Discourage
2.desc: Profane Veil's area has a chance to slow enemies each second. Additionally, you leech a portion of the global damage you deal as health while in Profane Veil.

3.name: Heretic's Flame
3.desc:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Form now has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

Swaps Profane Form's {Necrotic} tag for a {Fire} tag.

4.name: Hell Fire
4.desc: While in Profane Veil you gain a percentage of your damned, bleed, poison, slow and ignite chance on hit as chance to ignite per second for Profane Form.

5.name: Propane Form
5.desc:
You move faster equal to a portion of your chance to ignite on hit up to a maximum, but Profane Veil has a shorter duration per chance to ignite on hit up to a maximum.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

6.name: Infernal Deliverance
6.desc:
When you first damage an enemy with Profane Veil you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on them.

This effect can occur a maximum amount of times per cast of Profane Veil.

7.name: Mire of Words
7.desc: Profane Veil Immobilizes {Cursed} enemies for a short duration, but Bosses and Rare enemies will instead be chilled, rather than Immobilized.
stats: +1 Chill stacks on Cursed Rares and Bosses

8.name: Scorn
8.desc: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Cursed} enemies while in Profane Veil.

9.name: Stream of Profanity
9.desc:
Directly casting a {Curse} skill reduces Profane Veil's remaining cooldown.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times.

10.name: Sable Inquisition
10.desc: Profane Veil affects a larger area.

11.name: Profane Instruments
11.desc:
Profane Veil gains additional effects depending on the weapon type you are wielding. 

{Staff}: Increased area.
{Wand}: More damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
{Scepter}: Increased duration.
{Dagger}: Increased movement speed.
{Axe}: Kill threshold.

12.name: Visage of Terror
12.desc: You now fear nearby enemies for a short duration when you exit Profane Veil. Additionally, Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared or slowed enemies for the same duration.

13.name: Spirit Plate
13.desc: Damage reduction from armor now also applies to damage over time taken while in Profane Veil.

14.name: Seance
14.desc:
When a {Wandering Spirit} is revealed inside Profane Veil's area the {Spirit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for the rest of the {Spirit's} duration. 

Additionally, for each {Spirit} revealed inside Profane Veil's area you gain ward scaling with your necrotic resistance.
stats: 1 Ward Gain per 15% Uncapped Necrotic Res

15.name: Derision
15.desc: You gain ward per dexterity when you dodge while in Profane Veil.
stats: 2 Ward Gain on Dodge per Dex

16.name: Eternal Blasphemy
16.desc: Profane Veil lasts longer and you move faster while in it.

17.name: Singleminded
17.desc:
While in Profane Veil you move faster and it has a shorter cooldown, but you can no longer change direction while concealed and it has a shorter duration without being able to extend its duration.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

18.name: Vampiric Pool
18.desc: Profane Veil's area now consumes your minions, and consuming minions this way grants you ward equal to a portion of their maximum health as well as extending its remaining duration by a small amount.

19.name: Apocalypse
19.desc:
You now summon {Volatile Zombies} when you exit Profane Veil equal to the number of minions consumed up to a maximum from the {Vampiric Pool} node.

{Zombies} summoned deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Intelligence.

20.name: Omnivore
20.desc:
The benefits from the {Vampiric Pool} and {Apocalypse} nodes now also trigger when you kill enemies with Profane Veil.

The limit from {Vampiric Pool} remains the same.

21.name: Lake of Blood
21.desc:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% global Bleed chance on hit.

Swaps Profane Veil's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

22.name: Desecrated Graves
22.desc: You now cast {Bone Curse} when you enter and exit Profane Veil.
stats: Bone Curse on you on Enter or Exit
Bone Curse at Target Location with Forked Tongue

23.name: Forked Tongue
23.desc: You now create a secondary Profane Veil area that is detached from you and moves towards enemies, but Profane Veil now has a higher mana cost.

24.name: Second Rites
24.desc: The secondary area from {Forked Tongue} is now created at the target location, but Profane Veil costs additional mana.

25.name: Harsh Words
25.desc: Profane Veil costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Grave Circle
26.desc: Profane Veil's area now applies {Mark for Death} to enemies, but entering Profane Veil applies {Mark for Death} to you.

27.name: Mark of the Rat
27.desc: When you apply {Mark for Death} to an enemy or yourself by any method, all your stacks of damned and poison on them spread to a number of nearby enemies.

28.name: Profane Orbs
28.desc: While in Profane Veil, you consume 6 mana to cast a {Profane Orb} each second that seek out enemies.

29.name: Hex Flurry
29.desc: Increases the frequency of {Profane Orb} per 1% increased cast speed for {Curses} you have. Additionally, {Profane Orb} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Curse} on the target.
stats: +1% Profane Orb Frequency per 1% Cast Speed

30.name: Loose Tongue
30.desc: Profane Veil costs less mana.

31.name: Penitent Tangent
31.desc: Profane Veil's area inflicts {Penance} to enemies, which is a {Curse} that causes enemies to take fire damage when they hit a target. Additionally Penance deals more damage per 1% of Damage Reflected (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +5% Penance Damage per 1% of Damage Reflected

32.name: Unholy Renewal
32.desc: You now cleanse all negative ailments on you when you enter Profane Veil.

0.name: Rip Blood
0.desc: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. A {Blood Orb} is drawn back to you which restores 10 health when it reaches you.

2.name: Splatter
2.desc: Rip Blood hits have a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} at the target, dealing damage to other enemies around it that were not hit by Rip Blood. This effect can occur a limited number of times per cast of Rip Blood.

3.name: Blood Bond
3.desc: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy it attaches a {Blood Tether}, dealing physical spell damage over time.

4.name: Crimson Flood
4.desc: {Blood Splatter} deals damage in a larger area.

5.name: Revile
5.desc: Rip Blood deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Coagulation
6.desc:
When a blood orb grants health, you gain a stack of {Coagulated Blood}. Upon reaching at least 6 stacks, your next cast of Rip Blood consumes 6 stacks to form a {Coagulated Blood Orb} that seeks out a nearby enemy, dealing spell physical damage in a small area.

Additionally, Blood Tethers such as from {Blood Bond} grant 3 stacks each second.

8.name: Varicose Veins
8.desc: The {Coagulated Blood Orb} deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Gushing Wound
10.desc: Rip Blood hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed..

12.name: Blood Infusion
12.desc: {Blood Splatter} grants your minions {Blood Infusion} when it hits them. The {Blood Infusion} buff grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Necrotic Unity
13.desc: Blood Splatter has increased area for each minion you currently control, up to a maximum benefit.

14.name: Infused Frenzy
14.desc: {Blood Infusion} grants increased attack and cast speed.

15.name: Hemophagy
15.desc: {Blood Infusion} causes your minions to leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

16.name: Hemomancer
16.desc: Rip Blood has increased cast speed.

17.name: Thirst
17.desc: Rip Blood costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

18.name: Carrion Hunger
18.desc: When you are out of mana Rip Blood is free.

19.name: Quenching
19.desc: {Blood Orbs} grant additional health and the {Blood Orb} returns faster.

20.name: Hematology
20.desc: {Blood Orbs} restore more health based on your Intelligence stat.

21.name: Mana Feast
21.desc: {Blood Orbs} now also grant you mana when you directly cast Rip Blood. The amount of mana is tripled for orbs from bosses and rare enemies.

22.name: Marrow Drinker
22.desc: Rip Blood can be cast on your minions, but no longer can be cast on enemies. {Blood Orbs} restore significantly more health.

23.name: Volatility
23.desc: Rip Blood has additional critical strike chance..

24.name: Carnage
24.desc: When you directly use Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy or hit at least 3 enemies, you cast Marrow Shards in the same direction.

26.name: Arcane Absorption
26.desc: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit at least one enemy you gain additional spell damage for 6 seconds. The amount of spell damage gained is doubled for Rip Blood. This effect can stack.

27.name: Run Dry
27.desc: Rip Blood deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.name: Necrotic Inspiration
28.desc: Rip Blood deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit.

29.name: Blood Catalyst
29.desc:
When you directly cast Rip Blood and it kills at least one enemy, it will recast from that position towards another enemy, consuming Rip Blood's mana cost. These recasts can also trigger this effect.

Rip Blood no longer creates {Blood Orbs}.
stats: 100% Percent of Rip Blood Mana Cost Consumed

30.name: Rip Spirit
30.desc:
Rip Blood and {Blood Splatter's} base physical damage are converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Damned chance.

31.name: Arcane Fortress
31.desc:
{Blood Orbs} now grant ward instead of health, equal to half of the health they would have restored.

Being at or close to full health does not affect the amount of the ward the {Blood Orbs} grant.

32.name: Stench of Blood
32.desc: Rip Blood has increased cast speed leaves a stench on the target enemy that causes your minions to prioritise attacking it.

2.name: Soul for a Soul
2.desc: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage but have reduced healing effectiveness.

3.name: Ghastly Flow
3.desc: You move faster for 4 seconds after using {Reap} while below half health.

4.name: Sanguine Reaper
4.desc: {Reap} deals damage in a larger area and you leech a portion of the damage its hits deal as health.

5.name: Ravenous Doom
5.desc: While in Reaper Form you gain health from kills. This bonus is doubled for kills using {Reap}.

6.name: Reaper's Curse
6.desc: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage and have increased critical strike chance, but lose health when you kill an enemy.

7.name: Death's Door
7.desc: {Reap} deal more damage for each percent of health you are missing (multiplicative with other modifiers). You deal increased damage at low health while in Reaper Form.
stats: +1% Reap Damage Per Missing Health Percent

8.name: Dark Harvest
8.desc: {Reap} hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

9.name: Gravechill
9.desc:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} for Reap, and Reap gains a freeze rate equal to four times your intelligence.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} and {Poison} tags and gains a {Cold} t
stats: Reap Necrotic Damage per Intelligence -> Cold

10.name: Deathtouch Scythe
10.desc: While in Reaper Form, you deal additional necrotic damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

11.name: Executioner
11.desc: While in Reaper Form, your critical strikes deal more damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

12.name: Bloodmoon Reaver
12.desc:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage. You have additional physical penetration while in Reaper Form.

All poison related effects from this tree now affect bleed for Reap.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} tag and gains a {Physical} tag inst

13.name: Sweeping Scythes
13.desc: {Reap} moves you further.

14.name: Pestilence
14.desc: Reap poisons enemies. It also gains the {Poison} tag.

15.name: Venomous Coating
15.desc: {Reap} has a chance to poison enemies, and poisons you inflict while in Reaper Form last longer.

16.name: Herald of Rot
16.desc: Entering Reaper Form poisons all nearby enemies. While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to poison enemies that you hit.
stats: 1 Poison Stacks To Nearby Enemies On Transform

17.name: Haunting
17.desc: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance apply {Mark For Death} to enemies on hit. This chance is doubled for {Reap}.

18.name: Rapid Destruction
18.desc: You have increased attack, cast speed and movement speed while in Reaper Form.

19.name: Reaper's Ascendance
19.desc: Gain a stack of {Reaper’s Ascendance} every 5 seconds you spend in Reaper Form, which grants you increased spell damage. You can have up to 25 stacks of Reaper’s Ascendance at a time.

20.name: Reaper's Supremacy
20.desc: You gain stacks of Reaper’s Ascendence more frequently.

21.name: Mistress of Decay
21.desc: While in Reaper Form, your health decays more slowly and you deal increased damage over time.

22.name: Soul Shroud
22.desc: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional armor proportional to your intelligence.

23.name: Elixir of Death
23.desc: While in Reaper Form, potions grant twice as much health as normal.

24.name: Vile Shroud
24.desc: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional necrotic and poison resistance per point of intelligence.
stats: +1% Necrotic Resistance Per Point Of Intelligence
+1% Poison Resistance Per Point Of Intelligence

25.name: Phantom Restoration
25.desc: While in Reaper Form, you have more ward retention. {Reap} grants ward on hit.

26.name: Protective Spirit
26.desc: {Reaper’s Blessing} also grants ward when you transform back to your human form.

27.name: From the Grave
27.desc: Entering Reaper Form summons {Skeletons}, unless you are already at your maximum number of Skeletons.

28.name: Reaper's Blessing
28.desc: You gain ward when entering Reaper Form.

29.name: Mercy in Undeath
29.desc: Hitting minions with {Reap} heals them for the same amount that Reap would heal you if an enemy was hit.

30.name: Soul Release
30.desc: You have a chance to cast {Hungering Souls} whenever you kill an enemy with {Reap}.

31.name: Harbinger of Blood
31.desc: While in Reaper Form you have increased healing effectiveness and leech more of the damage you deal. You gain additional health on hit with {Reap}.

32.name: Unholy Dominion
32.desc: {Reap} has a much longer cooldown, but no longer shares a cooldown with other traversal skills.

34.name: Blood Tethers
34.desc: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to retaliate with {Blood Tether} when you are hit.
stats: 6% Chance To Cast Blood Tether When Hit

2.name: Soul Shatter
2.desc: Sacrifice deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Sacrifice costs more mana.

3.name: Great Sacrifice
3.desc: Sacrifice deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the sacrificed minion has more current health than you.

4.name: Last Sacrifice
4.desc: Sacrifice deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the minion you sacrifice is your only active minion.

5.name: Altar of Flames
5.desc: Sacrifice deals additional fire damage.

6.name: Infernal Vindication
6.desc: Sacrifice costs less mana and if you cast Sacrifice while you control at least one minion you gain a buff that grants you more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). This buff does not stack.

7.name: Burning Offering
7.desc: Sacrifice has a chance to ignite enemies and ignite it inflicts has additional fire penetration.

8.name: Punishment
8.desc: Sacrifice deals more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Pontifex
9.desc: Sacrifice deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

10.name: Blood Spectre
10.desc:
When you sacrifice a minion you have a chance to assemble a {Blood Spectre} from the remains. 15 mana is consumed when you summon a Blood Spectre. 

You cannot summon a Blood Spectre by sacrificing a Blood Spectre or when your mana is negative and below -100.

11.name: Blood Weaver
11.desc: {Blood Spectres} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. Blood Spectres consume less mana when summoned.

12.name: From Blood
12.desc: {Blood Spectres} summoned by Sacrifice have more maximum health and deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Crimson Horror
13.desc:
Sacrificing a minion always creates a {Blood Spectre}.

Blood Spectres summoned by Sacrifice have significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and are larger, but consume more mana when summoned.

14.name: Hemophage
14.desc: {Blood Spectres} leech a portion of the damage they deal as health. Sacrifice has a greater chance to summon a Blood Spectre.

15.name: Bone Nova
15.desc: Sacrificing a minion creates a {Bone Nova} around it, but Sacrifice costs more mana.

16.name: Bone Missiles
16.desc: {Bone Nova} has increased area of effect.

17.name: Impaling
17.desc: {Bone Nova} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Ivory Ballista
18.desc: {Bone Nova} has a chance to slow enemies hit.

19.name: Lacerating Bones
19.desc: {Bone Nova} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

20.name: Avatar of Decay
20.desc: You deal increased damage over time if you have cast Sacrifice recently (past 4 seconds). You cannot have multiple instances of this buff at once.

21.name: Temple of Awe
21.desc: Sacrifice deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

22.name: Necrotic Audience
22.desc: Sacrifice deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you have three or more minions active when you cast Sacrifice.

23.name: Catalyst of Horror
23.desc: Sacrifice is recast onto other minions within its area of effect, which can happen multiple times. Sacrifice costs more mana.

24.name: Sanguine Libation
24.desc: Sacrifice is recast onto other minions within its area of effect up to one additional time. It also has additional Bleed Chance.

25.name: Flickering Shadows
25.desc: If you cast Sacrifice while you control at least one minion all your active {Infernal Shades} have their remaining duration reduced to 2 seconds, but deal significantly more damage for their remaining duration.

1.name: Gravetide
1.desc: Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Macabre Waltz
2.desc: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your melee Wraiths and Blood Spectres, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

3.name: Underlings
3.desc: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Vanguards, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

4.name: Cryomancers
4.desc:
Adds {Cryomancers} to the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Cryomancers deal cold damage and cast {Ice Shard}.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to chill chance for Cryomancers.

5.name: Frost Lich
5.desc: Removes regular Skeletal Mages and Pyromancers from the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned, and your Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Frozen Tomb
6.desc: Skeletal Mages have an increased chance to stun enemies and an increased freeze rate.

7.name: Putrid Essence
7.desc: Skeletal Mage hits have a chance to poison enemies.

8.name: Ossein Frenzy
8.desc: Skeletal Mages have a chance to gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds when they hit an enemy.

9.name: Pyromancers
9.desc:
Adds Pyromancers to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Pyromancers deal fire damage and cast {Fireball}.
 
Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Pyromancers.

10.name: Inferno
10.desc: Your Skeletal Mages have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased attack and cast speed, but regular Skeletal Mages are removed from the summon pool of Skeletal Mages.

11.name: Flame Rot
11.desc: Ignites and poisons inflicted by Skeletal Mages last longer and have additional Penetration.

12.name: Celer Mortis
12.desc: Improves Skeletal Mages' base critical strike chance and they move faster.

13.name: Grey Merchant
13.desc: Skeletal Mages' critical strikes deal more damage, and when they critically strike they are healed for a percentage of their maximum health.

14.name: Order of Death
14.desc: You can summon more Skeletal Mages.

15.name: Leech Life
15.desc: Skeletal Mages leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Death Knights
16.desc: Adds Death Knights to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages, which uses melee necrotic attacks, and removes all other types of Skeletal Mages from the pool.

17.name: Flaming Attacks
17.desc: Death Knight melee hits deal additional fire damage.

18.name: Death Blossom
18.desc: Death Knights cast {Hungering Souls}, using your Hungering Souls tree. Hungering Souls has a 6 second cooldown when cast by Death Knights.

19.name: Undead Mortars
19.desc: Skeletal Mages cast {Necrotic Mortar}, a ranged necrotic spell with a large area of effect. Necrotic Mortar has a 6 second cooldown.

20.name: Battle Hardened
20.desc: Skeletal Mages are able to use their abilities more frequently.

21.name: Splintered Dominion
21.desc:
Skeletal Mages have a chance to fire 2 additional projectiles. 

Skeletal Mages have an increased area of effect with melee attacks.

22.name: Archmage
22.desc: You can only summon one Skeletal Mage, an Archmage, that has significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), fires twice the number of extra projectiles, and is larger.

23.name: Argonautic Speed
23.desc: Skeletal Mages attack and cast faster (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Shadow Wardens
24.desc: Skeletal Mages' gain ward over time and have a chance to avoid critical strikes.

26.name: Forbidden Arcana
26.desc: Skeletal Mages deal more damage based on your maximum mana.

27.name: Grave Passage
27.desc: When you directly cast Summon Skeletal Mage you are teleported to the target location. Summon Skeletal Mage now has a cooldown and counts as {Traversal} skill.

28.name: Death's Cavalry
28.desc: When you teleport using Summon Skeletal Mage some of your other minions are teleported with you.

0.name: Spirit Plague
0.desc: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.

2.name: Hindering Affliction
2.desc: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are now also slowed.

3.name: Plague Burst
3.desc: You have a chance to spread Spirit Plague when you hit an afflicted enemy.
stats: +10% Chance To Spread On Hitting Afflicted Enemy

4.name: Putrid Recovery
4.desc: You gain ward when hitting an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague, up to a limited number of times per second.

5.name: Agonizing Expanse
5.desc: Spirit Plague spreads when you critically strike an afflicted target.
stats: Plague Spreads On Crit Against Afflicted Target

6.name: Enfeeblement
6.desc: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with Frailty.

7.name: Contagion
7.desc: Spirit Plague is now cast in an area around the target, but costs more mana.

8.name: Plague's Purview
8.desc: Spirit Plague is cast in a larger area.

9.name: Scourge
9.desc: Spirit Plague deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer spreads.

10.name: Plague of Eyes
10.desc: Spirit Plague has additional spell necrotic damage for each point of Intelligence

11.name: Toxic Transmission
11.desc: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with poison for the same duration.

12.name: Gift of Death
12.desc: Spirit Plague has a chance to summon a {Poison Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion which lasts for 15 seconds and poisons nearby enemies.

13.name: Efficacious Application
13.desc: Spirit Plague costs less mana and lasts longer.

14.name: Discharge
14.desc: Spirit Plague spreads after a duration. (This does not affect the maximum number of spreads.)

15.name: Perpetuity
15.desc: Spirit Plague has increased cast speed and lasts longer.

16.name: Spooked
16.desc: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are also feared.

17.name: Conductor of Plagues
17.desc: Spirit Plague is now a combo skill. Directly recasting Spirit Plague within 2 seconds will cause up to 3 inflicted enemies to spread Spirit Plague to other enemies around them.

18.name: Pestilence
18.desc: You gain increased global damage over time when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

19.name: Plague Bearer
19.desc: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted by {Plague} for the same duration. {Plague} is an ailment that deals poison damage over time, spreads between enemies, and does not stack.

20.name: Queen of Plagues
20.desc: {Plague} inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Poison Penetration.

21.name: Endless Decay
21.desc: You gain increased poison damage when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

22.name: Rotten to the Core
22.desc: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Concentrated Rot
23.desc: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but spreads in a smaller area.

24.name: Calamitous
24.desc: Spirit Plague spreads to additional targets, but costs more mana.

25.name: Hemorrhage
25.desc: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with bleeding for the same duration.

26.name: Exsanguination
26.desc: Bleed inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Bleed Penetration, but you are now also inflicted with bleeding.

27.name: Defilement
27.desc: You gain mana when Spirit Plague kills an enemy.

28.name: Laceration
28.desc: You have a chance to apply bleed when you hit an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague.
stats: 30% Chance To Inflict Bleed On Afflicted Enemies On Hit

2.name: Necrotic Conviction
2.desc: Skeleton Warriors have more maximum health, while Skeleton Rogues and Archers deal more damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Aegis of Death
3.desc: When one of your Skeletons dies, another Skeleton is healed to full health.

4.name: Unbound Necromancy
4.desc: Summon Skeletons costs less mana, and your Skeletons have improved base critical strike chance.

5.name: Soul Catcher
5.desc: You gain ward whenever one of your Skeletons dies.

6.name: Mind Catcher
6.desc: You gain mana whenever one of your Skeletons dies.

7.name: Memory Catcher
7.desc: You have increased spell damage if one of your Skeletons has died recently (past 4 seconds).

8.name: Unholy Rage
8.desc: Skeletons have increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.

9.name: Lone Guardian
9.desc: Your Skeletons have increased critical strike chance, but you can only have one Skeleton Warrior summoned at once.

10.name: Mightier than the Sword
10.desc: Skeleton Warriors are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

11.name: Marrow Walkers
11.desc: You can summon more Skeletons.

12.name: Hollow Walkers
12.desc: You can summon more Skeletons.

13.name: Grave Walkers
13.desc: You can summon more Skeletons.

14.name: Shambling Steel
14.desc: Skeleton Archers are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

15.name: Fire Arrow
15.desc:
Skeleton Archers have their basic attack replaced with {Fire Arrow}, which is a more powerful bow attack that deals fire damage and ignites on hit.

Skeleton Archers have less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Multishot
16.desc: {Fire Arrow} has a chance to shoot additional projectiles.

17.name: Ice Arrow
17.desc: Converts {Fire Arrow} into {Ice Arrow}, converting its base fire damage to cold damage. Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Ice Arrow.
stats: Ignite -> Frostbite Chance for Ice Arrow

18.name: Dread Phalanx
18.desc: Skeletons deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger, but you can only summon half as many as you could before (rounded up).

19.name: Bone Armor
19.desc:
Skeleton Warriors can now cast {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

20.name: Ash and Frost
20.desc: Skeleton Archers will randomly use Fire Arrow or Ice Arrow, but have additional chance to ignite or inflict frostbite depending on the arrow used.
stats: Randomly Use Fire or Ice Arrow

21.name: Bone Share
21.desc: Skeleton Warriors can target allies with {Bone Armor}.

22.name: Marrow Tap
22.desc: Skeletons leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and they have additional physical resistance.

23.name: Empty the Graves
23.desc: You summon multiple Skeletons in a single cast, but Summon Skeleton costs more mana. This does not affect your maximum number of Skeletons.

24.name: Sweeping Strikes
24.desc: Skeletons have an increased area of effect with melee attacks, and your Skeletons deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Skeleton Rogue
25.desc: Adds Skeleton Rogues to the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned. Rogues dash to distant enemies, throw shurikens, use melee attacks, and they poison enemies on hit.

26.name: Immortal
26.desc: When a Skeleton dies, there is a chance to summon a random new one at the same location after 3 seconds.

27.name: Vile Flask
27.desc: Skeleton Rogues can now throw a {Vile Flask}, which inflicts poison and armor shred on hit. Vile Flask has a 5 second cooldown.

28.name: Individual Operator
28.desc: Skeleton Rogues deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each Skeleton Warrior or Archer you control.
stats: +25% Rogue Damage per Skeleton Warrior or Archer

0.name: Volatile Zombie
0.desc: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

1.name: Leap Attack
1.desc: Zombies now leap towards their targets, up to a maximum distance.

2.name: Fervor
2.desc: Zombies deal more damage and have more movement speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Grave Attunement
3.desc: Zombies deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the Zombies' health decays slower, but they also move slower.

4.name: Giant Zombie
4.desc: You now summon a single large zombie with more health, that deals more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.
stats: 10% Chance to Summon from Indirect Casts

6.name: Corrosive Guts
6.desc: {Vomit} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

7.name: Bone Pact
7.desc:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Marrow Shards} from the Zombie towards a nearby enemy.

Marrow Shards does not cost health when cast this way.

8.name: Repulsive Vomit
8.desc: Zombies will now {Vomit} on enemies before exploding, dealing physical and poison damage over time. Zombies lose 33% of their maximum health per second while vomiting.

9.name: Corpse Bane
9.desc: The explosion applies {Mark for Death} to enemies hit, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.
stats: Mark For Death On Explosion Hit

10.name: Dreadful Horde
10.desc: You summon additional Zombies per cast, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana and has additional cooldown duration.

11.name: Wretched Innards
11.desc: {Vomit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Army of Rot
12.desc: The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.

14.name: Path of Destruction
14.desc: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

15.name: Shepherd of Thralls
