15.desc: The explosion deals damage in a larger area and when a Zombie dies it creates a {Skeleton Vanguard}, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

16.name: Putridity
16.desc: {Vomit} has a chance to poison enemies each second based on your maximum mana.
stats: +1% Poison Chance Per Second Per 2 Maximum Mana

17.name: Vile Force
17.desc: When a Zombie dies it creates {Corpse Parasites} for 4 seconds, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

18.name: Rite of the Grave
18.desc: The explosion deals damage in a larger area, but Zombies no longer move.

19.name: Grand Sacrifice
19.desc: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Sacrifice} on another nearby minion. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost.

20.name: Forceful Commander
20.desc: You summon Zombies faster and Volatile Zombie costs less mana.

21.name: Necromantic Fervor
21.desc:
You are healed for a portion of the Zombies' maximum health when they explode. 

The amount healed is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.

22.name: Flammable Vitae
22.desc:
The explosion's base physical damage and {Vomit}'s base physical and poison damage are converted to fire. Consequently their damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical or poison damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to poison now depend on ignite instead.

23.name: Horrific Vessels
23.desc: The explosion's base physical and fire damage and {Vomit}'s base physical damage are converted to necrotic. Consequently their damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical or fire damage.

24.name: Pull of the Grave
24.desc:
Zombies instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

25.name: Army of Nightmares
25.desc: The explosion now fears enemies for a short duration.

26.name: Effigy of Combustion
26.desc: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on an enemy near the zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Infernal Shade's mana cost.

27.name: Ferocious Horde
27.desc: Zombies have increased movement speed per point of missing health, but their health decays faster.

28.name: Ravenous
28.desc: The explosion's hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.
stats: +30% Hit Damage to Bosses And Rare Enemies

29.name: Emerging Terrors
29.desc: You have a chance to cast {Dread Shade} on Zombies created by a direct cast of Volatile Zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Dread Shade's mana cost.
stats: 34# Dread Shade Chance for Direct Casts

31.name: Awakening Presence
31.desc: When a minion dies you have a chance to cast Volatile Zombie at its location, expending its mana cost.
stats: +10% Chance to Cast Volatile Zombie On Minion Death

32.name: Vital Ward
32.desc: {Necromantic Fervor} now grants ward rather than health. The amount of ward gained is not affected by increased healing effectiveness.
stats: Health -> Ward From Zombie Max Health

2.name: Locus Of Resurrection
2.desc: {Wraiths} appear at the target location, but Summon Wraith costs more mana.

3.name: Locus Of Death
3.desc: {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased melee attack speed, but are unable to move.

4.name: Dark Scythe
4.desc: {Wraiths} have more melee attack speed (multiplicative with other modifers).

5.name: Echoes Inside
5.desc: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} with each cast, but Summon Wraith also costs more mana and now has a cooldown.

6.name: Stygian River
6.desc: Summon Wraith has a shorter cooldown, and there is a shorter delay between each {Wraith} being summoned.

7.name: Army of Wraiths
7.desc: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} per cast, but costs more mana.

8.name: Spectral Ambush
8.desc: Removes the delay between each {Wraith} being summoned, but fewer Wraiths are summoned per cast (rounded up).

9.name: Haunting
9.desc: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Twin Spirits
10.desc: {Wraiths'} health no longer decays, but you are limited to only 2 wraiths.

11.name: Sanguine Spirits
11.desc: Bleed inflicted by {Wraiths} has increased effect and duration.

12.name: Sequel of Avarice
12.desc: {Wraiths} are larger, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and hit a larger area with their melee attacks.

13.name: Covenant of Souls
13.desc: You can control more {Wraiths} at once.

14.name: Reapers
14.desc: {Wraiths} deal additional necrotic damage with attacks and spells.

15.name: Wraith Bringer
15.desc: Summon Wraith has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

16.name: Fallen Reclamation
16.desc: {Wraiths} move faster.

17.name: Flame Wraith
17.desc: You have a chance to instead summon a {Flame Wraith}, which casts fireballs. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Spirit Link
18.desc: {Wraiths} have improved base critical strike chance, and when you cast Summon Wraith you gain increased critical strike chance equal to its mana cost for 4 seconds.

19.name: Dawn of the Fall
19.desc: {Wraiths} have additional critical strike chance and leech a portion of the damage they deal with crits as health

20.name: Dusk of the Living
20.desc: {Wraiths'} critical strikes deal more damage.

21.name: Necrotic Hunger
21.desc: {Wraiths} deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and leech a portion of the necrotic damage they deal as health.

22.name: Grave Reality
22.desc: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Summon Wraith costs more mana and has reduced cast speed.

23.name: Noxious Blades
23.desc: {Wraiths}' have additional posion penetration and their melee attacks have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

24.name: Putrid Wraith
24.desc: You have a chance to instead summon a {Putrid Wraith}, which Poisons enemies from a distance. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Delay the End
25.desc: {Wraiths}' health decays more slowly.

26.name: Wraith Feast
26.desc: Your critical strikes restore health to your {Wraiths}.

28.name: Serrated Scythes
28.desc: {Wraiths} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed on hit.

29.name: Spectre of Death
29.desc: {Wraiths} have a chance to apply {Damned} to nearby enemies on death.

30.name: One Foot in the Grave
30.desc: Gain ward for each {Wraith} summoned, but their health decays more quickly.

2.name: Bone Armor
2.desc:
When you use Transplant you are granted {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which causes you to take less damage.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

4.name: Fleeting Form
4.desc: Transplant has increased cast speed and cooldown recovery speed.

5.name: Apostasy
5.desc: {Bone Armor} lasts longer.

6.name: Drink Deep
6.desc: Transplant's health cost is regenerated over 4 seconds, but costs significantly more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Marrow Blades
7.desc: Your minions deal additional melee damage for 4 seconds after you cast Transplant.

8.name: Simulacrum
8.desc: You leave behind a {Bone Minion}, which is a temporary melee minion, when you use Transplant, but your previous body no longer detonates. Other detonations still behave normally.

9.name: Transfusion
9.desc: You may Transplant to minions, which sacrifices the minion. Sacrifice cast this way uses your Sacrifice Tree and deals more damage than usual (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Purgatory
10.desc: {Bone Minions} last until killed, but you may have only 1 active at a time.

11.name: Ivory Court
11.desc: You can summon more {Bone Minions}.

12.name: Scarlet Rain
12.desc: Transplant’s detonations deal damage in a larger area.

13.name: Cursed Exile
13.desc: Transplant deals more hit damage to cursed enemies. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Bone Curse restore health. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Spirit Plague grant ward.

14.name: Ethereal Body
14.desc: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

15.name: Squeamish
15.desc: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on departure.

16.name: Thanatophobia
16.desc: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on arrival.

17.name: Reign of Blood
17.desc: Transplant creates an additional body that detonates on arrival.

18.name: Acolyte's Fervor
18.desc: Casting Transplant grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a short duration.

19.name: Doom Bringer
19.desc: You cast Bone Curse around the target location after you arrive.

20.name: Hemophilia
20.desc: Explosions cause enemies to bleed, but using Transplant also causes you to bleed.

21.name: Sticky Blood
21.desc: Transplant detonations leave a {Pool of Blood} for 3 seconds that slows enemies.

22.name: Anemia
22.desc: Transplant costs less health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Siphon
23.desc: {Pools of Blood} heal you for a percentage of your total health when you walk on them.
stats: +3% Pool of Blood Maximum Health Heal

24.name: Dance of Blood
24.desc: You automatically cast {Rip Blood} at enemies nearby where you depart, but Transplant costs more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). An enemy cannot be hit by multiple instances of Rip Blood created this way.

25.name: Azure Veins
25.desc: When you hit an enemy with Transplant you regain mana, but lose a portion of your current health and ward.

26.name: Pale Blood
26.desc: Transplant restores mana, but has a longer cooldown.

27.name: Flesh Marquis
27.desc: Transplant detonation hits deal more damage, especially to bleeding enemies.

28.name: Forced Fruition
28.desc: When you are out of mana, Transplant detonations deal more damage.

30.name: Violent Emergence
30.desc:
Transplant explosions instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

32.name: Frozen Form
32.desc: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

2.name: Thin Veil
2.desc: Wandering Spirits reveals Spirits more frequently.

3.name: Tethered Existence
3.desc: Spirits deal more damage when they pass through enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers), but move slower.

4.name: Drifting Spirits
4.desc: Spirits are revealed in a larger radius around you.

5.name: Infectious Dead
5.desc: The base necrotic damage dealt by Wandering Spirits is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

6.name: Familiar Souls
6.desc: Spirits are revealed in a smaller radius around the player and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Lingering Souls
7.desc: Spirits last longer when they are revealed.

8.name: Drained Will
8.desc: Wandering Spirits shred the necrotic resistance of enemies near them.
stats: 30% Necrotic Resistance Shred Chance Per Second

9.name: Terrifying Presence
9.desc: Enemies near Spirits are {Feared} for 0.5 to 0.9 seconds, causing them to flee from the spirit that feared them.

10.name: Harrowing Aura
10.desc: Spirits can Fear enemies in a larger radius. If spirits inflict {Necrotic Resistance Shred} or {Damned} those ailments are also inflicted in a larger radius.

11.name: False Courage
11.desc: Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the fear they apply to enemies via the {Terrifying Presence} node has a shorter duration.

12.name: Haunting
12.desc: Fear applied to enemies via the {Terrifying Presence} node lasts longer, but affects a smaller area.

13.name: Prey On Fear
13.desc: Spirits deal more damage to feared or possessed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +16% Damage To Feared Or Possessed Enemies

14.name: Medium
14.desc: Wandering Spirits has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

15.name: Eternal Haunt
15.desc: Wandering Spirits continues to reveal Spirits for a longer duration, but has a longer cooldown.

16.name: Daunting Presence
16.desc:
Each Spirit is larger and deals damage in a larger area.

If you have {Terrifying Presence}, the area for inflicting fear is also increased.

17.name: Sheltering Spirits
17.desc: You gain Ward whenever a Spirit expires.

18.name: Infusing Souls
18.desc: You have a chance to gain mana whenever a Spirit expires.

19.name: Souls of Rage
19.desc: Spirits move faster and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Poisoned Minds
20.desc: Spirits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Spectral Putrescence
21.desc: Spirits have a chance to cast {Spectral Putrescence} at nearby enemies each second. Spectral Putrescence is a projectile with 100% chance to poison on hit.

22.name: Spectral Scorn
22.desc: Spirits cast {Spectral Putrescence} at enemies from further away.

23.name: Soul Of Filth
23.desc: Spirits can cast {Spectral Putrescence} more frequently.

24.name: Locus Mortis
24.desc: Spirits are now revealed around a target location, rather than around you. Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Reap the Damned
26.desc: Spirits deal more damage to cursed enemies and damned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.name: Song of the Lost Chantry
28.desc: Wandering Spirits is now a channelled skill, has a much shorter cooldown, and creates Spirits much more frequently. You can regenerate mana while channelling this skill.

30.name: Spirit Swarm
30.desc: Wandering Spirits has a shorter cooldown

31.name: Sins of the Forgotten
31.desc: Wandering Spirits inflict enemies around them with {Damned}.

2.name: Flow
2.desc: You have increased dodge rating, and you gain health when hitting an enemy.

3.name: Draining Arrows
3.desc: You have increased bow attack speed and when you use a bow attack and hit at least one enemy you regain health.

4.name: Spell Breaker
4.desc: You have a chance to parry hits, and increased mana regeneration.

6.name: Swift Assassin
6.desc: Your melee, throwing, and bow attacks have increased attack speed and deal additional physical damage.

7.name: Evasion
7.desc: You take less damage while moving (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased dodge rating.

8.name: Agility
8.desc: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for one second on hit and deal increased damage based on your increased movement speed.
stats: 0.2% Increased Damage per 1% Increased Movement Speed

9.name: Dodge and Parry
9.desc: You have additional dodge rating and a chance to receieve a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

10.name: Twin Blade
10.desc: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword or dagger in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +20% Attack And Cast Speed While Dual Wielding

11.name: Duelist
stats: 4% Increased Dodge Rating while Dual Wielding

12.name: Lethal Cadence
12.desc: Every third melee, throwing, or bow attack deals increased damage.

13.name: Poison Tipped
13.desc: You have a chance to poison on hit while you have a dagger or bow equipped.

14.name: Sapping Strikes
14.desc: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain health and mana.

15.name: Critical Precision
15.desc: You have increased critical strike chance per sword, bow, or dagger you have equipped.
stats: 8% Increased Critical Strike Chance per Sword
8% Increased Critical Strike Chance per Dagger
12% Increased Critical Strike Chance with a Bow

16.name: Disembowel
16.desc: Every third non-channelling melee, throwing, or bow attack also inflicts bleed.

17.name: Coated Blades
17.desc: When you directly use a melee or bow attack that costs mana, it consumes additional mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Thiefguard
18.desc: You have additional health and whenever you receive a glancing blow you recover health.

21.name: Focus Fire
21.desc: You have additional Dexterity and when you hit a boss or rare enemy you reduce its dodge rating for 8 seconds.

22.name: Concentration
22.desc: By default you have {Concentration} which grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you are hit by an enemy within 4m you lose concentration for 4 seconds. Subsequent hits do not reset the cooldown.

23.name: Missile Mastery
23.desc: You have increased bow and throwing attack damage and you have a chance to shred armour on hit.

24.name: Elemental Arrows
24.desc: If you have a bow equipped you gain 1 {Elemental Arrow} per second, up to a maximum of 3. Using a bow attack expends an Elemental Arrow to deal additional bow fire damage and bow lightning damage.

25.name: Wound Maker
25.desc: You have a chance to inflict Critical Vulnerability on hit.

26.name: Prolonged Demise
26.desc: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). While wielding a bow you deal increased damage over time.
stats: +7% Damage Over Time while wielding a Bow

27.name: Storm Fletcher
27.desc: If you have a bow equipped you deal increased elemental damage and gain {Elemental Arrows} more frequently.

29.name: Siege Quiver
29.desc: You can hold additional {Elemental Arrows} and you gain ward per {Elemental Arrow} when you use them.

30.name: Heightened Senses
30.desc: You have a chance to avoid critical strikes and your critical strikes with bow attacks deal more damage.

31.name: Reflection
bonus: 10% Less Hit Damage Taken With Concentration

32.name: Elemental Barrage
32.desc: You can consume [1] additional {Elemental Arrow} with each bow attack. If you consume 3 arrows with a single attack it has 200% additional shock and ignite chance
stats: +1 Elemental Arrow consumed per bow attack
bonus: 200% Shock and Ignite chance when consuming 3 Arrows

33.name: Arrow Storm
33.desc: When you use a bow attack you gain {Arrow Storm} which increases your bow attack speed for 3 seconds. You can only gain Arrow Storm once every 10 seconds.
stats: 10% Increased Bow Attack Speed with Arrow Storm

23.desc: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Detonating Arrow} to deal damage in a significantly larger area.

24.name: Crippling Arrows
24.desc: Picking up a {Black Arrow} slows nearby enemies for a short duration.

25.name: Fend Off
25.desc: Picking up a {Black Arrow} knocks nearby enemies back 4 meters.

26.name: Accessible
26.desc: {Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.

27.name: Quickened Arrows
27.desc: You instantly summon a number of {Black Arrows} on use. The rest are spread out over the normal duration.

28.name: Until Dawn
28.desc: Using a bow attack grants you a chance to summon a {Black Arrow} at a random nearby location. This effect has a 3 second cooldown.
stats: 5% Arrow On Bow Skill Use Chance

29.name: Tide of Darkness
29.desc: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Hail of Arrows} to deal increased damage over time equal to twice your critical strike chance.

30.name: Perfect Bolts
30.desc:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} additional bow physical damage while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

31.name: Keen Shots
31.desc:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} increased attack speed while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

32.name: Heavy Artillery
32.desc: {Ballistae} that have been buffed by at least 4 {Black Arrows} always critically strike.

34.name: Bleak Arrow
34.desc: Using a Black Arrow grants your next {Heartseeker} additional {Recurve} chance.

2.name: Ash Compartment
2.desc: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits shred enemy fire resistance.

3.name: Hold This
3.desc:
Whenever you hit an enemy with any melee attack, you attach an Explosive Trap to that enemy.

This effect has a 1.5 second cooldown and attached traps explode after 1 second ignoring arming time or when the enemy it's attached to dies. Enemies cannot have more than 1 trap attached.

4.name: Aspect of the Rabbit
4.desc:
Attached traps deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If the enemy that the Explosive Trap is attached to hits you, it now attaches to you instead (but will still only damage enemies). Hitting an enemy then attaches it back to them without changing the delay before exploding.

Additionally, when it explodes, the trap deals 30% more damage for each time it has been passed.

5.name: Arrow Traps
5.desc:
When an Explosive Trap detonates, all other Explosive Traps now also detonate in quick succession and fire {Detonating Arrows} at the original target trap's location. The Detonating Arrows can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Detonating Arrow's} mana cost.

6.name: Blasting Device
6.desc: {Detonating Arrows} fired this way deal additional bow damage per 3 Dexterity.

7.name: Static Mines
7.desc:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

8.name: Lightning Bomb
8.desc: Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to shock enemies and inflict them with a {Spark Charge}.

9.name: Traps
9.desc:
When directly using Explosive Trap, an unconverted Explosive Trap and a trap corresponding to each conversion node you have taken are thrown at the same time. Traps thrown this way are thrown in a small area.

Additionally, Explosive Trap deals less damage in a smaller area (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and cost additional mana.

10.name: Coldsnap Mines
10.desc:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to cold resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

11.name: Flash Frozen
11.desc:
Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to chill enemies.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has additional freeze rate per Intelligence.

12.name: Freezing Trap
12.desc:
When you directly throw Explosive Trap, its hits always freeze enemies, but it now has a cooldown.

Whenever you freeze an enemy with any skill, a portion of Explosive Trap's remaining cooldown is recovered.

13.name: Tinkerer's Design
13.desc: Explosive Trap is now triggered from farther away and deals damage in a larger area.

14.name: Adaptive Fuse
14.desc:
Particularly fast enemies (with a movement speed above 6 meters per second) trigger Explosive Traps instantly, even if they haven't armed.

Additionally, Explosive Trap's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to moving enemies.

15.name: Prepared Demolition
15.desc: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second it has existed before detonating up to a maximum.

16.name: Gadgeteer
16.desc: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the arming time is not ignored, but it takes longer for it to arm before it can detonate.

17.name: Smoke Traps
17.desc: When an Explosive Trap detonates, if it hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to grant you a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. This chance increases for each second it spends arming.
stats: 30% Dusk Shroud chance gained per second

18.name: Umbral Saboteur
18.desc: Explosive Trap deals additional throwing damage per stack of {Dusk Shroud} you have.

19.name: Jelkhor's Blueprint
19.desc: Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.

20.name: Sky Signal
20.desc:
Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon} gains physical and elemental penetration for a short duration.

This effect can trigger up to a maximum of 15 times within 3 seconds.

21.name: Free Lofting Bird
21.desc: Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon's} skills recover a portion of their remaining cooldowns.

22.name: No Man's Land
22.desc:
Whenever you directly throw Explosive Trap, you now throw traps, up to your maximum number of traps, in a wide area around the target location.

Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per maximum traps, but it now has a cooldown and costs more mana per maximum trap.

23.name: Minefield
23.desc: You can now have more active Explosive Traps.

24.name: Clustered Explosives
24.desc: When you directly use Explosive Trap you throw additional traps, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

25.name: Subtle Sabotage
25.desc: Explosive Trap costs less mana, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a smaller area.

26.name: Blast Rain
26.desc:
You now shoot arrows attached with Explosive Traps up into the air that then drop down around the target location.

Explosive Trap now scales with your bow damage instead of throwing damage and your bow attack speed instead of throwing attack speed.

This requires wielding a bow.

27.name: Impact Trigger
27.desc:
Explosive Traps now instantly detonate when the arrows hit the ground via the {Blast Rain} node, ignoring the arming time.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has a higher chance to stun enemies.

28.name: Trap Sprinkler
28.desc: Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it has a chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap at its location as long as there is an enemy within 6 meters, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

29.name: Automated Bombardment
29.desc:
Explosive Trap has an additional chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap via the {Trap Sprinkler} node, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

Traps dropped this way cannot drop more additional traps.

30.name: Siege Engineering
30.desc:
Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it now has a chance to create a {Ballista} for you.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Ballista's} mana cost.

31.name: Trapuchet
31.desc:
Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node are now flung at a nearby enemy within 12 meters instead of being dropped.

Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node can now drop Explosive Traps when there's an enemy within 12 meters even if there is not an enemy within 6 meters.

32.name: Instrument of the Alchemist
32.desc:
When an Explosive Trap drops a trap by the {Trap Sprinkler} node, it also flings an {Acid Flask} for you towards the target location.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Acid Flask's mana cost.

2.name: Volley
2.desc: Hail of Arrows deals damage in a larger area

3.name: Blot Out the Sun
3.desc: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while inside the area, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

4.name: Fight in the Shade
4.desc: Hail of Arrows now also grants a stack of {Dusk Shroud} to allies each second for 2 seconds while inside the area.

5.name: Skystrike
5.desc: Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage, but costs more mana. This does not scale with damage over time.

6.name: Silver Arrows
6.desc: Improves {Barrage of Arrows'} base critical strike chance.

7.name: Condemn
7.desc: {Barrage of Arrows} immobilizes enemies for a short duration. Rare enemies and bosses are slowed instead.

8.name: Blighted Arrows
8.desc: Hail of Arrows has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies each second.

9.name: Sundering Rain
9.desc: Hail of Arrows has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

10.name: Lethality
10.desc: Hail of Arrows has a chance to inflict enemies with {Crit Vulnerability} each second.

11.name: Arsonist
11.desc: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Scorched Earth
12.desc:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to bleed now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to cold with

13.name: Pristine Fletcher
13.desc: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Soul Stealer Arrows
14.desc: Hail of Arrows leeches a portion of the bow damage it deals as health.

16.name: Focus
16.desc: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Quick Draw
17.desc: Hail of Arrows costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Backup Volley
18.desc: You can store additional charges of Hail of Arrows, but it has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Deadly Draw
19.desc: Hail of Arrows costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown, but has a longer delay before the arrows fall.

20.name: Tear Flesh
20.desc: Hail of Arrows has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

21.name: Aim for the Heart
21.desc: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.

22.name: Arrow Spray
22.desc: Hail of Arrows now fall in a forward advancing rectangle area rather than a circle.

23.name: Pin Down
23.desc: Hail of Arrows has a chance to slow enemies each second.

24.name: Crystal Arrows
24.desc:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies each second.

All slow chance from this tree is converted to chill chance and effects related to slow now depend on chill instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

This has no e

25.name: Frost Shots
25.desc: Hail of Arrows has increased chance to freeze enemies each second and has increased chill duration.

26.name: Steady
26.desc: Hail of Arrows lasts longer.

27.name: Nowhere to Hide
27.desc: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) over its duration scaling up to a maximum. This does not affect damaging ailments.

28.name: The Hunt
28.desc:
Hail of Arrows lasts significantly longer (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you can only have one Hail of Arrows active at a time. 

Using Hail of Arrows again causes the old instance to stop.

29.name: Endless Barrage
29.desc:
Hail of Arrows is now channeled and can be retargeted while you are channelling. It costs less initial mana, but rapidly drains your mana.

Channelled Hail of Arrows' delay is halved, and increases to its delay are halved.

30.name: Acid Rain
30.desc:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

31.name: Venom Arrows
31.desc: Hail of Arrows has a chance to poison enemies each second.

32.name: Headshot
32.desc: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers). This does not affect ailment damage.

1.name: Marking Strikes
1.desc: Your Falcon's other hits now have a chance to inflict {Falconer's Mark}.
stats: 10% Falcon Chance to inflict Falconer's Mark

2.name: Falconer's Mark
2.desc: Whenever the Falcon hits an enemy with {Falcon Strikes} it {Marks} them. Your next hit against a {Marked} target deals more damage and consumes the {Mark}.

4.name: Avian Arsenal
4.desc:
When you consume a {Falconer's Mark} your Falcon gains additional melee damage equal to a portion of your added melee damage, throwing damage, bow damage, or spell damage depending on the type of ability used to consume the mark.

This effect lasts 10 seconds and can stack a limited number of times.

5.name: Toxic Airdrop
5.desc:
Your Falcon now throws {Acid Flasks} for you. {Acid Flasks} thrown by the Falcon scale with your stats and your {Acid Flask} tree, but can apply {Falcon's Mark} from {Marking Strikes}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Acid Flask's} mana cost and has a 6 second cooldown.

6.name: Flask Satchel
6.desc: Your Falcon has additional {Acid Flask} charges.

7.name: Parrotkin
7.desc: When you directly use {Acid Flask} your Falcon has a chance to gain additional {Acid Flask} charges.
stats: 25% Chance to grant Falcon Acid Flask Charges

8.name: Falconer's Journey
8.desc: Your Falcon deals more global damage per character level and per point of Dexterity (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Is it a bird?
9.desc:
Your Falcon deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This effect is tripled for {Falcon Strikes}.

10.name: Watchful Eye
10.desc: Your Falcon now more heavily prioritizes enemies close to you during combat.

11.name: Sidekick
11.desc: Your Falcon now heavily prioritizes enemies close to the target location of your most recent melee, throwing or bow attack.
stats: Falcon Prioritizes close to Recent Target

12.name: Agile Prey
12.desc:
Your Falcon deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is tripled against moving targets.

13.name: Dark Plumage
13.desc: When your Falcon hits an enemy it has a chance to drop a {Black Arrow} at its location.
stats: 10% Black Arrow chance on Falcon Hit

14.name: Rending Talons
14.desc: A portion of your chance to inflict bleed, poison, shred armor, shred resistances, and slow on hit now also apply to your Falcon's hits.

15.name: Feather Knives
15.desc:
Your Falcon now uses {Feather Knives} at nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Your Falcon also throws a single Feather Knife whenever you consume {Falconer's Mark}.

16.name: Sky Chaser
16.desc: A portion of your global throwing attack speed now applies to the Falcon's {Feather Knives} ability as increased cooldown recovery speed.
stats: 75% Throwing Attack Speed -> Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed

17.name: Trained to Hunt
17.desc: A portion of the highest of your global increased melee damage, increased throwing damage, or increased bow damage now apply to all your Falcon's damage.

18.name: Go For the Eyes!
18.desc: Your critical strike chance modifiers now also apply to your {Falcon}, but at a reduced ratio.

19.name: Exposed Weakness
19.desc:
When you use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and critically strike at least one enemy, your Falcon gains a portion of your global melee, throwing, or bow critical strike multiplier respectively for 10 seconds.

This effect can occur at most twice every two second.
stats: 25% Crit Multi -> Falcon Crit Multi Buff after Attack

20.name: Side by Side
20.desc: When you directly use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and hit at least one enemy, you reduce a portion of {Falcon Strike's} remaining cooldown.
stats: -3% Remaining Cooldown Reduction after skill use

21.name: Falcon Screech
21.desc: After the first hit of {Falcon Strike} your Falcon lets out a {Screech} which slows and applies {Frailty} to enemies around it.

22.name: Frightful Feathers
22.desc:
Your Falcon's {Screech} now also fears enemies it hits.

Additionally, your Falcon moves to you when a hit leaves you at low health, and this effect will interrupt any skill it is currently using.

This effect can occur at most every 10 seconds.
stats: Falcon Screech on you at Low Health

23.name: Avian Stamina
23.desc: {Falcon Strikes} hits addtional times and your {Falcon} has increased melee attack speed.

24.name: Bird of Prey
24.desc:
{Falcon Strikes} instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

25.name: Razor Wings
25.desc: {Falcon Strikes} now cause your Falcon to swoop down in a line in front of you attacking all enemies in that line rather than hitting enemies individually.

26.name: Wingspan
26.desc:
A portion of your global increased area for area skills now applies to the width of {Falcon Strikes}.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have directly used an area skill in the past 8 seconds.
stats: +20% Falcon Strikes Damage after Area skill use

27.name: The Blood Dance
27.desc:
If {Falcon Strikes} kills an enemy it will hit an additional time.

Additionally, when {Falcon Strikes} hits a boss or rare enemy it has a chance to hit an additional time.
stats: +1 Additional Falcon Strikes hits on kill
+1 10% chance for Additional hits on Boss or Rares

28.name: Hunter's Spoils
28.desc: When your Falcon kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy it restores health and mana to you based on your total attributes. This effect can occur from hits a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

29.name: Wake of Wings
29.desc:
When you consume {Falconer's Mark} you gain the {Falcon's Wake} buff for a short duration. 

This buff grants you increased movement speed, attack and cast speed.

30.name: Falcon's Gale
30.desc: Consuming a {Falconer's Mark} instantly recovers {Falcon Strike's} cooldown, but it now also costs additional mana.

0.name: Flurry
0.desc: A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.

2.name: Alacrity
2.desc: Flurry has increased attack speed.

3.name: Relentless
3.desc: You have increased attack speed for each hit you dealt with your previous flurry, up to a maximum.

4.name: Kineticism
4.desc: Enemies killed by Flurry have a chance to release a {Kinetic Burst} around the target, dealing physical damage.
stats: +10% Chance for Kinetic Burst on Kill

5.name: Deep Strikes
5.desc: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifers).

6.name: Blood Revelry
6.desc: Flurry leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

7.name: Adrenaline Rush
7.desc: Flurry strikes have a chance to grant you {Adrenaline Rush}, granting Flurry 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 5% increased attack speed. This lasts for 4 seconds, can stack up to 4 times.

8.name: Bloodplay
8.desc: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

9.name: Giant Slayer
9.desc: Eack stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants Flurry more hit damage against bosses and rare enemies.
stats: 15% More Damage to Bosses per Stack

10.name: Inexhaustible
10.desc: {Adrenaline Rush} lasts longer.

11.name: Strained Reflexes
11.desc: {Adrenaline Rush} can have multiple stacks.

12.name: Lethal Vector
12.desc: Damaging ailments inflicted by Flurry deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Boundless Blows
13.desc: Flurry is now a channelled ability that costs mana per second to maintain.

14.name: Accelerating Impact
14.desc: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled up to a maximum.

15.name: Pavise
15.desc: You have additional physical and elemental resistances while channelling Flurry.

16.name: Arrow Storm
16.desc: If you are using a bow you fire arrows faster, but they are less accurate.

17.name: Vile Tactics
17.desc:
Flurry's first strike has a chance to inflict poison.
Flurry's second strike has a chance to cause bleed.
Flurry's third strike has a chance to shred physical and poison resistance.
stats: +20% Third Strike Poison Res Shred Chance
+20% Third Strike Physical Res Shred Chance

18.name: Reopened Wounds
18.desc: Bleed inflicted by Flurry has additional Physical Penetration.

19.name: Compounding Toxin
19.desc: Poison inflicted by Flurry has additional Poison Penetration.

20.name: Shockwave
20.desc: If you are using a melee weapon Flurry now causes {Force Waves} to blast forward with each strike, dealing melee physical damage.

21.name: Billowing Waves
21.desc: The {Force Waves} travel further.

22.name: Precision
22.desc: Improves Flurry's base critical strike chance.

23.name: Incision
23.desc: Flurry critical strikes deal more damage.

24.name: Stolen Endurance
24.desc: Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.

25.name: Second Wind
25.desc: Flurry grants health when hitting at least one enemy.

26.name: Sap Willpower
26.desc: Flurry grants mana when hitting at least one enemy.

27.name: Hamstring
27.desc: Flurry's third strike Slows enemies hit.

28.name: Crescendo
28.desc: Flurry's first and second strike deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Fusillade
29.desc: If you are using a bow, every 6th arrow is replaced with {Multishot}.

1.name: Bloodseeker
1.desc: You leech a portion of Heartseeker's damage and it has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

2.name: Decimating Spike
2.desc: Heartseeker has additional critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

3.name: Bonepiercer
3.desc: Heartseeker deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

4.name: Exposed
4.desc: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to apply frailty and shred enemy armor, but it no longer seeks new targets when the first target dies.

5.name: Straight Through
5.desc: When Heartseeker's target dies, you shoot {Puncture} at a nearby enemy for each {Recurve} it would have triggered after the target died.

6.name: Hidden Skewer
6.desc: Heartseeker has a chance on {Recurve} to grant you a {Dusk Shroud}, up to a maximum every 2 seconds.

7.name: Gloom Needle
7.desc: When you directly use Heartseeker and hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to consume one of your {Shadows} to use Heartseeker at the same target.

8.name: Returning Darkness
8.desc:
After a Heartseeker arrow {Recurves} at least 3 times, it has a chance to leave a {Black Arrow} between you and the target enemy if the enemy is at least 6 meters away.

This effect can occur a limited number of times every 3 seconds.

9.name: Against All Odds
9.desc: Heartseeker's hits cannot be dodged and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Controlled Icicle
10.desc:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to cold and it now has a base freeze rate. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Heartseeker.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

11.name: Icy Impaler
11.desc: Heartseeker's hits have a higher chance to freeze and have a chance to chill enemies.

12.name: Frozen Splinter
12.desc: Heartseeker penetrate additional cold resistance scaling with your cold overcapped resistance.
stats: +1% Cold Penetration Per 10% Overcapped Cold Res

13.name: Molten Arrowstorm
13.desc:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

14.name: Blades of the Pyre
14.desc: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you a {Burning Dagger} on {Recurve} consuming mana.

15.name: Dragonfang
15.desc: Consecutive {Recurves} each grant a stack of {Dragonfang} for 10 seconds. Higher stacks can only be achieved by a higher amount of consecutive {Recurves}, up to a maximum of 20.

16.name: Fury of the Hunt
16.desc:
Directly using Heartseeker and hitting at least one enemy grants you frenzy for a short duration. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

17.name: Heartdrain
17.desc: When directly used, Heartseeker arrows have a chance to grant mana and health on hit.

18.name: Swift and Sure
18.desc: Heartseeker has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

19.name: Blightshot
19.desc: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to poison enemies and poison it inflicts last longer.

20.name: Heartrender
20.desc: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed it inflicts penetrate enemy physical resistance.

21.name: Seeping Wounds
21.desc: Heartseeker deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

22.name: The Red Veil
22.desc: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you {Crimson Shroud} on {Recurve}.

23.name: Arrow Mastery
23.desc: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

24.name: Arrow of the Ravager
24.desc: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown.

25.name: Relentless Volley
25.desc: Heartseeker has additional charges.

26.name: Fletcher's Resurgence
26.desc: Your Heartseeker restores a charge whenever you pick up a {Black Arrow}.

27.name: Shadow Weaver's Grasp
27.desc: Heartseeker now has a minimum chance to {Recurve}.

28.name: Nimble Threads
28.desc: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve} scaling with Dexterity.

29.name: A Storm of Arrows
29.desc: Whenever Heartseeker {Recurves}, it extends the duration of your most recent {Hail of Arrows} by a small amount, up to 10 times per use of {Hail of Arrows}.
stats: +0.2 Hail of Arrows Duration On Recurve

30.name: Woven Grasp
30.desc: Heartseeker now twists around in a semi-cirle to {Recurve} and its hits have a chance to slow enemies.

31.name: Deep Rust
31.desc: Armor shred chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

0.name: Lethal Mirage
0.desc: A circular attack that's also used by your shadow clones. Requires dual wielding.

2.name: Maj'elkan Blade
2.desc: Lethal Mirage deals additional melee physical damage per equipped sword or dagger.

3.name: Wounding Ambush
3.desc: Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.

4.name: Shocking Grasp
4.desc:
Lethal Mirage deals additional melee lightning damage and its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

34.name: Hidden Blows
34.desc: {Puncture} and {Shurikens} have a chance cause enemies to bleed if used inside the smoke cloud.

2.name: Toxic Tips
2.desc: Shurikens have a chance to poison enemies.

3.name: Weighted Projectiles
3.desc: Shurikens penetrates enemy physical resistance.

4.name: Deep Cuts
4.desc: Shurikens have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

6.name: Flip of a Coin
6.desc: You have a chance to throw many additional Shurikens with each throw.

7.name: Entry Points
7.desc: Shurikens hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed or poison on the target up to a maximum.

8.name: Throwing Star
8.desc: Shurikens are now thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.

9.name: Scintillant Steel
9.desc: Shurikens deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and costs less mana.

10.name: Keen Throw
10.desc: {Chakram} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each projectile you would release with Shurikens.

11.name: Behind the Veil
11.desc: Shurikens have a chance to {Blind} enemies.

12.name: Acrobatics
12.desc: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.

13.name: Exuberance
13.desc: Shurikens have a shorter cooldown and you gain {Haste} for a short duration if it hits at least one enemy.

14.name: Stagger
14.desc: Shurikens {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for a short duration.

15.name: Alacrity
15.desc: Shurikens have increased attack speed.

16.name: Charged Steel
16.desc:
Shurikens deals additional lightning damage and a percentage of its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Shurikens gains a {Lightning} tag. If all its base damage is converted it loses its {Physical} tag.

17.name: Shuriken Storm
17.desc: Shurikens shock enemies on hit.

18.name: Abrasive Arsenal
18.desc: Shurikens have a chance to shred enemy physical and poison resistance.

19.name: Ricochet
19.desc:
Shurikens ricochets to different targets up to a maximum number of times, but costs more mana.

Pierce chance is converted to additional critical strike multiplier.

20.name: Fan of Blades
20.desc: You throw additional Shurikens with each throw.

21.name: Blade Shield
21.desc: You now summon your Shurikens in a shield around you for 3 seconds. All Shurikens cast this way can hit the same target.

22.name: Bladed Armor
22.desc: When you directly cast Shurikens you gain a stack of {Bladed Armor}, which grants increased armor per stack. Maximum of 3 stacks.

23.name: Floating Blades
23.desc: {Blade Shield} lasts longer.

24.name: Aerodynamic
24.desc:
Shurikens travel faster and farther.

This does not affect {Chakram.}

25.name: Deadly Aim
25.desc:
Shurikens are now thrown in a straight line and they can hit the same target, but you throw half as many (rounded up).

This has no effect if you have the {Blade Shield} node.

27.name: Ethereal Blades
27.desc: Shurikens have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit).

28.name: Jagged Edges
28.desc: Improves Shurikens' base critical strike chance and Shurikens deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Massacre
29.desc: Shurikens' critical strikes deal more damage.

30.name: Chakram
30.desc:
You now throw a single returning {Chakram} instead of multiple Shurikens. 

The Chakram has increased size and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This damage modifier is doubled if Chakram is directly used.

0.name: Synchronized Strike
0.desc:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

1.name: Growing Darkness
1.desc: Synchronized Strike deals damage in a larger area.

2.name: Foreshadowing
2.desc:
{Shadows} created by Synchronized Strike deal increased damage. This effect also applies to shadows created from any source for 4 seconds after using Synchronized Strike.

This effect stacks.

3.name: Dark Allies
3.desc: Synchronized Strike creates 2 additional {Shadows}, but costs significantly more mana. This can exceed your normal maximum number of {Shadows}.

4.name: Razor Strikes
4.desc: Synchronized Strike has a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

5.name: Crimson Storm
5.desc: Using Synchronized Strike grants you {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

6.name: Shadow Dancing
6.desc: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Shadows} from Synchronized Strike expire after attacking. They also do not cause existing {Shadows} to expire and do not trigger {on shadow creation} or {on shadow expiration} effects.

7.name: Shadow Fang
7.desc: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Last Call
8.desc: Synchronized Strike deals more damage to enemies on low health.

9.name: Lust for Carnage
9.desc: Synchronized Strike leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

10.name: Escape Artist
10.desc: You gain {Haste} for a short duration when you kill an enemy with Synchronized Strike.

11.name: Umbral Execution
11.desc:
Synchronized Strike instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

12.name: Thrill of the Kill
12.desc: You are granted increased critical strike chance for 4 seconds on kill with Synchronized Strike. This effect can stack.

13.name: Blade Prowess
13.desc: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword and has a chance to poison enemies per equipped dagger.

14.name: Lethality
14.desc: Improves Synchronized Strike's base critical strike chance.

15.name: True Strikes
15.desc: Synchronized Strike deals more critical strike damage.

16.name: Harmony of Death
16.desc: Synchronized Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Critical Vulnerability}.

17.name: Coordinated Cuts
17.desc: Synchronized Strike has a chance to shred enemy armor. Armor shred applied by Synchronized Strike has increased effectiveness.

18.name: Umbral Assassination
18.desc: Synchronized Strike inflicts enemies with a {Shadow Dagger}.

19.name: Shadow Infusion
19.desc: Synchronized Strike consumes existing {Shadows} to deal damage in a larger area and grant you ward per {Shadow} consumed.

20.name: Wave of Darkness
20.desc:
Synchronized Strike causes existing {Shadows} to use {Shadow Cascade} on use, rather than being consumed immediately. 

This effect consumes a portion of mana per active Shadow.

21.name: Dynamics
21.desc: Synchronized Strike costs less mana.

22.name: Art of the Blade
22.desc: You are granted increased attack speed for 3 seconds if Synchronized Strike hits at least one enemy.

23.name: Perfect Coordination
23.desc: The {Shadows} now jump inward towards the target rather than outward, making it easier for them to hit the same target. Synchronized Strikes has additional mana cost.

24.name: Divergence
24.desc: Synchronized Strike deals more damage, but the {Shadows} now attack from where you teleport from, rather than where you arrive.

25.name: Shadow Rush
25.desc: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike restore health on creation.

26.name: Retreat Into Shadow
26.desc:
You now disappear instead of teleporting to the target and a {Shadow} is created in your place, but Synchronized Strike has a longer cooldown. You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Synchronized Strike.

Synchronized Strike's mana cost is significantly lower.

27.name: Dark Passage
27.desc:
Directly using Synchronized Strike grants {Dark Passage} for 4 seconds, creating a shadow every second over its duration.

Synchronized Strike deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only creates a single shadow from the initial attack.
stats: Create a Shadow Every Second for 4 Seconds

28.name: Cutthroat
28.desc: Synchronized Strike always critically hits enemies on high health.

1.name: Dawnfall
1.desc: You have a chance to gain {Dusk Shroud} when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.

2.name: Sword Thrower
2.desc: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.

4.name: Honed Edge
4.desc: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike chance.

5.name: Thousand Cuts
5.desc: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike multiplier for each blade being thrown or recalled by the attack.

6.name: Lethal Darkness
6.desc: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} on hit, while using a dagger.

7.name: Edge of Obscurity
7.desc:
Umbral Blades deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Dusk Shroud} on you, up to 20. 

This effect is doubled while inside the area of {Smoke Bomb}.
stats: +2% Damage per Dusk Shroud, up to 20

8.name: Umbral Remnant
8.desc: Whenever one of your {Shadows} expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade.

10.name: Soul Thief
10.desc: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.
stats: +4 Ward Gain On Hit On Recall

11.name: Stabbing Blast
11.desc: Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.

12.name: Shredding Daggers
12.desc: Recalled blades now have a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies it hits).

13.name: Nightmare Dash
13.desc:
You can now only recall blades by using {Shift}, rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.

14.name: Backstab
14.desc: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Slice the Legs
15.desc: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.

16.name: Bloody Trail
16.desc: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.
stats: +10% Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Slow
+3% Recalled Blades Hit Damage Per Bleed

17.name: Cut and Leave
17.desc:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second.

18.name: Emerald Cutlass
18.desc:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the {Explosive Blades}, the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.

19.name: Kunai Belt
19.desc: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the second throw.

20.name: Hidden Blades
20.desc: Every 2 seconds you throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the next throw.

21.name: Jagged Carvings
21.desc: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.

22.name: Twilight Assault
22.desc: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.

23.name: Duskhunter
23.desc: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the third throw.

24.name: Subzero Intrusion
24.desc:
Umbral Blades base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Swaps Umbral Blades' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

25.name: Coldsnap Strike
25.desc: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.

26.name: Precision Cuts
26.desc: Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

27.name: Explosive Blades
27.desc:
Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a {Shard Explosion}, a subskill dealing physical damage in an area.

Blades expire and explode after 3 seconds if no enemies walk over them.

28.name: Burst of Agony
28.desc: The {Shard Explosion} deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
stats: +20% More Explosion Area Per Second On Ground
+20% Explosion Damage Per Second On Ground

30.name: Calling Card
30.desc: Recalled blades have a chance to create a {Shadow} at their position.
